      {
        "number": 161,
        "text": "    elif tile == \"SWITCH\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 162,
        "text": "        cost = 1.5"
      },
      {
        "number": 163,
        "text": "    elif tile in PORTALS:"
      },
      {
        "number": 164,
        "text": "        cost = 3.5"
      },
      {
        "number": 165,
        "text": "    else:"
      },
      {
        "number": 166,
        "text": "        cost = 0.63"
      },
      {
        "number": 167,
        "text": "    if in_beam:"
      },
      {
        "number": 168,
        "text": "        cost += 33.0"
      },
      {
        "number": 169,
        "text": "    if in_hot:"
      },
      {
        "number": 170,
        "text": "        cost += 50.0"
      },
      {
        "number": 171,
        "text": "    return cost"
      },
      {
        "number": 172,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 173,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 174,
        "text": "def _update_memory(state, memory):"
      },
      {
        "number": 175,
        "text": "    known = memory.get(\"k\")"
      },
      {
        "number": 176,
        "text": "    if not isinstance(known, list) or len(known) != CELLS:"
      },
      {
        "number": 177,
        "text": "        known = [None] * CELLS"
      },
      {
        "number": 178,
        "text": "        memory[\"k\"] = known"
      },
      {
        "number": 179,
        "text": "    occ_m = memory.get(\"o\")"
      },
      {
        "number": 180,
        "text": "    if not isinstance(occ_m, list) or len(occ_m) != CELLS:"
      },
      {
        "number": 181,
        "text": "        occ_m = [None] * CELLS"
      },
      {
        "number": 182,
        "text": "        memory[\"o\"] = occ_m"
      },
      {
        "number": 183,
        "text": "    vis = state[\"visible_mask\"]"
      },
      {
        "number": 184,
        "text": "    ter = state[\"terrain\"]"
      },
      {
        "number": 185,
        "text": "    occ = state[\"occupant\"]"
      },
      {
        "number": 186,
        "text": "    clues = state[\"clues\"]"
      },
      {
        "number": 187,
        "text": "    for y in range(GRID_H):"
      },
      {
        "number": 188,
        "text": "        vr = vis[y]"
      },
      {
        "number": 189,
        "text": "        if not vr:"
      },
      {
        "number": 190,
        "text": "            continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 191,
        "text": "        base = y * GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 192,
        "text": "        tr = ter[y]"
      },
      {
        "number": 193,
        "text": "        orow = occ[y]"
      },
      {
        "number": 194,
        "text": "        for x in range(GRID_W):"
      },
      {
        "number": 195,
        "text": "            if not vr[x]:"
      },
      {
        "number": 196,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 197,
        "text": "            t = tr[x]"
      },
      {
        "number": 198,
        "text": "            if t == \"UNKNOWN\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 199,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 200,
        "text": "            idx = base + x"
      },
      {
        "number": 201,
        "text": "            if t == \"CHEST\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 202,
        "text": "                # 四邻全可见才能用骸骨线索判断真伪"
      },
      {
        "number": 203,
        "text": "                resolved = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 204,
        "text": "                mimic = False"
      },
      {
        "number": 205,
        "text": "                for dx, dy in ((0, -1), (0, 1), (-1, 0), (1, 0)):"
      },
      {
        "number": 206,
        "text": "                    nx = x + dx"
      },
      {
        "number": 207,
        "text": "                    ny = y + dy"
      },
      {
        "number": 208,
        "text": "                    if nx < 0 or nx >= GRID_W or ny < 0 or ny >= GRID_H:"
      },
      {
        "number": 209,
        "text": "                        continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 210,
        "text": "                    if not vis[ny][nx]:"
      },
      {
        "number": 211,
        "text": "                        resolved = False"
      },
      {
        "number": 212,
        "text": "                        break"
      },
      {
        "number": 213,
        "text": "                    if clues[ny][nx]:"
      },
      {
        "number": 214,
        "text": "                        mimic = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 215,
        "text": "                known[idx] = (\"MIMIC\" if mimic else \"HEAL\") if resolved else \"CHEST\""
      },
      {
        "number": 216,
        "text": "                occ_m[idx] = None"
      },
      {
        "number": 217,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 218,
        "text": "            known[idx] = t"
      },
      {
        "number": 219,
        "text": "            occ_m[idx] = orow[x]"
      },
      {
        "number": 220,
        "text": "    return known, occ_m"
      },
      {
        "number": 221,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 222,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 223,
        "text": "def _beam_sets(known, occ_m, flipped):"
      },
      {
        "number": 224,
        "text": "    sets = []"
      },
      {
        "number": 225,
        "text": "    for idx in range(CELLS):"
      },
      {
        "number": 226,
        "text": "        dk = LASER_TILES.get(known[idx])"
      },
      {
        "number": 227,
        "text": "        if dk is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 228,
        "text": "            continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 229,
        "text": "        x = idx % GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 230,
        "text": "        y = idx // GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 231,
        "text": "        dx, dy = DIRS[dk]"
      },
      {
        "number": 232,
        "text": "        cells = set()"
      },
      {
        "number": 233,
        "text": "        for step in range(1, 11):"
      },
      {
        "number": 234,
        "text": "            nx = x + dx * step"
      },
      {
        "number": 235,
        "text": "            ny = y + dy * step"
      },
      {
        "number": 236,
        "text": "            if nx < 0 or nx >= GRID_W or ny < 0 or ny >= GRID_H:"
      },
      {
        "number": 237,
        "text": "                break"
      },
      {
        "number": 238,
        "text": "            j = ny * GRID_W + nx"
      },
      {
        "number": 239,
        "text": "            t = known[j]"
      },
      {
        "number": 240,
        "text": "            if t is not None and _is_wall(t, flipped):"
      },
      {
        "number": 241,
        "text": "                break"
      },
      {
        "number": 242,
        "text": "            o = occ_m[j]"
      },
      {
        "number": 243,
        "text": "            if o == \"BOX\" or o == \"TNT\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 244,
        "text": "                break"
      },
      {
        "number": 245,
        "text": "            cells.add(j)"
      },
      {
        "number": 246,
        "text": "        if cells:"
      },
      {
        "number": 247,
        "text": "            sets.append(cells)"
      },
      {
        "number": 248,
        "text": "    return sets"
      },
      {
        "number": 249,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 250,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 251,
        "text": "def _hot_cells(state, beam_sets):"
      },
      {
        "number": 252,
        "text": "    hot = set()"
      },
      {
        "number": 253,
        "text": "    bombs = state.get(\"bombs\") or ()"
      },
      {
        "number": 254,
        "text": "    for b in bombs:"
      },
      {
        "number": 255,
        "text": "        try:"
      },
      {
        "number": 256,
        "text": "            t = int(b[\"timer\"])"
      },
      {
        "number": 257,
        "text": "            bx = int(b[\"x\"])"
      },
      {
        "number": 258,
        "text": "            by = int(b[\"y\"])"
      },
      {
        "number": 259,
        "text": "        except Exception:"
      },
      {
        "number": 260,
        "text": "            continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 261,
        "text": "        if t <= 2:"
      },
      {
        "number": 262,
        "text": "            for yy in range(by - 1, by + 2):"
      },
      {
        "number": 263,
        "text": "                for xx in range(bx - 1, bx + 2):"
      },
      {
        "number": 264,
        "text": "                    if 0 <= xx < GRID_W and 0 <= yy < GRID_H:"
      },
      {
        "number": 265,
        "text": "                        hot.add(yy * GRID_W + xx)"
      },
      {
        "number": 266,
        "text": "    # 已知 TNT 若已在激光弹道上，会在激光回合被引爆"
      },
      {
        "number": 267,
        "text": "    if beam_sets:"
      },
      {
        "number": 268,
        "text": "        occ = state.get(\"occupant\")"
      },
      {
        "number": 269,
        "text": "        for cells in beam_sets:"
      },
      {
        "number": 270,
        "text": "            for idx in cells:"
      },
      {
        "number": 271,
        "text": "                y = idx // GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 272,
        "text": "                x = idx % GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 273,
        "text": "                try:"
      },
      {
        "number": 274,
        "text": "                    if occ[y][x] != \"TNT\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 275,
        "text": "                        continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 276,
        "text": "                except Exception:"
      },
      {
        "number": 277,
        "text": "                    continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 278,
        "text": "                for yy in range(y - 1, y + 2):"
      },
      {
        "number": 279,
        "text": "                    for xx in range(x - 1, x + 2):"
      },
      {
        "number": 280,
        "text": "                        if 0 <= xx < GRID_W and 0 <= yy < GRID_H:"
      },
      {
        "number": 281,
        "text": "                            hot.add(yy * GRID_W + xx)"
      },
      {
        "number": 282,
        "text": "    return hot"
      },
      {
        "number": 283,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 284,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 285,
        "text": "def _next_goal(state):"
      },
      {
        "number": 286,
        "text": "    hero = state[\"hero\"]"
      },
      {
        "number": 287,
        "text": "    hx = int(hero[\"x\"])"
      },
      {
        "number": 288,
        "text": "    hy = int(hero[\"y\"])"
      },
      {
        "number": 289,
        "text": "    keys = hero[\"keys\"]"
      },
      {
        "number": 290,
        "text": "    tg = state.get(\"targets\") or {}"
      },
      {
        "number": 291,
        "text": "    k1 = tg.get(\"K1\")"
      },
      {
        "number": 292,
        "text": "    k2 = tg.get(\"K2\")"
      },
      {
        "number": 293,
        "text": "    vp = tg.get(\"V\")"
      },
      {
        "number": 294,
        "text": "    if not keys[0] and not keys[1]:"
      },
      {
        "number": 295,
        "text": "        best = None"
      },
      {
        "number": 296,
        "text": "        bd = None"
      },
      {
        "number": 297,
        "text": "        for cand in (k1, k2):"
      },
      {
        "number": 298,
        "text": "            if not cand:"
      },
      {
        "number": 299,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 300,
        "text": "            d = abs(int(cand[0]) - hx) + abs(int(cand[1]) - hy)"
      },
      {
        "number": 301,
        "text": "            if bd is None or d < bd:"
      },
      {
        "number": 302,
        "text": "                bd = d"
      },
      {
        "number": 303,
        "text": "                best = cand"
      },
      {
        "number": 304,
        "text": "        return (int(best[0]), int(best[1])) if best else None"
      },
      {
        "number": 305,
        "text": "    if keys[0] and not keys[1]:"
      },
      {
        "number": 306,
        "text": "        return (int(k2[0]), int(k2[1])) if k2 else None"
      },
      {
        "number": 307,
        "text": "    if keys[1] and not keys[0]:"
      },
      {
        "number": 308,
        "text": "        return (int(k1[0]), int(k1[1])) if k1 else None"
      },
      {
        "number": 309,
        "text": "    return (int(vp[0]), int(vp[1])) if vp else None"
      },
      {
        "number": 310,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 311,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 312,
        "text": "_POPC = [0] * 4096"
      },
      {
        "number": 313,
        "text": "for _i in range(1, 4096):"
      },
      {
        "number": 314,
        "text": "    _POPC[_i] = _POPC[_i >> 1] + (_i & 1)"
      },
      {
        "number": 315,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 316,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 317,
        "text": "def _plan_field(known, occ_m, flipped, beams, hot, hp, jumps, goal_idx, mem_beam=None):"
      },
      {
        "number": 318,
        "text": "    \"\"\"三相位（turn%3）时间展开反向 Dijkstra："
      },
      {
        "number": 319,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 320,
        "text": "    dist[cell*3+p] = 在\"出发回合号 mod 3 == p\"时位于 cell 的最优代价，"
      },
      {
        "number": 321,
        "text": "    act[...] = 该状态的最佳首动作。相位模型让规划器自动把穿越激光的时机算进去。"
      },
      {
        "number": 322,
        "text": "    \"\"\""
      },
      {
        "number": 323,
        "text": "    nb = len(beams)"
      },
      {
        "number": 324,
        "text": "    cover = [0] * CELLS"
      },
      {
        "number": 325,
        "text": "    for bi in range(nb):"
      },
      {
        "number": 326,
        "text": "        bit = 1 << bi"
      },
      {
        "number": 327,
        "text": "        for c in beams[bi]:"
      },
      {
        "number": 328,
        "text": "            cover[c] |= bit"
      },
      {
        "number": 329,
        "text": "    if hp > 70:"
      },
      {
        "number": 330,
        "text": "        hit_cost = 90.0"
      },
      {
        "number": 331,
        "text": "    elif hp > 50:"
      },
      {
        "number": 332,
        "text": "        hit_cost = 500.0"
      },
      {
        "number": 333,
        "text": "    else:"
      },
      {
        "number": 334,
        "text": "        hit_cost = 1500.0"
      },
      {
        "number": 335,
        "text": "    if mem_beam is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 336,
        "text": "        mem_beam = ()"
      },
      {
        "number": 337,
        "text": "    layers = [[[] for _ in range(CELLS)] for _ in range(3)]"
      },
      {
        "number": 338,
        "text": "    jump_extra = 2.0 + (2.5 if jumps <= 1 else 0.0)"
      },
      {
        "number": 339,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 340,
        "text": "    def add_edge(u, v, act_s, base, heavy, prob):"
      },
      {
        "number": 341,
        "text": "        layers[1][v].append((u * 3, act_s, base + heavy + prob))"
      },
      {
        "number": 342,
        "text": "        layers[2][v].append((u * 3 + 1, act_s, base))"
      },
      {
        "number": 343,
        "text": "        layers[0][v].append((u * 3 + 2, act_s, base))"
      },
      {
        "number": 344,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 345,
        "text": "    for u in range(CELLS):"
      },
      {
        "number": 346,
        "text": "        ux = u % GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 347,
        "text": "        uy = u // GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 348,
        "text": "        cu = cover[u]"
      },
      {
        "number": 349,
        "text": "        for dk in DIR_KEYS:"
      },
      {
        "number": 350,
        "text": "            dx, dy = DIRS[dk]"
      },
      {
        "number": 351,
        "text": "            nx = ux + dx"
      },
      {
        "number": 352,
        "text": "            ny = uy + dy"
      },
      {
        "number": 353,
        "text": "            if 0 <= nx < GRID_W and 0 <= ny < GRID_H:"
      },
      {
        "number": 354,
        "text": "                v = ny * GRID_W + nx"
      },
      {
        "number": 355,
        "text": "                base = _cell_cost(known[v], occ_m[v], flipped, False, v in hot, hp)"
      },
      {
        "number": 356,
        "text": "                if base is not None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 357,
        "text": "                    cv = cover[v]"
      },
      {
        "number": 358,
        "text": "                    heavy = hit_cost * _POPC[cu | cv] if nb else 0.0"
      },
      {
        "number": 359,
        "text": "                    prob = 0.0"
      },
      {
        "number": 360,
        "text": "                    if not (cu | cv) and (u in mem_beam or v in mem_beam):"
      },
      {
        "number": 361,
        "text": "                        prob = hit_cost"
      },
      {
        "number": 362,
        "text": "                    add_edge(u, v, MOVE_ACT[dk], base, heavy, prob)"
      },
      {
        "number": 363,
        "text": "            if jumps > 0:"
      },
      {
        "number": 364,
        "text": "                p1x = ux + dx"
      },
      {
        "number": 365,
        "text": "                p1y = uy + dy"
      },
      {
        "number": 366,
        "text": "                p2x = ux + 2 * dx"
      },
      {
        "number": 367,
        "text": "                p2y = uy + 2 * dy"
      },
      {
        "number": 368,
        "text": "                if not (0 <= p2x < GRID_W and 0 <= p2y < GRID_H):"
      },
      {
        "number": 369,
        "text": "                    continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 370,
        "text": "                i1 = p1y * GRID_W + p1x"
      },
      {
        "number": 371,
        "text": "                t1 = known[i1]"
      },
      {
        "number": 372,
        "text": "                if t1 is not None and _is_wall(t1, flipped):"
      },
      {
        "number": 373,
        "text": "                    continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 374,
        "text": "                i2 = p2y * GRID_W + p2x"
      },
      {
        "number": 375,
        "text": "                t2 = known[i2]"
      },
      {
        "number": 376,
        "text": "                if t2 is not None and _is_wall(t2, flipped):"
      },
      {
        "number": 377,
        "text": "                    continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 378,
        "text": "                base2 = _cell_cost(t2, occ_m[i2], flipped, False, i2 in hot, hp)"
      },
      {
        "number": 379,
        "text": "                if base2 is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 380,
        "text": "                    continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 381,
        "text": "                if t1 is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 382,
        "text": "                    base2 += 1.5"
      },
      {
        "number": 383,
        "text": "                ci = cover[i2]"
      },
      {
        "number": 384,
        "text": "                heavy = hit_cost * _POPC[cu | ci] if nb else 0.0"
      },
      {
        "number": 385,
        "text": "                prob = 0.0"
      },
      {
        "number": 386,
        "text": "                if not (cu | ci) and (u in mem_beam or i2 in mem_beam):"
      },
      {
        "number": 387,
        "text": "                    prob = hit_cost"
      },
      {
        "number": 388,
        "text": "                add_edge(u, i2, JUMP_ACT[dk], base2 + jump_extra, heavy, prob)"
      },
      {
        "number": 389,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 390,
        "text": "    total = CELLS * 3"
      },
      {
        "number": 391,
        "text": "    dist = [INF] * total"
      },
      {
        "number": 392,
        "text": "    act = [None] * total"
      },
      {
        "number": 393,
        "text": "    if goal_idx is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 394,
        "text": "        return dist, act"
      },
      {
        "number": 395,
        "text": "    for ph in range(3):"
      },
      {
        "number": 396,
        "text": "        dist[goal_idx * 3 + ph] = 0.0"
      },
      {
        "number": 397,
        "text": "    pq = [(0.0, goal_idx * 3), (0.0, goal_idx * 3 + 1), (0.0, goal_idx * 3 + 2)]"
      },
      {
        "number": 398,
        "text": "    while pq:"
      },
      {
        "number": 399,
        "text": "        d, st = heapq.heappop(pq)"
      },
      {
        "number": 400,
        "text": "        if d > dist[st] + 1e-12:"
      },
      {
        "number": 401,
        "text": "            continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 402,
        "text": "        cell = st // 3"
      },
      {
        "number": 403,
        "text": "        ph = st % 3"
      },
      {
        "number": 404,
        "text": "        for (uf, a, c) in layers[ph][cell]:"
      },
      {
        "number": 405,
        "text": "            nd = d + c"
      },
      {
        "number": 406,
        "text": "            if nd < dist[uf] - 1e-12:"
      },
      {
        "number": 407,
        "text": "                dist[uf] = nd"
      },
      {
        "number": 408,
        "text": "                act[uf] = a"
      },
      {
        "number": 409,
        "text": "                heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, uf))"
      },
      {
        "number": 410,
        "text": "    return dist, act"
      },
      {
        "number": 411,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 412,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 413,
        "text": "def _sim_chain(hx, hy, dkey, known, occ_m, flipped, hp):"
      },
      {
        "number": 414,
        "text": "    \"\"\"已知地图上仿真一次 MOVE 的 8 步原子位移链。\"\"\""
      },
      {
        "number": 415,
        "text": "    res = {\"dead\": False, \"blocked\": False, \"unknown\": False,"
      },
      {
        "number": 416,
        "text": "           \"dmg\": 0, \"x\": hx, \"y\": hy, \"exposed\": [(hx, hy)]}"
      },
      {
        "number": 417,
        "text": "    dx, dy = DIRS[dkey]"
      },
      {
        "number": 418,
        "text": "    x = hx + dx"
      },
      {
        "number": 419,
        "text": "    y = hy + dy"
      },
      {
        "number": 420,
        "text": "    if not (0 <= x < GRID_W and 0 <= y < GRID_H):"
      },
      {
        "number": 421,
        "text": "        res[\"blocked\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 422,
        "text": "        return res"
      },
      {
        "number": 423,
        "text": "    idx = y * GRID_W + x"
      },
      {
        "number": 424,
        "text": "    if occ_m[idx] == \"BOX\" or occ_m[idx] == \"TNT\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 425,
        "text": "        res[\"blocked\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 426,
        "text": "        return res"
      },
      {
        "number": 427,
        "text": "    t = known[idx]"
      },
      {
        "number": 428,
        "text": "    if t is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 429,
        "text": "        res[\"unknown\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 430,
        "text": "        res[\"x\"] = x"
      },
      {
        "number": 431,
        "text": "        res[\"y\"] = y"
      },
      {
        "number": 432,
        "text": "        res[\"exposed\"].append((x, y))"
      },
      {
        "number": 433,
        "text": "        return res"
      },
      {
        "number": 434,
        "text": "    if _is_wall(t, flipped):"
      },
      {
        "number": 435,
        "text": "        res[\"blocked\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 436,
        "text": "        return res"
      },
      {
        "number": 437,
        "text": "    cur = (x, y)"
      },
      {
        "number": 438,
        "text": "    dk = dkey"
      },
      {
        "number": 439,
        "text": "    steps = 0"
      },
      {
        "number": 440,
        "text": "    while True:"
      },
      {
        "number": 441,
        "text": "        steps += 1"
      },
      {
        "number": 442,
        "text": "        if steps > 32:"
      },
      {
        "number": 443,
        "text": "            break"
      },
      {
        "number": 444,
        "text": "        tile = known[cur[1] * GRID_W + cur[0]]"
      },
      {
        "number": 445,
        "text": "        if tile is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 446,
        "text": "            res[\"unknown\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 447,
        "text": "            break"
      },
      {
        "number": 448,
        "text": "        res[\"exposed\"].append(cur)"
      },
      {
        "number": 449,
        "text": "        if tile == \"PIT\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 450,
        "text": "            res[\"dmg\"] += 100"
      },
      {
        "number": 451,
        "text": "            res[\"dead\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 452,
        "text": "            break"
      },
      {
        "number": 453,
        "text": "        if tile == \"MIMIC\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 454,
        "text": "            res[\"dmg\"] += 45"
      },
      {
        "number": 455,
        "text": "        elif tile == \"HEAL\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 456,
        "text": "            res[\"dmg\"] -= 30"
      },
      {
        "number": 457,
        "text": "        elif tile == \"SWITCH\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 458,
        "text": "            flipped = not flipped"
      },
      {
        "number": 459,
        "text": "        if tile in SPRING_TILES:"
      },
      {
        "number": 460,
        "text": "            dk = SPRING_TILES[tile]"
      },
      {
        "number": 461,
        "text": "            ndx, ndy = DIRS[dk]"
      },
      {
        "number": 462,
        "text": "            land = None"
      },
      {
        "number": 463,
        "text": "            for k in (1, 2, 3):"
      },
      {
        "number": 464,
        "text": "                px = cur[0] + k * ndx"
      },
      {
        "number": 465,
        "text": "                py = cur[1] + k * ndy"
      },
      {
        "number": 466,
        "text": "                if not (0 <= px < GRID_W and 0 <= py < GRID_H):"
      },
      {
        "number": 467,
        "text": "                    land = None if k == 1 else (cur[0] + (k - 1) * ndx, cur[1] + (k - 1) * ndy)"
      },
      {
        "number": 468,
        "text": "                    break"
      },
      {
        "number": 469,
        "text": "                j = py * GRID_W + px"
      },
      {
        "number": 470,
        "text": "                tt = known[j]"
      },
      {
        "number": 471,
        "text": "                oo = occ_m[j]"
      },
      {
        "number": 472,
        "text": "                if oo == \"BOX\" or oo == \"TNT\" or (tt is not None and _is_wall(tt, flipped)):"
      },
      {
        "number": 473,
        "text": "                    land = None if k == 1 else (cur[0] + (k - 1) * ndx, cur[1] + (k - 1) * ndy)"
      },
      {
        "number": 474,
        "text": "                    break"
      },
      {
        "number": 475,
        "text": "                if tt is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 476,
        "text": "                    res[\"unknown\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 477,
        "text": "                    land = None"
      },
      {
        "number": 478,
        "text": "                    break"
      },
      {
        "number": 479,
        "text": "            if res[\"unknown\"]:"
      },
      {
        "number": 480,
        "text": "                break"
      },
      {
        "number": 481,
        "text": "            if land is None or land == cur:"
      },
      {
        "number": 482,
        "text": "                break"
      },
      {
        "number": 483,
        "text": "            cur = land"
      },
      {
        "number": 484,
        "text": "            res[\"exposed\"].append(cur)"
      },
      {
        "number": 485,
        "text": "            tile = known[cur[1] * GRID_W + cur[0]]"
      },
      {
        "number": 486,
        "text": "            if tile is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 487,
        "text": "                res[\"unknown\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 488,
        "text": "                break"
      },
      {
        "number": 489,
        "text": "            if tile == \"PIT\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 490,
        "text": "                res[\"dmg\"] += 100"
      },
      {
        "number": 491,
        "text": "                res[\"dead\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 492,
        "text": "                break"
      },
      {
        "number": 493,
        "text": "            if tile == \"MIMIC\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 494,
        "text": "                res[\"dmg\"] += 45"
      },
      {
        "number": 495,
        "text": "            elif tile == \"HEAL\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 496,
        "text": "                res[\"dmg\"] -= 30"
      },
      {
        "number": 497,
        "text": "            elif tile == \"SWITCH\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 498,
        "text": "                flipped = not flipped"
      },
      {
        "number": 499,
        "text": "            if tile != \"ICE\" and tile not in MIRROR_TILES:"
      },
      {
        "number": 500,
        "text": "                break"
      },
      {
        "number": 501,
        "text": "            continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 502,
        "text": "        if tile in MIRROR_TILES:"
      },
      {
        "number": 503,
        "text": "            dk = MIRROR_TILES[tile][dk]"
      },
      {
        "number": 504,
        "text": "        if tile in PORTALS:"
      },
      {
        "number": 505,
        "text": "            res[\"unknown\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 506,
        "text": "            break"
      },
      {
        "number": 507,
        "text": "        if tile == \"ICE\" or tile in MIRROR_TILES or tile in SPRING_TILES:"
      },
      {
        "number": 508,
        "text": "            ndx, ndy = DIRS[dk]"
      },
      {
        "number": 509,
        "text": "            nx = cur[0] + ndx"
      },
      {
        "number": 510,
        "text": "            ny = cur[1] + ndy"
      },
      {
        "number": 511,
        "text": "            if not (0 <= nx < GRID_W and 0 <= ny < GRID_H):"
      },
      {
        "number": 512,
        "text": "                break"
      },
      {
        "number": 513,
        "text": "            j = ny * GRID_W + nx"
      },
      {
        "number": 514,
        "text": "            tt = known[j]"
      },
      {
        "number": 515,
        "text": "            oo = occ_m[j]"
      },
      {
        "number": 516,
        "text": "            if oo == \"BOX\" or oo == \"TNT\" or (tt is not None and _is_wall(tt, flipped)):"
      },
      {
        "number": 517,
        "text": "                break"
      },
      {
        "number": 518,
        "text": "            if tt is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 519,
        "text": "                res[\"unknown\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 520,
        "text": "                break"
      },
      {
        "number": 521,
        "text": "            cur = (nx, ny)"
      },
      {
        "number": 522,
        "text": "            continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 523,
        "text": "        break"
      },
      {
        "number": 524,
        "text": "    res[\"x\"] = cur[0]"
      },
      {
        "number": 525,
        "text": "    res[\"y\"] = cur[1]"
      },
      {
        "number": 526,
        "text": "    if hp - res[\"dmg\"] <= 0:"
      },
      {
        "number": 527,
        "text": "        res[\"dead\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 528,
        "text": "    return res"
      },
      {
        "number": 529,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 530,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 531,
        "text": "def _sim_jump(hx, hy, dkey, known, occ_m, flipped, hp):"
      },
      {
        "number": 532,
        "text": "    res = {\"dead\": False, \"blocked\": False, \"unknown\": False,"
      },
      {
        "number": 533,
        "text": "           \"dmg\": 0, \"x\": hx, \"y\": hy, \"exposed\": [(hx, hy)]}"
      },
      {
        "number": 534,
        "text": "    dx, dy = DIRS[dkey]"
      },
      {
        "number": 535,
        "text": "    p1 = (hx + dx, hy + dy)"
      },
      {
        "number": 536,
        "text": "    p2 = (hx + 2 * dx, hy + 2 * dy)"
      },
      {
        "number": 537,
        "text": "    if not (0 <= p2[0] < GRID_W and 0 <= p2[1] < GRID_H):"
      },
      {
        "number": 538,
        "text": "        res[\"blocked\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 539,
        "text": "        return res"
      },
      {
        "number": 540,
        "text": "    t1 = known[p1[1] * GRID_W + p1[0]]"
      },
      {
        "number": 541,
        "text": "    if t1 is not None and _is_wall(t1, flipped):"
      },
      {
        "number": 542,
        "text": "        res[\"blocked\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 543,
        "text": "        return res"
      },
      {
        "number": 544,
        "text": "    i2 = p2[1] * GRID_W + p2[0]"
      },
      {
        "number": 545,
        "text": "    o2 = occ_m[i2]"
      },
      {
        "number": 546,
        "text": "    if o2 == \"BOX\" or o2 == \"TNT\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 547,
        "text": "        res[\"blocked\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 548,
        "text": "        return res"
      },
      {
        "number": 549,
        "text": "    t2 = known[i2]"
      },
      {
        "number": 550,
        "text": "    if t2 is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 551,
        "text": "        res[\"unknown\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 552,
        "text": "        res[\"x\"] = p2[0]"
      },
      {
        "number": 553,
        "text": "        res[\"y\"] = p2[1]"
      },
      {
        "number": 554,
        "text": "        res[\"exposed\"].append(p2)"
      },
      {
        "number": 555,
        "text": "        return res"
      },
      {
        "number": 556,
        "text": "    if _is_wall(t2, flipped):"
      },
      {
        "number": 557,
        "text": "        res[\"blocked\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 558,
        "text": "        return res"
      },
      {
        "number": 559,
        "text": "    res[\"exposed\"].append(p2)"
      },
      {
        "number": 560,
        "text": "    if t2 == \"PIT\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 561,
        "text": "        res[\"dmg\"] += 100"
      },
      {
        "number": 562,
        "text": "        res[\"dead\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 563,
        "text": "        res[\"x\"] = p2[0]"
      },
      {
        "number": 564,
        "text": "        res[\"y\"] = p2[1]"
      },
      {
        "number": 565,
        "text": "        return res"
      },
      {
        "number": 566,
        "text": "    if t2 == \"MIMIC\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 567,
        "text": "        res[\"dmg\"] += 45"
      },
      {
        "number": 568,
        "text": "    elif t2 == \"HEAL\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 569,
        "text": "        res[\"dmg\"] -= 30"
      },
      {
        "number": 570,
        "text": "    res[\"x\"] = p2[0]"
      },
      {
        "number": 571,
        "text": "    res[\"y\"] = p2[1]"
      },
      {
        "number": 572,
        "text": "    if hp - res[\"dmg\"] <= 0:"
      },
      {
        "number": 573,
        "text": "        res[\"dead\"] = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 574,
        "text": "    return res"
      },
      {
        "number": 575,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 576,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 577,
        "text": "def _laser_hits(cells, beam_sets, warn=None):"
      },
      {
        "number": 578,
        "text": "    \"\"\"估计本轮会被多少门激光炮命中（已知炮座精确计数 + 官方 laser_warnings 兜底）。\"\"\""
      },
      {
        "number": 579,
        "text": "    if not cells:"
      },
      {
        "number": 580,
        "text": "        return 0"
      },
      {
        "number": 581,
        "text": "    ex = set()"
      },
      {
        "number": 582,
        "text": "    for (x, y) in cells:"
      },
      {
        "number": 583,
        "text": "        ex.add(y * GRID_W + x)"
      },
      {
        "number": 584,
        "text": "    n = 0"
      },
      {
        "number": 585,
        "text": "    if beam_sets:"
      },
      {
        "number": 586,
        "text": "        for bs in beam_sets:"
      },
      {
        "number": 587,
        "text": "            if not ex.isdisjoint(bs):"
      },
      {
        "number": 588,
        "text": "                n += 1"
      },
      {
        "number": 589,
        "text": "    if warn:"
      },
      {
        "number": 590,
        "text": "        top = 0"
      },
      {
        "number": 591,
        "text": "        distinct = 0"
      },
      {
        "number": 592,
        "text": "        for (x, y) in cells:"
      },
      {
        "number": 593,
        "text": "            c = warn.get((x, y), 0)"
      },
      {
        "number": 594,
        "text": "            if c > top:"
      },
      {
        "number": 595,
        "text": "                top = c"
      },
      {
        "number": 596,
        "text": "            if c > 0:"
      },
      {
        "number": 597,
        "text": "                distinct += 1"
      },
      {
        "number": 598,
        "text": "        if top > n:"
      },
      {
        "number": 599,
        "text": "            n = top"
      },
      {
        "number": 600,
        "text": "        if distinct > n:"
      },
      {
        "number": 601,
        "text": "            n = distinct"
      },
      {
        "number": 602,
        "text": "    return n"
      },
      {
        "number": 603,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 604,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 605,
        "text": "# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 破墙自救"
      },
      {
        "number": 606,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 607,
        "text": "def _bfs_reach(start, known, occ_m, flipped):"
      },
      {
        "number": 608,
        "text": "    seen = set((start,))"
      },
      {
        "number": 609,
        "text": "    stack = [start]"
      },
      {
        "number": 610,
        "text": "    while stack:"
      },
      {
        "number": 611,
        "text": "        u = stack.pop()"
      },
      {
        "number": 612,
        "text": "        ux = u % GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 613,
        "text": "        uy = u // GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 614,
        "text": "        for dk in DIR_KEYS:"
      },
      {
        "number": 615,
        "text": "            dx, dy = DIRS[dk]"
      },
      {
        "number": 616,
        "text": "            nx = ux + dx"
      },
      {
        "number": 617,
        "text": "            ny = uy + dy"
      },
      {
        "number": 618,
        "text": "            if not (0 <= nx < GRID_W and 0 <= ny < GRID_H):"
      },
      {
        "number": 619,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 620,
        "text": "            v = ny * GRID_W + nx"
      },
      {
        "number": 621,
        "text": "            if v in seen:"
      },
      {
        "number": 622,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 623,
        "text": "            t = known[v]"
      },
      {
        "number": 624,
        "text": "            if t is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 625,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 626,
        "text": "            if occ_m[v] is not None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 627,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 628,
        "text": "            if _is_wall(t, flipped) or t == \"PIT\" or t == \"MIMIC\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 629,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 630,
        "text": "            seen.add(v)"
      },
      {
        "number": 631,
        "text": "            stack.append(v)"
      },
      {
        "number": 632,
        "text": "    return seen"
      },
      {
        "number": 633,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 634,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 635,
        "text": "def _bfs_path_act(start, target, known, occ_m, flipped):"
      },
      {
        "number": 636,
        "text": "    \"\"\"从 start 到 target 的最短步行路径的首个动作。\"\"\""
      },
      {
        "number": 637,
        "text": "    if start == target:"
      },
      {
        "number": 638,
        "text": "        return None"
      },
      {
        "number": 639,
        "text": "    prev = {start: (None, None)}"
      },
      {
        "number": 640,
        "text": "    dq = [start]"
      },
      {
        "number": 641,
        "text": "    head = 0"
      },
      {
        "number": 642,
        "text": "    while head < len(dq):"
      },
      {
        "number": 643,
        "text": "        u = dq[head]"
      },
      {
        "number": 644,
        "text": "        head += 1"
      },
      {
        "number": 645,
        "text": "        ux = u % GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 646,
        "text": "        uy = u // GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 647,
        "text": "        for dk in DIR_KEYS:"
      },
      {
        "number": 648,
        "text": "            dx, dy = DIRS[dk]"
      },
      {
        "number": 649,
        "text": "            nx = ux + dx"
      },
      {
        "number": 650,
        "text": "            ny = uy + dy"
      },
      {
        "number": 651,
        "text": "            if not (0 <= nx < GRID_W and 0 <= ny < GRID_H):"
      },
      {
        "number": 652,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 653,
        "text": "            v = ny * GRID_W + nx"
      },
      {
        "number": 654,
        "text": "            if v in prev:"
      },
      {
        "number": 655,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 656,
        "text": "            if occ_m[v] is not None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 657,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 658,
        "text": "            t = known[v]"
      },
      {
        "number": 659,
        "text": "            if t is None or _is_wall(t, flipped) or t == \"PIT\" or t == \"MIMIC\":"
      },
      {
        "number": 660,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 661,
        "text": "            prev[v] = (u, MOVE_ACT[dk])"
      },
      {
        "number": 662,
        "text": "            if v == target:"
      },
      {
        "number": 663,
        "text": "                node = v"
      },
      {
        "number": 664,
        "text": "                act = MOVE_ACT[dk]"
      },
      {
        "number": 665,
        "text": "                while prev[node][0] is not None and prev[node][0] != start:"
      },
      {
        "number": 666,
        "text": "                    node = prev[node][0]"
      },
      {
        "number": 667,
        "text": "                    act = prev[node][1]"
      },
      {
        "number": 668,
        "text": "                return act"
      },
      {
        "number": 669,
        "text": "            dq.append(v)"
      },
      {
        "number": 670,
        "text": "    return None"
      },
      {
        "number": 671,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 672,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 673,
        "text": "def _breach_action(state, known, occ_m, flipped, hx, hy, goal):"
      },
      {
        "number": 674,
        "text": "    \"\"\"被彻底封死时：找一格可炸的 W 墙，走到贴墙格布雷。\"\"\""
      },
      {
        "number": 675,
        "text": "    hero = state[\"hero\"]"
      },
      {
        "number": 676,
        "text": "    if int(hero[\"bombs\"]) <= 0:"
      },
      {
        "number": 677,
        "text": "        return None"
      },
      {
        "number": 678,
        "text": "    gx, gy = goal"
      },
      {
        "number": 679,
        "text": "    start = hy * GRID_W + hx"
      },
      {
        "number": 680,
        "text": "    reach = _bfs_reach(start, known, occ_m, flipped)"
      },
      {
        "number": 681,
        "text": "    best_wall = None"
      },
      {
        "number": 682,
        "text": "    for u in reach:"
      },
      {
        "number": 683,
        "text": "        ux = u % GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 684,
        "text": "        uy = u // GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 685,
        "text": "        for dk in DIR_KEYS:"
      },
      {
        "number": 686,
        "text": "            dx, dy = DIRS[dk]"
      },
      {
        "number": 687,
        "text": "            nx = ux + dx"
      },
      {
        "number": 688,
        "text": "            ny = uy + dy"
      },
      {
        "number": 689,
        "text": "            if not (0 <= nx < GRID_W and 0 <= ny < GRID_H):"
      },
      {
        "number": 690,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 691,
        "text": "            v = ny * GRID_W + nx"
      },
      {
        "number": 692,
        "text": "            if known[v] != \"W\" or occ_m[v] is not None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 693,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 694,
        "text": "            sc = abs(nx - gx) + abs(ny - gy)"
      },
      {
        "number": 695,
        "text": "            if best_wall is None or sc < best_wall[0]:"
      },
      {
        "number": 696,
        "text": "                best_wall = (sc, v)"
      },
      {
        "number": 697,
        "text": "    if best_wall is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 698,
        "text": "        return None"
      },
      {
        "number": 699,
        "text": "    wx = best_wall[1] % GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 700,
        "text": "    wy = best_wall[1] // GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 701,
        "text": "    # 选贴近墙的可达格作为布雷点"
      },
      {
        "number": 702,
        "text": "    best_b = None"
      },
      {
        "number": 703,
        "text": "    for u in reach:"
      },
      {
        "number": 704,
        "text": "        ux = u % GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 705,
        "text": "        uy = u // GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 706,
        "text": "        if max(abs(ux - wx), abs(uy - wy)) <= 1:"
      },
      {
        "number": 707,
        "text": "            d = abs(ux - hx) + abs(uy - hy)"
      },
      {
        "number": 708,
        "text": "            if best_b is None or d < best_b[0]:"
      },
      {
        "number": 709,
        "text": "                best_b = (d, u)"
      },
      {
        "number": 710,
        "text": "    if best_b is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 711,
        "text": "        return None"
      },
      {
        "number": 712,
        "text": "    bx = best_b[1] % GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 713,
        "text": "    by = best_b[1] // GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 714,
        "text": "    # 已有炸弹贴着我们 / 脚下 -> 先撤到安全距离"
      },
      {
        "number": 715,
        "text": "    bombs = state.get(\"bombs\") or ()"
      },
      {
        "number": 716,
        "text": "    near_bomb = False"
      },
      {
        "number": 717,
        "text": "    for b in bombs:"
      },
      {
        "number": 718,
        "text": "        try:"
      },
      {
        "number": 719,
        "text": "            ddx = abs(int(b[\"x\"]) - hx)"
      },
      {
        "number": 720,
        "text": "            ddy = abs(int(b[\"y\"]) - hy)"
      },
      {
        "number": 721,
        "text": "        except Exception:"
      },
      {
        "number": 722,
        "text": "            continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 723,
        "text": "        if ddx <= 1 and ddy <= 1:"
      },
      {
        "number": 724,
        "text": "            near_bomb = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 725,
        "text": "    if near_bomb:"
      },
      {
        "number": 726,
        "text": "        best_r = None"
      },
      {
        "number": 727,
        "text": "        for u in reach:"
      },
      {
        "number": 728,
        "text": "            ux = u % GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 729,
        "text": "            uy = u // GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 730,
        "text": "            far = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 731,
        "text": "            for b in bombs:"
      },
      {
        "number": 732,
        "text": "                try:"
      },
      {
        "number": 733,
        "text": "                    if max(abs(int(b[\"x\"]) - ux), abs(int(b[\"y\"]) - uy)) <= 1:"
      },
      {
        "number": 734,
        "text": "                        far = False"
      },
      {
        "number": 735,
        "text": "                        break"
      },
      {
        "number": 736,
        "text": "                except Exception:"
      },
      {
        "number": 737,
        "text": "                    continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 738,
        "text": "            if far:"
      },
      {
        "number": 739,
        "text": "                d = abs(ux - hx) + abs(uy - hy)"
      },
      {
        "number": 740,
        "text": "                if best_r is None or d < best_r[0]:"
      },
      {
        "number": 741,
        "text": "                    best_r = (d, u)"
      },
      {
        "number": 742,
        "text": "        if best_r is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 743,
        "text": "            return None"
      },
      {
        "number": 744,
        "text": "        return _bfs_path_act(start, best_r[1], known, occ_m, flipped)"
      },
      {
        "number": 745,
        "text": "    if start == best_b[1]:"
      },
      {
        "number": 746,
        "text": "        # 确认炸完有地方躲（够大就躲，躲不开就赌血量扛一发炸弹自伤 50）"
      },
      {
        "number": 747,
        "text": "        safe = False"
      },
      {
        "number": 748,
        "text": "        for u in reach:"
      },
      {
        "number": 749,
        "text": "            ux = u % GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 750,
        "text": "            uy = u // GRID_W"
      },
      {
        "number": 751,
        "text": "            if max(abs(ux - bx), abs(uy - by)) >= 2:"
      },
      {
        "number": 752,
        "text": "                safe = True"
      },
      {
        "number": 753,
        "text": "                break"
      },
      {
        "number": 754,
        "text": "        if not safe and int(hero[\"hp\"]) <= 60:"
      },
      {
        "number": 755,
        "text": "            return None"
      },
      {
        "number": 756,
        "text": "        return \"BOMB\""
      },
      {
        "number": 757,
        "text": "    return _bfs_path_act(start, best_b[1], known, occ_m, flipped)"
      },
      {
        "number": 758,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 759,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 760,
        "text": "# ============================================================================="
      },
      {
        "number": 761,
        "text": "# 决策主体"
      },
      {
        "number": 762,
        "text": "# ============================================================================="
      },
      {
        "number": 763,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 764,
        "text": "def _decide(state, memory):"
      },
      {
        "number": 765,
        "text": "    hero = state[\"hero\"]"
      },
      {
        "number": 766,
        "text": "    hx = int(hero[\"x\"])"
      },
      {
        "number": 767,
        "text": "    hy = int(hero[\"y\"])"
      },
      {
        "number": 768,
        "text": "    hp = int(hero[\"hp\"])"
      },
      {
        "number": 769,
        "text": "    turn = int(state[\"turn\"])"
      },
      {
        "number": 770,
        "text": "    flipped = bool(state[\"gates_flipped\"])"
      },
      {
        "number": 771,
        "text": "    jumps = int(hero[\"jumps\"])"
      },
      {
        "number": 772,
        "text": "    throws = int(hero[\"throws\"])"
      },
      {
        "number": 773,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 774,
        "text": "    known, occ_m = _update_memory(state, memory)"
      },
      {
        "number": 775,
        "text": "    beams = _beam_sets(known, occ_m, flipped)"
      },
      {
        "number": 776,
        "text": "    hot = _hot_cells(state, beams)"
      },
      {
        "number": 777,
        "text": "    start = hy * GRID_W + hx"
      },
      {
        "number": 778,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 779,
        "text": "    goal = _next_goal(state)"
      },
      {
        "number": 780,
        "text": "    if goal is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 781,
        "text": "        return \"WAIT\""
      },
      {
        "number": 782,
        "text": "    gx, gy = goal"
      },
      {
        "number": 783,
        "text": "    goal_idx = gy * GRID_W + gx"
      },
      {
        "number": 784,
        "text": "    laser_now = (turn % 3 == 0)"
      },
      {
        "number": 785,
        "text": "    phase = turn % 3"
      },
      {
        "number": 786,
        "text": "    next_phase = (turn + 1) % 3"
      },
      {
        "number": 787,
        "text": "    warn = None"
      },
      {
        "number": 788,
        "text": "    if laser_now:"
      },
      {
        "number": 789,
        "text": "        warn = {}"
      },
      {
        "number": 790,
        "text": "        for w in (state.get(\"laser_warnings\") or ()):"
      },
      {
        "number": 791,
        "text": "            try:"
      },
      {
        "number": 792,
        "text": "                key = (int(w[\"x\"]), int(w[\"y\"]))"
      },
      {
        "number": 793,
        "text": "            except Exception:"
      },
      {
        "number": 794,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 795,
        "text": "            warn[key] = warn.get(key, 0) + 1"
      },
      {
        "number": 796,
        "text": "    # 记住历史警告过的弹道格（炮座可能在视野外），供后续回合避险"
      },
      {
        "number": 797,
        "text": "    beam_mem = memory.get(\"b\")"
      },
      {
        "number": 798,
        "text": "    if not isinstance(beam_mem, set):"
      },
      {
        "number": 799,
        "text": "        beam_mem = set()"
      },
      {
        "number": 800,
        "text": "        memory[\"b\"] = beam_mem"
      },
      {
        "number": 801,
        "text": "    if warn:"
      },
      {
        "number": 802,
        "text": "        for (bx, by) in warn:"
      },
      {
        "number": 803,
        "text": "            beam_mem.add(by * GRID_W + bx)"
      },
      {
        "number": 804,
        "text": "    dist, act = _plan_field(known, occ_m, flipped, beams, hot, hp, jumps, goal_idx,"
      },
      {
        "number": 805,
        "text": "                            beam_mem)"
      },
      {
        "number": 806,
        "text": "    start_state = start * 3 + phase"
      },
      {
        "number": 807,
        "text": "    plan_act = act[start_state]"
      },
      {
        "number": 808,
        "text": "    goal_cost = dist[start_state]"
      },
      {
        "number": 809,
        "text": "    sealed = goal_cost >= INF * 0.5"
      },
      {
        "number": 810,
        "text": "    if sealed:"
      },
      {
        "number": 811,
        "text": "        goal_cost = 40.0"
      },
      {
        "number": 812,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 813,
        "text": "    # 防打转：最近走过的格子"
      },
      {
        "number": 814,
        "text": "    hist = memory.get(\"h\")"
      },
      {
        "number": 815,
        "text": "    if not isinstance(hist, list):"
      },
      {
        "number": 816,
        "text": "        hist = []"
      },
      {
        "number": 817,
        "text": "        memory[\"h\"] = hist"
      },
      {
        "number": 818,
        "text": "    hist3 = set(hist[-3:-1]) if len(hist) >= 2 else set()"
      },
      {
        "number": 819,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 820,
        "text": "    # ---- 被彻底封死 / 长时间僵住：尝试炸弹破墙"
      },
      {
        "number": 821,
        "text": "    stall = memory.get(\"stall\")"
      },
      {
        "number": 822,
        "text": "    if not isinstance(stall, int):"
      },
      {
        "number": 823,
        "text": "        stall = 0"
      },
      {
        "number": 824,
        "text": "    if sealed or stall >= 6:"
      },
      {
        "number": 825,
        "text": "        breach = None"
      },
      {
        "number": 826,
        "text": "        try:"
      },
      {
        "number": 827,
        "text": "            breach = _breach_action(state, known, occ_m, flipped, hx, hy, goal)"
      },
      {
        "number": 828,
        "text": "        except Exception:"
      },
      {
        "number": 829,
        "text": "            breach = None"
      },
      {
        "number": 830,
        "text": "        if breach in VALID_ACTIONS:"
      },
      {
        "number": 831,
        "text": "            memory[\"stall\"] = 0"
      },
      {
        "number": 832,
        "text": "            memory[\"probe\"] = 0"
      },
      {
        "number": 833,
        "text": "            return breach"
      },
      {
        "number": 834,
        "text": "        # 最后手段：系统化试探（飞石引爆 TNT / 跳跃越障等），总比原地等死强"
      },
      {
        "number": 835,
        "text": "        idx = memory.get(\"probe\")"
      },
      {
        "number": 836,
        "text": "        if not isinstance(idx, int):"
      },
      {
        "number": 837,
        "text": "            idx = 0"
      },
      {
        "number": 838,
        "text": "        order = (\"THROW_R\", \"THROW_U\", \"THROW_D\", \"THROW_L\","
      },
      {
        "number": 839,
        "text": "                 \"JUMP_R\", \"JUMP_U\", \"JUMP_D\", \"JUMP_L\", \"BOMB\")"
      },
      {
        "number": 840,
        "text": "        while idx < len(order):"
      },
      {
        "number": 841,
        "text": "            a = order[idx]"
      },
      {
        "number": 842,
        "text": "            idx += 1"
      },
      {
        "number": 843,
        "text": "            if a.startswith(\"THROW_\") and throws <= 0:"
      },
      {
        "number": 844,
        "text": "                continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 845,
        "text": "            if a.startswith(\"JUMP_\"):"
      },
      {
        "number": 846,
        "text": "                if jumps <= 0:"
      },
      {
        "number": 847,
        "text": "                    continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 848,
        "text": "                sim = _sim_jump(hx, hy, a[5], known, occ_m, flipped, hp)"
      },
      {
        "number": 849,
        "text": "                if sim[\"blocked\"] or sim[\"dead\"]:"
      },
      {
        "number": 850,
        "text": "                    continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 851,
        "text": "            memory[\"probe\"] = idx"
      },
      {
        "number": 852,
        "text": "            memory[\"stall\"] = 0"
      },
      {
        "number": 853,
        "text": "            return a"
      },
      {
        "number": 854,
        "text": "        memory[\"probe\"] = idx"
      },
      {
        "number": 855,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 856,
        "text": "    # ---- 候选动作评估"
      },
      {
        "number": 857,
        "text": "    cands = []"
      },
      {
        "number": 858,
        "text": "    if plan_act:"
      },
      {
        "number": 859,
        "text": "        cands.append(plan_act)"
      },
      {
        "number": 860,
        "text": "    for dk in DIR_KEYS:"
      },
      {
        "number": 861,
        "text": "        a = MOVE_ACT[dk]"
      },
      {
        "number": 862,
        "text": "        if a not in cands:"
      },
      {
        "number": 863,
        "text": "            cands.append(a)"
      },
      {
        "number": 864,
        "text": "    if jumps > 0:"
      },
      {
        "number": 865,
        "text": "        for dk in DIR_KEYS:"
      },
      {
        "number": 866,
        "text": "            a = JUMP_ACT[dk]"
      },
      {
        "number": 867,
        "text": "            if a not in cands:"
      },
      {
        "number": 868,
        "text": "                cands.append(a)"
      },
      {
        "number": 869,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 870,
        "text": "    best_score = None"
      },
      {
        "number": 871,
        "text": "    best_act = None"
      },
      {
        "number": 872,
        "text": "    for a in cands:"
      },
      {
        "number": 873,
        "text": "        if a.startswith(\"MOVE_\"):"
      },
      {
        "number": 874,
        "text": "            sim = _sim_chain(hx, hy, a[5], known, occ_m, flipped, hp)"
      },
      {
        "number": 875,
        "text": "        else:"
      },
      {
        "number": 876,
        "text": "            sim = _sim_jump(hx, hy, a[5], known, occ_m, flipped, hp)"
      },
      {
        "number": 877,
        "text": "        if sim[\"blocked\"] or sim[\"dead\"]:"
      },
      {
        "number": 878,
        "text": "            continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 879,
        "text": "        if sim[\"x\"] == hx and sim[\"y\"] == hy:"
      },
      {
        "number": 880,
        "text": "            continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 881,
        "text": "        dmg = sim[\"dmg\"]"
      },
      {
        "number": 882,
        "text": "        if laser_now:"
      },
      {
        "number": 883,
        "text": "            dmg += 50 * _laser_hits(sim[\"exposed\"], beams, warn)"
      },
      {
        "number": 884,
        "text": "        if hp - dmg <= 0:"
      },
      {
        "number": 885,
        "text": "            continue"
      },
      {
        "number": 886,
        "text": "        eidx = sim[\"y\"] * GRID_W + sim[\"x\"]"
      },
      {
        "number": 887,
        "text": "        d2 = dist[eidx * 3 + next_phase]"
      },
      {
        "number": 888,
        "text": "        if d2 >= INF * 0.5:"
      },
      {
        "number": 889,
        "text": "            d2 = 40.0 + 0.63 * (abs(gx - sim[\"x\"]) + abs(gy - sim[\"y\"]))"
      },
      {
        "number": 890,
        "text": "        score = 1.5 * dmg + d2"
      },
      {
        "number": 891,
        "text": "        if sim[\"unknown\"]:"
      },
      {
        "number": 892,
        "text": "            score += 1.0"
      },
      {
        "number": 893,
        "text": "        if a != plan_act:"
      },
      {
        "number": 894,
        "text": "            score += 0.5"
      },
      {
        "number": 895,
        "text": "        if a.startswith(\"JUMP_\"):"
      },
      {
        "number": 896,
        "text": "            score += 0.3"
      },
      {
        "number": 897,
        "text": "        if eidx in hist3:"
      },
      {
        "number": 898,
        "text": "            score += 4.0"
      },
      {
        "number": 899,
        "text": "        if best_score is None or score < best_score:"
      },
      {
        "number": 900,
        "text": "            best_score = score"
      },
      {
        "number": 901,
        "text": "            best_act = a"
      },
      {
        "number": 902,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 903,
        "text": "    wait_dmg = 0"
      },
      {
        "number": 904,
        "text": "    if laser_now:"
      },
      {
        "number": 905,
        "text": "        wait_dmg += 50 * _laser_hits([(hx, hy)], beams, warn)"
      },
      {
        "number": 906,
        "text": "    wait_score = 1.5 * wait_dmg + dist[start * 3 + next_phase] + 2.0"
      },
      {
        "number": 907,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 908,
        "text": "    hist.append(start)"
      },
      {
        "number": 909,
        "text": "    if len(hist) > 8:"
      },
      {
        "number": 910,
        "text": "        del hist[0:len(hist) - 8]"
      },
      {
        "number": 911,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 912,
        "text": "    if best_act is None:"
      },
      {
        "number": 913,
        "text": "        memory[\"stall\"] = stall + 1"
      },
      {
        "number": 914,
        "text": "        return \"WAIT\""
      },
      {
        "number": 915,
        "text": "    if wait_score < best_score:"
      },
      {
        "number": 916,
        "text": "        memory[\"stall\"] = 0 if wait_dmg > 0 else stall + 1"
      },
      {
        "number": 917,
        "text": "        return \"WAIT\""
      },
      {
        "number": 918,
        "text": "    memory[\"stall\"] = 0"
      },
      {
        "number": 919,
        "text": "    return best_act"
      },
      {
        "number": 920,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 921,
        "text": ""
      },
      {
        "number": 922,
        "text": "def decide_action(state: dict, memory: dict) -> str:"

        "number": 923,
        "text": "    try:"

        "number": 924,
        "text": "        if not isinstance(memory, dict):"

可入：**先让该 `\"BOX\"`（初始 `steps_taken=0, portal_count=0`）从 `p1 -> p2` 启动并完整跑完箱子的动量链**（期间勇者原格 `(hx, hy)` 视为阻挡箱子的障碍物）。箱子动量链彻底结束后，重新检查 `p1` 格此刻是否对勇者可入（例如箱子可能折返停回 `p1`，或箱子踩了开关把 `p1` 处的门关上了）：仅当 `p1` 无阻挡且无箱子：勇者直接从 `(hx, hy) -> p1` 迈入并跑完动量链。\n150: 147: 4. **`\"JUMP_U/D/L/R\"`**：\n151: 148:    * 若 `hero.jumps == 0`：按 `\"WAIT\"` 处理；\n152: 149:    * 否则先扣减 `hero.jumps -= 1`。设第 1 格 `p1 = (hx+dx, hy+dy)`，第 2 格 `p2 = (hx+2*dx, hy+2*dy)`：\n153: 150:      * **起跳阻挡检查**：若 `p1` 为 `HIGH_WALL`，或者 `p2` 为 `HIGH_WALL`、`\"BOX\"` 或 `\"TNT\"`，则跳跃受阻失败，勇者留在原地（不触发 `p0` 离格，但跳跃次数已扣除）；\n154: 151:      * **成功腾空跨越**：勇者跃过 `p1`（`p1` 上的任何陷阱/钥匙/深渊均不触发，也不加入 `exposed_cells`），直接作为一次从 `p0 -> p2` 的成功位移（`steps_taken=0, portal_count=0, dir=(dx,dy)`）执行 8 步原子序（注意：`p0` 若为 `\"CRACK\"` 会在第 2 步正常坍塌为 `\"PIT\"`，`p2` 落点正常结算并延续动量）！\n155: 152: 5. **`\"THROW_U/D/L/R\"`**：\n156: 153:    * 若 `hero.throws == 0`：按 `\"WAIT\"` 处理；\n157: 154:    * 否则扣减 `hero.throws -= 1`。勇者留在原地，飞石从 `(sx, sy) = (hx, hy)` 沿 `dir = (dx, dy)` 射出，初始空中剩余射程 `range_left = 6`，传送计数 `stone_portals = 0`：\n158: 155:    * **空中飞行循环（当 `range_left > 0`）**：\n159: 156:      * 飞石进入下一相邻格 `pn = (sx+dx, sy+dy)`，消耗 `range_left -= 1`，更新 `(sx, sy) = pn`：\n160: 157:      * 若 `pn` 为 `HIGH_WALL` 或 `occupant[pn] == \"BOX\"`：飞石撞击碎裂，飞行结束；\n161: 158:      * 若 `occupant[pn] == \"TNT\"`：将该桶标记待爆 `tnt_armed.add(pn)`，飞石碎裂结束；\n162: 159:      * 若 `terrain[pn] == \"SWITCH\"`：`gates_flipped = not gates_flipped`，飞石碎裂结束；\n163: 160:      * 若 `terrain[pn] == \"MIMIC\"`：将 `terrain[pn]` 打爆清除为 `\"EMPTY\"`（同步清除其专属线索），飞石碎裂结束；\n164: 161:      * 若 `terrain[pn]` 为 `\"MIRROR_*\"`：按斜坡四向表折转 `dir`（每进入一格只折转一次），若 `range_left > 0` 继续向新方向飞行；\n165: 162:      * 若 `terrain[pn]` 为 `\"PORTAL_*\"`（且 `stone_portals < 2`）：检查配对端 `p_pair` 是否无 `\"BOX\"`/`\"TNT\"` 占用；若可入，飞石瞬间移至 `p_pair`（传送本身不额外消耗 `range_left`），`stone_portals += 1`；若 `stone_portals == 2` 则在 `p_pair` 直接停止，否则继续沿 `dir` 消耗剩余射程飞行；\n166: 163:      * 其余地形（`\"EMPTY\"`, `\"PIT\"`, `\"CRACK\"`, `\"ICE\"`, `\"SPRING_*\"`, `\"HEAL\"`, `\"K1\"`, `\"K2\"`, `\"V\"`）在空中完全透明飞越。\n167: 164:    * **第 6 格落地滑行延伸**：当 `range_left == 0` 且飞石尚未碎裂时，仅当此刻所在的第 6 格 `terrain[sx][sy]` 为 `\"ICE\"` 或 `\"MIRROR_*\"` 时，飞石转入地面滑行模式（最多滑行 32 步）：每步沿 `dir` 滑入下一格，途中若遇 `HIGH_WALL`/`\"BOX\"` 碎裂，遇 `\"TNT\"`/`\"SWITCH\"`/`\"MIMIC\"` 触发对应效果后碎裂，遇 `\"MIRROR_*\"` 折转继续滑，遇 `\"ICE\"` 继续滑，遇 `\"PORTAL_*\"` 按剩余传送次数传送，滑入任何其他地形（如 `\"EMPTY\"`, `\"PIT\"`, `\"CRACK\"`, `\"SPRING_*\"`）立即停下消失。\n168: 165: \n169: 166: #### ▶ 阶段 C：定时炸弹倒计时与链式爆炸闭包\n170: 167: 1. 全场现有 `bombs` 中的每颗炸弹 `timer -= 1`；\n171: 168: 2. 收集初始爆源集合：所有 `timer == 0` 的 `BOMB` 以及本回合阶段 A/B 中被加入 `tnt_armed` 的 `\"TNT\"`；\n172: 169: 3. 若存在初始爆源，执行 **同批链式爆炸 BFS**：\n173: 170:    * 设爆源队列 `Q`，对每个爆源 `(ex, ey)`，其波及范围为切比雪夫距离 $\\le 1$ 的九宫格（$|x - ex| \\le 1$ 且 $|y - ey| \\le 1$，注：钛金墙 `\"T_W\"` 自身免疫爆炸，但不遮挡同一九宫格内的对角格）。\n174: 171:    * 若九宫格内存在其他尚未引爆的 `\"TNT\"` 或尚未引爆的 `BOMB`（无论其 `timer` 是多少），立即将其加入 `Q` 在同一批次内链式引爆（每个爆源唯一计数，单批次只爆一次）。\n175: 172: 4. **伤害与地形合并结算（基于批次快照）**：\n176: 173:    * 统计波及勇者当前坐标 `(hx, hy)` 的所有爆源：每颗波及勇者的 `\"TNT\"` 计机关名义伤害 $+60$，每颗波及勇者的 `BOMB` 计勇者自伤 $+50$。设本批机关名义总伤害为 $a$，自伤总和为 $b$，结算前勇者血量为 $h$：\n177: 174:      * 若 $a + b > 0$，累加本批有效机关伤害 $\\Delta D = \\min(h, a + b) \\times \\frac{a}{a + b}$，随后扣减勇者血量 `hp -= (a + b)`。\n178: 175:    * 移除所有已引爆的 `BOMB` 与 `\"TNT\"`；\n179: 176:    * 对所有爆源九宫格并集内的每个格子 `(cx, cy)`：\n180: 177:      * 若 `occupant[cy][cx] == \"BOX\"`：箱子被炸毁（`occupant[cy][cx] = None`）；\n181: 178:      * 检查 `terrain[cy][cx]`：\n182: 179:        * `\"T_W\"`, `\"K1\"`, `\"K2\"`, `\"V\"`, `\"PORTAL_1A/1B/2A/2B\"`, `\"PIT\"`：**绝对免疫，保持不变**；\n183: 180:        * `\"CRACK\"`：**被炸断直接坍塌变为 `\"PIT\"`**；\n184: 181:        * `\"W\"`, `\"ICE\"`, `\"MIRROR_*\"`, `\"SPRING_*\"`, `\"LASER_*\"`, `\"SWITCH\"`, `\"R_GATE\"`, `\"B_GATE\"`, `\"HEAL\"`, `\"MIMIC\"`：**被炸毁变为 `\"EMPTY\"`**（若为 `\"MIMIC\"` 同步清除其专属线索）。\n185: 182:    * **爆炸后支撑检查**：\n186: 183:      * 若某未被炸毁的 `\"BOX\"` 脚下地形因爆炸变成了 `\"PIT\"`，该箱子立即填坑同归于尽（`occupant = None, terrain = \"EMPTY\"`）；\n187: 184:      * 若爆炸后勇者依然存活（`hp > 0`）但脚下 `terrain[hy][hx] == \"PIT\"`（例如勇者站在 `\"CRACK\"` 上被远方爆炸波及炸塌），勇者立即落坑受到 `100` 点机关伤害（记入有效机关伤害并 `hp -= 100`）！\n188: 185:    * 若 `hp <= 0`，立即终止回合判定勇者阵亡！\n189: 186: \n190: 187: #### ▶ 阶段 D：周期激光同步快照发射（仅当 `turn % 3 == 0` 时执行）\n191: 188: 当 `turn % 3 == 0`（即 `turn` 为 `3, 6, 9, ..., 240`）时：\n192: 189: 1. **冻结快照**：以阶段 C 结束后的地图状态为基准，扫描全场所有存活的 `\"LASER_U/D/L/R\"` 炮座。\n193: 190: 2. **同步射线延伸**：每门激光炮同时沿其朝向从相邻第 1 格起延伸最多 **10 格** 直线射线：\n194: 191:    * 逐格检查 $d = 1 .. 10$：\n195: 192:      * 若该格在快照中为 `HIGH_WALL` 或 `occupant == \"BOX\"`：射线在此格前截断（不包含该阻挡格）；\n196: 193:      * 若该格在快照中 `occupant == \"TNT\"`：射线在此格截断，并将该 `\"TNT\"` 标记入 `laser_tnt_armed`！\n197: 194:      * 否则该格属于该门激光炮的本轮激活射线格。\n198: 195: 3. **激光命中勇者结算**：\n199: 196:    * 统计所有激活激光炮中，其射线格集合与勇者本回合的暴露轨迹集合 `exposed_cells` 有交集的激光炮数量 $m$；\n200: 197:    * 若 $m > 0$，勇者受到 $50 \\times m$ 点纯机关伤害（有效机关伤害累加 $\\min(\\text{hp}, 50 \\times m)$，`hp -= 50 * m`）。若 `hp <= 0`，立即终止回合判定勇者阵亡！\n201: 198: 4. **激光引爆 `TNT` 连锁结算**：\n202: 199:    * 若 `laser_tnt_armed` 非空，以 `laser_tnt_armed` 为初始爆源调用阶段 C 的第 3、4 步爆炸闭包结算（**严格规定：此时绝不再次执行阶段 C 第 1 步的 `bombs` 倒计时递减！且本轮已被炸毁的激光炮座不会撤销步骤 3 已造成的激光伤害**）。\n203: 200: \n204: 201: * **回合末超时判定**：当 `turn == 240` 的阶段 D 完整执行完毕后，若勇者仍未通关（且未阵亡），则判定本局**超时失败（Timeout）**。\n205: 202: \n206: 203: ---\n207: 204: \n208: 205: ## 四、 双榜计分数学公式与经济博弈指南\n209: 206: \n210: 207: 设魔王建图花费为 $C_{\\text{spent}} \\in [0, 3000]$，金库留存比例为 $g = \\frac{3000 - C_{\\text{spent}}}{3000} \\in [0.0, 1.0]$；设整局累计有效机关伤害为 $D = \\min(100.0, \\sum \\Delta D_{\\text{trap}}) \\in [0.0, 100.0]$，勇者最终已拾取钥匙数为 $k \\in \\{0, 1, 2\\}$，当前阶段推进比为 $r = \\max\\!\\left(0.0, \\frac{d_0 - d_{\\min}}{\\max(1, d_0)}\\right) \\in [0.0, 1.0)$，连续总进度 $P = k + r \\in [0.0, 3.0)$。\n211: 208: \n212: 209: ### 1. 🗡️ 勇者单局得分 $Score_{\\text{Hero}}$（`0 ~ 1000` 连续线性分布）\n213: 210: * **【存活通关】（耗时 $T \\in [1, 240]$ 回合）**：\n214: 211:   $$Score_{\\text{Hero}} = 600 + 1.5 \\times HP_{\\text{left}} + 150 \\times \\frac{240 - T}{239} + 100 \\times g$$\n215: 212: * **【闯关失败】（阵亡或满 240 回合超时，三阶段连续线性推进）**：\n216: 213:   $$Score_{\\text{Hero}} = 200 \\times k + 200 \\times r = 200 \\times P$$\n217: 214:   *(其中 0 钥阶段占 `0~200` 分、1 钥阶段占 `200~400` 分、2 钥阶段占 `400~600` 分，无缝衔接存活通关的 `600` 分底线。距离采样仅在勇者取得第 $k$ 把钥匙之后的阶段内进行：$d_0$ 为该阶段起点距下一目标的曼哈顿距离，$d_{\\min}$ 为该阶段内勇者所有实际到达点距下一目标的最小曼哈顿距离；0 钥阶段下一目标距离定义为 $\\min(\\text{dist}(K_1), \\text{dist}(K_2))$，1 钥阶段为距剩余钥匙距离，2 钥阶段为距 `V` 距离。)*\n218: 215: \n219: 216: ### 2. 🏰 魔王单局得分 $Score_{\\text{Demon}}$（`0 ~ 1000` 连续线性分布）\n220: 217: * **情况 A：【实杀处决勇者】（勇者因 `HP <= 0` 阵亡 —— 全额独吞金库暴利！）**：\n221: 218:   $$Score_{\\text{Demon (Kill)}} = 500 + 50 \\times (3 - P) + D + 250 \\times g$$\n222: 219: * **情况 B：【困死超时勇者】（满 240 回合但勇者 `HP > 0` 存活 —— 基础分与金库暴利折减！）**：\n223: 220:   $$Score_{\\text{Demon (Timeout)}} = 320 + 50 \\times (3 - P) + D + 125 \\times g$$\n224: 221: * **情况 C：【金库失守】（被勇者存活通关 —— 按造成机关伤害与拖延回合连续计分，金库留存归零）**：\n225: 222:   $$Score_{\\text{Demon (Breached)}} = 2.0 \\times D + 120 \\times \\frac{T - 1}{239} \\quad (\\text{区间 } [0, 320]\\text{，无缝衔接困死底线})$$\n226: 223: \n227: 224: *(注：`author_solution` 必须在最后一个动作恰好首次完成存活通关，严禁在通关后追加冗余动作，否则直接判违章 0 分。)*\n228: 225: \n229: 226: ---\n230: 227: \n231: 228: ## 五、 接口输入输出 Schema 与完整样例\n232: 229: \n233: 230: ### 1. `build_dungeon()` 返回值规范\n234: 231: ```python\n235: 232: {\n236: 233:     \"taunt\": \"不超过40字的挑衅宣言\",\n237: 234:     \"grid\": [\n238: 235:         # 共 26 行，每行 40 个合法组件字符串\n239: 236:         [\"T_W\", \"T_W\", ..., \"T_W\"],\n240: 237:         ...\n241: 238:     ],\n242: 239:     \"author_solution\": [\n243: 240:         # 长度 1..240 的合法动作字符串列表，必须在最后一步恰好首次存活踏上 V 通关！\n244: 241:         \"MOVE_R\", \"MOVE_R\", \"WAIT\", \"JUMP_U\", ...\n245: 242:     ]\n246: 243: }\n247: 244: ```\n248: 245: \n249: 246: ### 2. `decide_action(state, memory)` 输入 `state` 完整结构\n250: 247: ```json\n251: 248: {\n252: 249:   \"turn\": 1,\n253: 250:   \"turns_left\": 240,\n254: 251:   \"mode\": \"BLIND\",\n255: 252:   \"hero\": {\n256: 253:     \"x\": 2,\n257: 254:     \"y\": 13,\n258: 255:     \"hp\": 100,\n259: 256:     \"keys\": [false, false],\n260: 257:     \"jumps\": 3,\n261: 258:     \"throws\": 3,\n262: 259:     \"bombs\": 2\n263: 260:   },\n264: 261:   \"gates_flipped\": false,\n265: 262:   \"targets\": {\n266: 263:     \"K1\": [20, 5],\n267: 264:     \"K2\": [20, 20],\n268:   \"terrain\": \"[[str x 40] x 26] (不可见格为 'UNKNOWN'; HEAL与MIMIC统一脱敏为 'CHEST')\",\n272: 269:   \"occupant\": \"[[str|None x 40] x 26] (可见格为 None|'BOX'|'TNT'; 不可见格为 None)\",\n273: 270:   \"bombs\": [\n274: 271:     {\"x\": 5, \"y\": 13, \"timer\": 2}\n275: 272:   ],\n276: 273:   \"clues\": \"[[bool x 40] x 26] (仅 visible_mask 为 True 且存在骸骨线索时为 True)\",\n277: 274:   \"laser_warnings\": [\n278: 275:     {\"x\": 4, \"y\": 13, \"dir\": \"D\"}\n279: 276:   ]\n280: 277: }\n281: 278: ```\n282: 279: *(注：`laser_warnings` 仅当 `turn % 3 == 0` 时返回按动作前快照计算且落在 `visible_mask` 内的激光束格，按 `(y, x, dir)` 升序排列；其余回合恒为空列表 `[]`。)*\n283: 280: \n284: 281: \n285: 282: ### BLIND 圆形视野与墙体遮挡（方案 B 增量约定）\n286: 283: \n287: 284: 基础候选格保持 `dx²+dy²<=10`，空旷中心恰为37格；存在遮挡或位于边缘时基础可见格少于37格。按 `max(|dx|,|dy|)=0,1,2,3` 由近及远判定。`sx=sign(dx)`、`sy=sign(dy)`，`open(dx,dy)=vis(dx,dy) and not is_high_wall(hx+dx,hy+dy)`，越界视为不透光：\n288: 285: \n289: 286: * 近身圈（自身及8邻格）恒可见，贴身墙面本身可见。\n290: 287: * 外圈正交格：仅当 `open(dx-sx,dy-sy)` 为真时可见。\n291: 288: * `(±2,±2)`：须 `open(sx,sy)`，且 `(hx+sx,hy)` 与 `(hx,hy+sy)` 不同时为高墙，禁止斜穿封死的墙角。\n292: 289: * `|dx|>|dy|>0`：`open(dx-sx,dy) or open(dx-sx,dy-sy)`。\n293: 290: * `|dy|>|dx|>0`：`open(dx,dy-sy) or open(dx-sx,dy-sy)`。\n294: 291: \n295: 292: 目标格可以是可见墙面，但不能继续向后透光。沿用现有 `HIGH_WALL` 定义：`W`、`T_W`、四向 `LASER_*` 炮座及当前关闭的红/蓝门；门随 `gates_flipped` 即时变化。被遮挡的地形为 `UNKNOWN`，骸骨线索不暴露，实体不暴露。相邻8格触发的冰面/折返镜滑道延伸仍使用原逻辑，作为基础视野之外的额外照亮（注：第一场正赛全部以 `BLIND` 迷雾模式运行，`FULL` 全图明牌破阵将独立发卷开赛，不在本场混跑）。\n296: \n297: (End of file - total 292 lines)\n298: </content>\n299: \n\n(End of
