      },
      {
        "number": 13,
        "text": "10: ### 1. 提交文件与运行环境"
      },
      {
        "number": 14,
        "text": "11: * 你需要提交单个 Python 3 文件：**`submission.py`**，并在其中实现两个顶层函数："
      },
      {
        "number": 15,
        "text": "12:   1. `build_dungeon() -> dict`（魔王造图与自证通关函数）"
      },
      {
        "number": 16,
        "text": "13:   2. `decide_action(state: dict, memory: dict) -> str`（勇者单步决策函数）"
      },
      {
        "number": 17,
        "text": "14: * **Python 环境与库使用权限**："
      },
      {
        "number": 18,
        "text": "15:   * 运行环境：CPython 3.11+。"
      },
      {
        "number": 19,
        "text": "16:   * **全面开放算法/数据结构标准库与科学计算库**：自由使用各类纯计算/数据结构/数学标准库（如 `math`, `cmath`, `heapq`, `collections`, `queue`, `array`, `statistics`, `decimal`, `fractions`, `graphlib`, `itertools`, `copy`, `random`, `typing`, `dataclasses`, `enum`, `bisect`, `functools`, `time`, `json`, `re`, `operator` 等）以及预装的算法计算库（如 `numpy`, `networkx`, `sympy`, `mpmath`），**正常面向对象私有属性/方法（如 `self._visited`、`self._bfs()`）完全允许**。"
      },
      {
        "number": 20,
        "text": "17:   * **严禁导入或调用以下危险能力（违反者直接判 0 分）**：任何文件与磁盘 I/O（如 `open`, `os`, `pathlib`, `shutil`, `io`, `np.load`/`loadtxt`/`fromfile`/`tofile`/`memmap`/`save*`, `nx.read_*`/`write_*`）、网络通信（`socket`, `urllib`, `http`, `requests` 等）、进程/线程控制（`subprocess`, `multiprocessing`, `threading`, `sys`）、动态执行、字节码篡改与双下划线反射内省（`eval`, `exec`, `inspect`, `ctypes`, `gc`, `types`, `pickle`, `builtins`, `__class__`/`__globals__` 等，注：`ctypeslib`/`f2py`/`testing` 子模块同样禁止）。"
      },
      {
        "number": 21,
        "text": "18: * **严禁联网检索**：比赛期间禁止使用任何联网搜索工具或查询外部代码库，必须 100% 独立完成。"
      },
      {
        "number": 22,
        "text": "19: * **限时 60 分钟，提前交卷无任何加分**：以 60:00 截止时刻最后一次完整保存且语法合法的 `submission.py` 为准。"
      },
      {
        "number": 23,
        "text": "20: "
      },
      {
        "number": 24,
        "text": "21: ### 2. 进程级隔离与计时红线"
      },
      {
        "number": 25,
        "text": "22: * **独立干净沙盒**：正式评测时，每一个 `(勇者, 目标地图)` 对局都在全新的独立子进程中运行，初始传入 `memory = {}`，固定随机种子 `random.seed(20261115)`，无法通过模块全局变量跨局传递数据。**第一场正赛全部采用 `\"BLIND\"` 迷雾盲视模式评测**（全图明牌破阵 `FULL` 模式将在独立的第二场赛程中另行提交专用代码）。"
      },
      {
        "number": 26,
        "text": "23: * **纯函数耗时上限**："
      },
      {
        "number": 27,
        "text": "24:   * 模块首次 `import submission` 限时 **`1.5 秒`**；"
      },
      {
        "number": 28,
        "text": "25:   * `build_dungeon()` 单次调用限时 **`2.0 秒`**（超时、抛异常或格式非法直接判魔王榜 **0 分废标**）；"
      },
      {
        "number": 29,
        "text": "26:   * `decide_action(state, memory)` 单步调用限时 **`0.5 秒`**。"
      },
      {
        "number": 30,
        "text": "27: * **勇者接口错误三振出局制**："
      },
      {
        "number": 31,
        "text": "28:   * 若 `decide_action` 超时（$>0.5\\text{s}$）、抛出未捕获异常、或返回值不属于 14 种合法动作字符串，视为一次**接口错误**：本回合动作强制替换为 `\"WAIT\"`，且连续错误计数 `error_streak += 1`；若 `error_streak == 3`（连续 3 回合接口错误），勇者当即暴毙判负。"
      },
      {
        "number": 32,
        "text": "29:   * 只要返回了合法的 14 种动作字符串之一（哪怕在游戏中撞墙、跳跃受阻或技能库存已用尽），均属于正常游戏行为，`error_streak` 立即清零（当技能库存为 `0` 时调用对应技能，游戏内自动按 `\"WAIT\"` 结算且不计接口错误）。"
      },
      {
        "number": 33,
        "text": "30: "
      },
      {
        "number": 34,
        "text": "31: ---"
      },
      {
        "number": 35,
        "text": "32: "
      },
      {
        "number": 36,
        "text": "33: ## 二、 赛场空间、四层状态模型与 3000G 金库经济"
      },
      {
        "number": 37,
        "text": "34: "
      },
      {
        "number": 38,
        "text": "35: ### 1. 画布尺寸与地标硬性约束（违反任意一条则魔王图 0 分废标）"
      },
      {
        "number": 39,
        "text": "36: * **网格尺寸**：宽 `40` 列（$x \\in [0, 39]$），高 `26` 行（$y \\in [0, 25]$），共 `1,040` 格。二维数组按 `grid[y][x]` 索引（`grid` 必须为包含 26 个长度为 40 的字符串列表）。"
      },
      {
        "number": 40,
        "text": "37: * **免费外框边界**：最外圈 128 格（即 $x \\in \\{0, 39\\}$ 或 $y \\in \\{0, 25\\}$）必须全部填写 `\"T_W\"`（钛金承重墙）。**外框这 128 格造价为 `0G`，且不计入 `\"T_W\"` 的 120 格单图限购配额！**"
      },
      {
        "number": 41,
        "text": "38: * **出生净空区（Spawn Clearance Zone）**："
      },
      {
        "number": 42,
        "text": "39:   * 勇者出生点固定在 `S = (2, 13)`（即 $x=2, y=13$）。"
      },
      {
        "number": 43,
        "text": "40:   * 以 `(2, 13)` 为中心的 $3\\times 3$ 区域（$x \\in [1, 3], y \\in [12, 14]$，共 9 格）为出生净空区，魔王提交的 `grid` 中这 9 格**必须全部填写 `\"EMPTY\"`**（禁止放置任何墙体、机关、箱子、地标或专属骸骨线索）。外部激光射线允许穿过该区域（第 3 回合才会首次发射）。"
      },
      {
        "number": 44,
        "text": "41: * **三座必放核心地标（造价均为 `0G`，全图各恰有 1 个，坐标互异）**："
      },
      {
        "number": 45,
        "text": "42:   1. **`\"K1\"`（上半区钥匙）**：必须满足 $x \\in [12, 34]$ 且 $y \\in [2, 10]$；"
      },
      {
        "number": 46,
        "text": "43:   2. **`\"K2\"`（下半区钥匙）**：必须满足 $x \\in [12, 34]$ 且 $y \\in [15, 23]$；"
      },
      {
        "number": 47,
        "text": "44:   3. **双钥间距约束**：必须满足曼哈顿距离 $|x_{K1} - x_{K2}| + |y_{K1} - y_{K2}| \\ge 12$；"
      },
      {
        "number": 48,
        "text": "45:   4. **`\"V\"`（终极金库）**：必须满足 $x \\in [33, 37]$ 且 $y \\in [4, 21]$。"
      },
      {
        "number": 49,
        "text": "46: * **通关条件**：勇者必须先拾取 `\"K1\"` 和 `\"K2\"`（先后顺序不限），随后在存活状态（$\\text{HP} > 0$）下踏上 `\"V\"` 金库格，当即判定通关成功！"
      },
      {
        "number": 50,
        "text": "47: "
      },
      {
        "number": 51,
        "text": "48: ### 2. 魔王施工组件参数表（总预算上限：`3,000 G`）"
      },
      {
        "number": 52,
        "text": "49: 魔王在内圈（$x \\in [1, 38], y \\in [1, 24]$）放置组件的累计造价 $C_{\\text{spent}}$ 不得超过 `3,000 G`："
      },
      {
        "number": 53,
        "text": "50: "
      },
      {
        "number": 54,
        "text": "51: | 类别 | 提交符号 (`grid[y][x]`) | 名称 | 单价 | 单图数量上限 | 基础物理简述 |"
      },
      {
        "number": 55,
        "text": "52: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |"
      },
      {
        "number": 56,
        "text": "53: | **基础** | `\"EMPTY\"` | 安全平地 | 0G | 无上限 | 普通摩擦地面，踏上即停。 |"
      },
      {
        "number": 57,
        "text": "54: | **地标** | `\"K1\"`, `\"K2\"`, `\"V\"` | 双钥匙与金库 | 0G | 各恰 1 个 | 见上方分区坐标约束。 |"
      },
      {
        "number": 58,
        "text": "55: | **墙体** | `\"W\"` | 普通砖墙 | 5G | 无上限 | 高墙阻挡；可被 `BOMB` 或 `TNT` 炸毁为 `\"EMPTY\"`。 |"
      },
      {
        "number": 59,
        "text": "56: | **墙体** | `\"T_W\"` | 钛金承重墙 | 25G | **120 格** *(不含外框)* | 不可摧毁的高墙，阻挡移动、跳跃、飞石、激光与爆炸。 |"
      },
      {
        "number": 60,
        "text": "57: | **动量** | `\"ICE\"` | 溜冰滑道 | 10G | 无上限 | 踏上后在同一回合内沿当前移动方向连续滑行。 |"
      },
      {
        "number": 61,
        "text": "58: | **动量** | `\"MIRROR_NE\"` (`↗`)<br>`\"MIRROR_SE\"` (`↘`)<br>`\"MIRROR_SW\"` (`↙`)<br>`\"MIRROR_NW\"` (`↖`) | 90°折跃斜坡 | 25G | 四种合计 **30 个** | 双轴无死角强制折转方向并继续滑出 1 格：<br>• `MIRROR_NE`: `L/R -> U`, `U/D -> R`<br>• `MIRROR_SE`: `L/R -> D`, `U/D -> R`<br>• `MIRROR_SW`: `L/R -> D`, `U/D -> L`<br>• `MIRROR_NW`: `L/R -> U`, `U/D -> L` |"
      },
      {
        "number": 62,
        "text": "59: | **动量** | `\"SPRING_U\"`, `\"SPRING_D\"`<br>`\"SPRING_L\"`, `\"SPRING_R\"` | 强力弹簧板 | 35G | 四种合计 **20 个** | 强制改为弹簧方向并腾空弹射最多 3 格（飞越中间低矮格）。 |"
      },
      {
        "number": 63,
        "text": "60: | **深渊** | `\"PIT\"` | 致命深渊坑 | 40G | 无上限 | 勇者落入即刻 `-100 HP` 暴毙；`BOX` 落入则与深渊同归于尽填平为 `\"EMPTY\"`。 |"
      },
      {
        "number": 64,
        "text": "61: | **时序** | `\"LASER_U\"`, `\"LASER_D\"`<br>`\"LASER_L\"`, `\"LASER_R\"` | 周期激光炮 | 75G | 四种合计 **12 门** | 炮座本身为高墙（可被炸毁）。当 `turn % 3 == 0` 时向朝向射出最长 10 格激光，命中勇者 `-50 HP`，击中 `TNT` 引爆。 |"
      },
      {
        "number": 65,
        "text": "62: | **时序** | `\"CRACK\"` | 脆冰断桥 | 20G | **40 格** | 踏上即停；当勇者或 `BOX` **离开该格的瞬间**，立即永久坍塌变为 `\"PIT\"`。 |"
      },
      {
        "number": 66,
        "text": "63: | **时序** | `\"SWITCH\"` | 红蓝反相开关 | 30G | **6 个** | 勇者/`BOX` 踏入或飞石击中时，全场 `R_GATE` 与 `B_GATE` 开闭状态立即互换。 |"
      },
      {
        "number": 67,
        "text": "64: | **时序** | `\"R_GATE\"`, `\"B_GATE\"` | 红门 / 蓝门 | 20G | 两种合计 **16 扇** | 初始 `gates_flipped = False` 时：`R_GATE` 关闭（高墙），`B_GATE` 开启（平地）。 |"
      },
      {
        "number": 68,
        "text": "65: | **爆破** | `\"TNT\"` | 连锁火药桶 | 40G | **12 个** | 独立占用层阻挡物。被激光、飞石、其他爆炸或弹簧弹射出的 `BOX` 击中时在阶段 C/D 引爆（$3\\times 3$ 造成 `-60 HP` 并炸墙）。 |"
      },
      {
        "number": 69,
        "text": "66: | **交互** | `\"BOX\"` | 重型合金箱 | 30G | **4 个** | 独立占用层实体。勇者执行 `\"MOVE_*\"` 可将其推动 1 格并触发箱子动量链。 |"
      },
      {
        "number": 70,
        "text": "67: | **欺诈** | `\"HEAL\"` | 真补给箱 | 30G | **4 个** | 勇者视野中显示为 `\"CHEST\"`。踏上恢复 `+30 HP`（上限 100）并变 `\"EMPTY\"`。 |"
      },
      {
        "number": 71,
        "text": "68: | **欺诈** | `\"MIMIC\"` | 伪装宝箱怪 | 60G | **4 个** | 勇者视野中同样显示为 `\"CHEST\"`。踏上扣 `-45 HP`、终止本回合动量并变 `\"EMPTY\"`。必须拥有合法专属骸骨线索位！ |"
      },
      {
        "number": 72,
        "text": "69: | **拓扑** | `\"PORTAL_1A\"`, `\"PORTAL_1B\"`<br>`\"PORTAL_2A\"`, `\"PORTAL_2B\"` | 双子传送门 | **80G/对** | **最多 2 对** | 若使用某编号，必须 `A` 与 `B` 成对出现（单放 1A 无 1B 判违章），每对合计收费 80G。 |"
      },
      {
        "number": 73,
        "text": "70: "
      },
      {
        "number": 74,
        "text": "71: ### 3. 裁判内核四层真值解码规则（Four-Layer Truth Model）"
      },
      {
        "number": 75,
        "text": "72: 魔王提交单层 `grid[26][40]` 后，裁判立即按以下规则解码为 4 个图层运行："
      },
      {
        "number": 76,
        "text": "73: 1. **`terrain[y][x]`（地形层）**：若 `grid[y][x]` 为 `\"BOX\"` 或 `\"TNT\"`，则 `terrain[y][x] = \"EMPTY\"`；否则 `terrain[y][x] = grid[y][x]`。"
      },
      {
        "number": 77,
        "text": "74: 2. **`occupant[y][x]`（实体占用层）**：若 `grid[y][x]` 为 `\"BOX\"` 或 `\"TNT\"`，则 `occupant[y][x] = grid[y][x]`；否则为 `None`。当箱子移动时只更新 `occupant` 层，不破坏底下的 `terrain`！"
      },
      {
        "number": 78,
        "text": "75: 3. **`bombs`（定时炸弹列表）**：初始为空列表 `[]`。"
      },
      {
        "number": 79,
        "text": "76: 4. **`clues[y][x]`（宝箱怪专属骸骨线索层）**："
      },
      {
        "number": 80,
        "text": "77:    * 初始全为 `False`。裁判按行优先（$y$ 从 $0\\to 25$，$x$ 从 $0\\to 39$）遍历每个 `\"MIMIC\"` `(mx, my)`，按固定顺序 **`U(0,-1), D(0,1), L(-1,0), R(1,0)`** 检查正交四邻 `(nx, ny)`，选择**第一个**同时满足以下条件的格子作为该 `\"MIMIC\"` 的绑定专属线索格："
      },
      {
        "number": 81,
        "text": "78:      1. 初始 `terrain[ny][nx] == \"EMPTY\"` 且 `occupant[ny][nx] is None`；"
      },
      {
        "number": 82,
        "text": "79:      2. 不在出生净空区（$x \\in [1,3], y \\in [12,14]$）内；"
      },
      {
        "number": 83,
        "text": "80:      3. 该格 `(nx, ny)` 的正交四邻中**不存在任何其他宝箱**（即除了当前 `(mx, my)` 外，不与任何其他 `\"HEAL\"` 或 `\"MIMIC\"` 正交相邻），且 `clues[ny][nx]` 尚未被占用。"
      },
      {
        "number": 84,
        "text": "81:    * **违章红线**：若任何一个 `\"MIMIC\"` 找不到满足上述条件的专属线索格，该魔王地图直接判**布局违章（0 分废标）**！"
      },
      {
        "number": 85,
        "text": "82:    * **动态清除**：当某个 `\"MIMIC\"` 被勇者踩爆、被箱子碾碎、被飞石打爆或被炸弹/TNT 炸毁时，其绑定的专属 `clues[ny][nx]` 立即同步重置为 `False`。"
      },
      {
        "number": 86,
        "text": "83: "
      },
      {
        "number": 87,
        "text": "84: ---"
      },
      {
        "number": 88,
        "text": "85: "
      },
      {
        "number": 89,
        "text": "86: ## 三、 确定性物理引擎：4 阶段与 8 步原子位移规范"
      },
      {
        "number": 90,
        "text": "87: "
      },
      {
        "number": 91,
        "text": "88: ### 1. 基础概念与阻挡集合"
      },
      {
        "number": 92,
        "text": "89: * 方向向量：`U = (0, -1)`, `D = (0, 1)`, `L = (-1, 0)`, `R = (1, 0)`。"
      },
      {
        "number": 93,
        "text": "90: * **高墙阻挡物（`HIGH_WALL`）**：`terrain[y][x]` 属于 `{\"W\", \"T_W\", \"LASER_U\", \"LASER_D\", \"LASER_L\", \"LASER_R\"}`，或当前处于**关闭状态**的门（当 `gates_flipped == False` 时 `\"R_GATE\"` 为高墙、`\"B_GATE\"` 为平地；当 `gates_flipped == True` 时 `\"B_GATE\"` 为高墙、`\"R_GATE\"` 为平地）。"
      },
      {
        "number": 94,
        "text": "91: * **门格特权**：开关翻转后新门态立即生效。若某扇门变为关闭时，勇者或 `\"BOX\"` 正停留在门格上，该实体可停留或正常移出该门格（不受挤压伤害），但其他实体不得进入。"
      },
      {
        "number": 95,
        "text": "92: "
      },
      {
        "number": 96,
        "text": "93: ### 2. 单次成功位移的 8 步原子结算序（Atomic Displacement Pipeline）"
      },
      {
        "number": 97,
        "text": "94: 每当实体（`hero` 或某个 `\"BOX\"`）从原坐标 `p0 = (x0, y0)` 成功进入目标格 `p1 = (x1, y1)`（含普通迈步、冰面滑入、斜坡折转滑入、跳跃落点、弹簧落点、传送到达配对端），严格按以下 8 步顺序执行："
      },
      {
        "number": 98,
        "text": "95: "
      },
      {
        "number": 99,
        "text": "96: 1. **位移计数递增**：该实体在当前动作链中的成功位移计数 `steps_taken += 1`。"
      },
      {
        "number": 100,
        "text": "97: 2. **原格离开钩子（Leave Hook）**：检查原格 `terrain[y0][x0]`：若为 `\"CRACK\"`（无论走离、跳离、弹簧起飞还是传送离开），立即将 `terrain[y0][x0]` 永久修改为 `\"PIT\"`！"
      },
      {
        "number": 101,
        "text": "98: 3. **更新坐标与暴露轨迹**："
      },
      {
        "number": 102,
        "text": "99:    * 若实体为 `\"BOX\"`：将 `occupant[y0][x0] = None`，`occupant[y1][x1] = \"BOX\"`；"
      },
      {
        "number": 103,
        "text": "100:    * 若实体为 `hero`：更新 `(hx, hy) = (x1, y1)`，并将 `(x1, y1)` 加入本回合激光暴露轨迹集合 `exposed_cells`。"
      },
      {
        "number": 104,
        "text": "101: 4. **落点即时效果（Arrive Hook）**：检查落点 `terrain[y1][x1]`："
      },
      {
        "number": 105,
        "text": "102:    * **若实体为 `\"BOX\"`**："
      },
      {
        "number": 106,
        "text": "103:      * `\"PIT\"`：箱子与深渊同归于尽——`occupant[y1][x1] = None`，`terrain[y1][x1] = \"EMPTY\"`，并立即终止该箱子的动量链；"
      },
      {
        "number": 107,
        "text": "104:      * `\"MIMIC\"`：箱子碾碎宝箱怪——`terrain[y1][x1] = \"EMPTY\"`（同步清除其专属线索）；"
      },
      {
        "number": 108,
        "text": "105:      * `\"SWITCH\"`：`gates_flipped = not gates_flipped`；"
      },
      {
        "number": 109,
        "text": "106:    * **若实体为 `hero`**："
      },
      {
        "number": 110,
        "text": "107:      * `\"PIT\"`：受到 `100` 点机关伤害（`hp -= 100`）；"
      },
      {
        "number": 111,
        "text": "108:      * `\"MIMIC\"`：受到 `45` 点机关伤害（`hp -= 45`），`terrain[y1][x1] = \"EMPTY\"`（同步清除其专属线索），并标记 `stop_momentum = True`；"
      },
      {
        "number": 112,
        "text": "109:      * `\"HEAL\"`：`hp = min(100, hp + 30)`，`terrain[y1][x1] = \"EMPTY\"`；"
      },
      {
        "number": 113,
        "text": "110:      * `\"SWITCH\"`：`gates_flipped = not gates_flipped`；"
      },
      {
        "number": 114,
        "text": "111: 5. **死亡即时截断**：若 `hero.hp <= 0`，立即终止本回合与整局游戏，判定勇者阵亡！"
      },
      {
        "number": 115,
        "text": "112: 6. **拾取钥匙与通关即时截断**："
      },
      {
        "number": 116,
        "text": "113:    * 若实体为 `hero` 且 `terrain[y1][x1] == \"K1\"`：`has_k1 = True`，`terrain[y1][x1] = \"EMPTY\"`；"
      },
      {
        "number": 117,
        "text": "114:    * 若实体为 `hero` 且 `terrain[y1][x1] == \"K2\"`：`has_k2 = True`，`terrain[y1][x1] = \"EMPTY\"`；"
      },
      {
        "number": 118,
        "text": "115:    * 若实体为 `hero` 且 `terrain[y1][x1] == \"V\"` 且 `has_k1 and has_k2` 且 `hero.hp > 0`：**立即终止本回合与整局游戏，判定勇者存活通关（不再执行后续阶段 C 与阶段 D）**！"
      },
      {
        "number": 119,
        "text": "116: 7. **位移上限与动量停止检查**：若 `steps_taken >= 32` 或 `stop_momentum == True`，立即终止该实体本次动作链的后续动量延伸，停在 `p1`。"
      },
      {
        "number": 120,
        "text": "117: 8. **动量延续判定（Momentum Continuation）**：根据此刻 `terrain[y1][x1]` 决定是否发起下一次位移（若刚刚是通过传送到达配对端且 `suppress_portal_once == True`，则跳过下方 `\"PORTAL_*\"` 分支，改按下方门后迈步规则处理）："
      },
      {
        "number": 121,
        "text": "118:    * **若为 `\"ICE\"`**：保持当前方向 `dir = (dx, dy)`，检查下一相邻格 `p_next = (x1+dx, y1+dy)` 是否可入（非 `HIGH_WALL`，且 `occupant` 非 `\"BOX\"`/`\"TNT\"`；若当前实体为 `\"BOX\"`，还要求 `p_next` 非勇者当前坐标且 `terrain` 非 `\"K1\"/\"K2\"/\"V\"`）。若可入，对 `p1 -> p_next` 递归执行本 8 步原子序；若受阻，则停在 `p1`，动量终止。"
      },
      {
        "number": 122,
        "text": "119:    * **若为 `\"MIRROR_NE/SE/SW/NW\"`**：先按折跃表将 `dir` 折转 $90^\\circ$，再按与 `\"ICE\"` 完全相同的可入性规则检查新方向下一相邻格 `p_next`：可入则滑入 `p_next` 执行 8 步原子序，受阻则停在当前斜坡格上。"
      },
      {
        "number": 123,
        "text": "120:    * **若为 `\"SPRING_U/D/L/R\"`**：将 `dir` 改为弹簧朝向，向该方向逐格探测 $k = 1, 2, 3$（记 `pk = (x1 + k*dx, y1 + k*dy)`）："
      },
      {
        "number": 124,
        "text": "121:      * 阻挡条件：`pk` 为 `HIGH_WALL`、`occupant[pk]` 为 `\"BOX\"` 或 `\"TNT\"`，或者当实体为 `\"BOX\"` 时 `pk` 为勇者坐标或 `\"K1\"/\"K2\"/\"V\"`。"
      },
      {
        "number": 125,
        "text": "122:      * 若在第 $k \\in \\{1, 2, 3\\}$ 格首次遇到阻挡："
      },
      {
        "number": 126,
        "text": "123:        * **特殊交互**：若当前弹射实体为 `\"BOX\"` 且阻挡物为 `\"TNT\"`，将该 `\"TNT\"` 标记为待爆（`tnt_armed.add(pk)`）！"
      },
      {
        "number": 127,
        "text": "124:        * 若 $k == 1$（紧贴阻挡物）：实体留在弹簧原格 `p1`，动量直接终止（不计新位移，绝不重复触发该弹簧）；"
      },
      {
        "number": 128,
        "text": "125:        * 若 $k \\in \\{2, 3\\}$：实体腾空飞越中间格，提前落在 `p_{k-1}`（作为一次从 `p1 -> p_{k-1}` 的成功位移执行 8 步原子序）！"
      },
      {
        "number": 129,
        "text": "126:      * 若 $k = 1, 2, 3$ 均无阻挡：实体腾空飞越 `p_1, p_2`（中间两格不触发任何效果、不加入 `exposed_cells`），直接落在 `p_3`（作为一次从 `p1 -> p_3` 的成功位移执行 8 步原子序）！"
      },
      {
        "number": 130,
        "text": "127:    * **若为 `\"PORTAL_1A/1B/2A/2B\"`**（且非刚从配对端传过来）："
      },
      {
        "number": 131,
        "text": "128:      * 查找其配对门坐标 `p_pair`。检查 `p_pair` 是否可入（`occupant[p_pair]` 为 `None`，且若实体为 `\"BOX\"` 则 `p_pair != (hx, hy)`）。若不可入，留在入口门 `p1` 并终止动量；"
      },
      {
        "number": 132,
        "text": "129:      * 若 `p_pair` 可入：实体传送至 `p_pair`，递增该实体本回合传送计数 `portal_count += 1`，作为一次从 `p1 -> p_pair` 的成功位移执行第 1~7 步；"
      },
      {
        "number": 133,
        "text": "130:      * 在第 8 步到达 `p_pair` 后：**若 `portal_count >= 2`，实体在第二个配对端 `p_pair` 直接停稳，动量终止！** 若 `portal_count == 1`，实体保持进入方向 `dir` 尝试向 `p_pair` 前方相邻格迈出 1 格普通位移（可入则进入下一格并继续根据下一格地形结算，受阻则停在 `p_pair` 上）。"
      },
      {
        "number": 134,
        "text": "131:    * **其余地形（`\"EMPTY\"`, `\"CRACK\"`, `\"SWITCH\"`, 开启的门, `\"K1\"`, `\"K2\"`, `\"V\"` 等）**：普通摩擦地面，实体停稳，动量终止。"
      },
      {
        "number": 135,
        "text": "132: "
      },
      {
        "number": 136,
        "text": "133: ---"
      },
      {
        "number": 137,
        "text": "134: "
      },
      {
        "number": 138,
        "text": "135: ### 3. 单回合 4 阶段主循环（Turn Master Pipeline）"
      },
      {
        "number": 139,
        "text": "136: 每回合（`turn = 1 .. 240`）开始时，初始化 `exposed_cells = {(hx, hy)}`。"
      },
      {
        "number": 140,
        "text": "137: "
      },
      {
        "number": 141,
        "text": "138: #### ▶ 阶段 A & B：起手动作与动量链"
      },
      {
        "number": 142,
        "text": "139: 1. **`\"WAIT\"`**：不移动（不触发脚下离开或进入效果）。"
      },
      {
        "number": 143,
        "text": "140: 2. **`\"BOMB\"`**：若 `hero.bombs > 0` 且当前坐标 `(hx, hy)` 上没有未爆炸弹，则 `hero.bombs -= 1`，在 `bombs` 列表末尾追加 `{\"id\": next_id, \"x\": hx, \"y\": hy, \"timer\": 3}`。否则等效于 `\"WAIT\"`。"
      },
      {
        "number": 144,
        "text": "141: 3. **`\"MOVE_U/D/L/R\"`**：设目标格 `p1 = (hx+dx, hy+dy)`："
      },
      {
        "number": 145,
        "text": "142:    * 若 `p1` 为 `HIGH_WALL` 或 `occupant[p1] == \"TNT\"`：撞墙受阻，留在原地；"
      },
      {
        "number": 146,
        "text": "143:    * 若 `occupant[p1] == \"BOX\"`：检查箱后一格 `p2 = (hx+2*dx, hy+2*dy)` 是否对箱子可入（非 `HIGH_WALL`、`occupant[p2]` 为 `None`、且 `terrain[p2]` 非 `\"K1\"/\"K2\"/\"V\"`）："
      },
      {
        "number": 147,
        "text": "144:      * 若 `p2` 不可入：推箱受阻，勇者留在原地；"
      },
      {
        "number": 148,
        "text": "145:      * 若 `p2` 可入：**先让该 `\"BOX\"`（初始 `steps_taken=0, portal_count=0`）从 `p1 -> p2` 启动并完整跑完箱子的动量链**（期间勇者原格 `(hx, hy)` 视为阻挡箱子的障碍物）。箱子动量链彻底结束后，重新检查 `p1` 格此刻是否对勇者可入（例如箱子可能折返停回 `p1`，或箱子踩了开关把 `p1` 处的门关上了）：仅当 `p1` 此刻对勇者可入时，勇者才（以 `steps_taken=0, portal_count=0`）从 `(hx, hy) -> p1` 迈入并跑完勇者的动量链！（注意：若 `p1` 原本是 `\"CRACK\"`，箱子被推离 `p1` 的瞬间 `p1` 已变为 `\"PIT\"`，勇者紧接着迈入 `p1` 将直接掉入深渊 `-100 HP` 暴毙！）"
      },
      {
        "number": 149,
        "text": "146:    * 若 `p1` 无阻挡且无箱子：勇者直接从 `(hx, hy) -> p1` 迈入并跑完动量链。"
      },
      {
        "number": 150,
        "text": "147: 4. **`\"JUMP_U/D/L/R\"`**："
      },
      {
        "number": 151,
        "text": "148:    * 若 `hero.jumps == 0`：按 `\"WAIT\"` 处理；"
      },
      {
        "number": 152,
        "text": "149:    * 否则先扣减 `hero.jumps -= 1`。设第 1 格 `p1 = (hx+dx, hy+dy)`，第 2 格 `p2 = (hx+2*dx, hy+2*dy)`："
      },
      {
        "number": 153,
        "text": "150:      * **起跳阻挡检查**：若 `p1` 为 `HIGH_WALL`，或者 `p2` 为 `HIGH_WALL`、`\"BOX\"` 或 `\"TNT\"`，则跳跃受阻失败，勇者留在原地（不触发 `p0` 离格，但跳跃次数已扣除）；"
      },
      {
        "number": 154,
        "text": "151:      * **成功腾空跨越**：勇者跃过 `p1`（`p1` 上的任何陷阱/钥匙/深渊均不触发，也不加入 `exposed_cells`），直接作为一次从 `p0 -> p2` 的成功位移（`steps_taken=0, portal_count=0, dir=(dx,dy)`）执行 8 步原子序（注意：`p0` 若为 `\"CRACK\"` 会在第 2 步正常坍塌为 `\"PIT\"`，`p2` 落点正常结算并延续动量）！"
      },
      {
        "number": 155,
        "text": "152: 5. **`\"THROW_U/D/L/R\"`**："
      },
      {
        "number": 156,
        "text": "153:    * 若 `hero.throws == 0`：按 `\"WAIT\"` 处理；"
      },
      {
        "number": 157,
        "text": "154:    * 否则扣减 `hero.throws -= 1`。勇者留在原地，飞石从 `(sx, sy) = (hx, hy)` 沿 `dir = (dx, dy)` 射出，初始空中剩余射程 `range_left = 6`，传送计数 `stone_portals = 0`："
      },
      {
        "number": 158,
        "text": "155:    * **空中飞行循环（当 `range_left > 0`）**："
      },
      {
        "number": 159,
        "text": "156:      * 飞石进入下一相邻格 `pn = (sx+dx, sy+dy)`，消耗 `range_left -= 1`，更新 `(sx, sy) = pn`："
      },
      {
        "number": 160,
        "text": "157:      * 若 `pn` 为 `HIGH_WALL` 或 `occupant[pn] == \"BOX\"`：飞石撞击碎裂，飞行结束；"
      },
      {
        "number": 161,
        "text": "158:      * 若 `occupant[pn] == \"TNT\"`：将该桶标记待爆 `tnt_armed.add(pn)`，飞石碎裂结束；"
      },
      {
        "number": 162,
        "text": "159:      * 若 `terrain[pn] == \"SWITCH\"`：`gates_flipped = not gates_flipped`，飞石碎裂结束；"
      },
      {
        "number": 163,
        "text": "160:      * 若 `terrain[pn] == \"MIMIC\"`：将 `terrain[pn]` 打爆清除为 `\"EMPTY\"`（同步清除其专属线索），飞石碎裂结束；"
      },
      {
        "number": 164,
        "text": "161:      * 若 `terrain[pn]` 为 `\"MIRROR_*\"`：按斜坡四向表折转 `dir`（每进入一格只折转一次），若 `range_left > 0` 继续向新方向飞行；"
      },
      {
        "number": 165,
        "text": "162:      * 若 `terrain[pn]` 为 `\"PORTAL_*\"`（且 `stone_portals < 2`）：检查配对端 `p_pair` 是否无 `\"BOX\"`/`\"TNT\"` 占用；若可入，飞石瞬间移至 `p_pair`（传送本身不额外消耗 `range_left`），`stone_portals += 1`；若 `stone_portals == 2` 则在 `p_pair` 直接停止，否则继续沿 `dir` 消耗剩余射程飞行；"
      },
      {
        "number": 166,
        "text": "163:      * 其余地形（`\"EMPTY\"`, `\"PIT\"`, `\"CRACK\"`, `\"ICE\"`, `\"SPRING_*\"`, `\"HEAL\"`, `\"K1\"`, `\"K2\"`, `\"V\"`）在空中完全透明飞越。"
      },
      {
        "number": 167,
        "text": "164:    * **第 6 格落地滑行延伸**：当 `range_left == 0` 且飞石尚未碎裂时，仅当此刻所在的第 6 格 `terrain[sx][sy]` 为 `\"ICE\"` 或 `\"MIRROR_*\"` 时，飞石转入地面滑行模式（最多滑行 32 步）：每步沿 `dir` 滑入下一格，途中若遇 `HIGH_WALL`/`\"BOX\"` 碎裂，遇 `\"TNT\"`/`\"SWITCH\"`/`\"MIMIC\"` 触发对应效果后碎裂，遇 `\"MIRROR_*\"` 折转继续滑，遇 `\"ICE\"` 继续滑，遇 `\"PORTAL_*\"` 按剩余传送次数传送，滑入任何其他地形（如 `\"EMPTY\"`, `\"PIT\"`, `\"CRACK\"`, `\"SPRING_*\"`）立即停下消失。"
      },
      {
        "number": 168,
        "text": "165: "
      },
      {
        "number": 169,
        "text": "166: #### ▶ 阶段 C：定时炸弹倒计时与链式爆炸闭包"
      },
      {
        "number": 170,
        "text": "167: 1. 全场现有 `bombs` 中的每颗炸弹 `timer -= 1`；"
      },
      {
        "number": 171,
        "text": "168: 2. 收集初始爆源集合：所有 `timer == 0` 的 `BOMB` 以及本回合阶段 A/B 中被加入 `tnt_armed` 的 `\"TNT\"`；"
      },
      {
        "number": 172,
        "text": "169: 3. 若存在初始爆源，执行 **同批链式爆炸 BFS**："
      },
      {
        "number": 173,
        "text": "170:    * 设爆源队列 `Q`，对每个爆源 `(ex, ey)`，其波及范围为切比雪夫距离 $\\le 1$ 的九宫格（$|x - ex| \\le 1$ 且 $|y - ey| \\le 1$，注：钛金墙 `\"T_W\"` 自身免疫爆炸，但不遮挡同一九宫格内的对角格）。"
      },
      {
        "number": 174,
        "text": "171:    * 若九宫格内存在其他尚未引爆的 `\"TNT\"` 或尚未引爆的 `BOMB`（无论其 `timer` 是多少），立即将其加入 `Q` 在同一批次内链式引爆（每个爆源唯一计数，单批次只爆一次）。"
      },
      {
        "number": 175,
        "text": "172: 4. **伤害与地形合并结算（基于批次快照）**："
      },
      {
        "number": 176,
        "text": "173:    * 统计波及勇者当前坐标 `(hx, hy)` 的所有爆源：每颗波及勇者的 `\"TNT\"` 计机关名义伤害 $+60$，每颗波及勇者的 `BOMB` 计勇者自伤 $+50$。设本批机关名义总伤害为 $a$，自伤总和为 $b$，结算前勇者血量为 $h$："
      },
      {
        "number": 177,
        "text": "174:      * 若 $a + b > 0$，累加本批有效机关伤害 $\\Delta D = \\min(h, a + b) \\times \\frac{a}{a + b}$，随后扣减勇者血量 `hp -= (a + b)`。"
      },
      {
        "number": 178,
        "text": "175:    * 移除所有已引爆的 `BOMB` 与 `\"TNT\"`；"
      },
      {
        "number": 179,
        "text": "176:    * 对所有爆源九宫格并集内的每个格子 `(cx, cy)`："
      },
      {
        "number": 180,
        "text": "177:      * 若 `occupant[cy][cx] == \"BOX\"`：箱子被炸毁（`occupant[cy][cx] = None`）；"
      },
      {
        "number": 181,
        "text": "178:      * 检查 `terrain[cy][cx]`："
      },
      {
        "number": 182,
        "text": "179:        * `\"T_W\"`, `\"K1\"`, `\"K2\"`, `\"V\"`, `\"PORTAL_1A/1B/2A/2B\"`, `\"PIT\"`：**绝对免疫，保持不变**；"
      },
      {
        "number": 183,
        "text": "180:        * `\"CRACK\"`：**被炸断直接坍塌变为 `\"PIT\"`**；"
      },
      {
        "number": 184,
        "text": "181:        * `\"W\"`, `\"ICE\"`, `\"MIRROR_*\"`, `\"SPRING_*\"`, `\"LASER_*\"`, `\"SWITCH\"`, `\"R_GATE\"`, `\"B_GATE\"`, `\"HEAL\"`, `\"MIMIC\"`：**被炸毁变为 `\"EMPTY\"`**（若为 `\"MIMIC\"` 同步清除其专属线索）。"
      },
      {
        "number": 185,
        "text": "182:    * **爆炸后支撑检查**："
      },
      {
        "number": 186,
        "text": "183:      * 若某未被炸毁的 `\"BOX\"` 脚下地形因爆炸变成了 `\"PIT\"`，该箱子立即填坑同归于尽（`occupant = None, terrain = \"EMPTY\"`）；"
      },
      {
        "number": 187,

      {
        "number": 208,
        "text": "205: ## 四、 双榜计分数学公式与经济博弈指南"
      },
      {
        "number": 209,
        "text": "206: "
      },
      {
        "number": 210,
        "text": "207: 设魔王建图花费为 $C_{\\text{spent}} \\in [0, 3000]$，金库留存比例为 $g = \\frac{3000 - C_{\\text{spent}}}{3000} \\in [0.0, 1.0]$；设整局累计有效机关伤害为 $D = \\min(100.0, \\sum \\Delta D_{\\text{trap}}) \\in [0.0, 100.0]$，勇者最终已拾取钥匙数为 $k \\in \\{0, 1, 2\\}$，当前阶段推进比为 $r = \\max\\!\\left(0.0, \\frac{d_0 - d_{\\min}}{\\max(1, d_0)}\\right) \\in [0.0, 1.0)$，连续总进度 $P = k + r \\in [0.0, 3.0)$。"
      },

        "number": 211,
        "text": "208: "
      },

        "number": 212,
        "text": "209: ### 1. 🗡️ 勇者单局得分 $Score_{\\text{Hero}}$（`0 ~ 1000` 连续线性分布）"

        "text": "210: * **【存活通关】（耗时 $T \\in [1, 240]$ 回合）**："

        "text": "211:   $$Score_{\\text{Hero}} = 600 + 1.5 \\times HP_{\\text{left}} + 150 \\times \\frac{240 - T}{239} + 100 \\times g$$"
      },

        "number": 215,
        "text": "212: * **【闯关失败】（阵亡或满 240 回合超时，三阶段连续线性推进）**："
      },
      {
        "number": 216,
        "text": "213:   $$Score_{\\text{Hero}} = 200 \\times k + 200 \\times r = 200 \\times P$$"
      },
      {
        "number": 217,
        "text": "214:   *(其中 0 钥阶段占 `0~200` 分、1 钥阶段占 `200~400` 分、2 钥阶段占 `400~600` 分，无缝衔接存活通关的 `600` 分底线。距离采样仅在勇者取得第 $k$ 把钥匙之后的阶段内进行：$d_0$ 为该阶段起点距下一目标的曼哈顿距离，$d_{\\min}$ 为该阶段内勇者所有实际到达点距下一目标的最小曼哈顿距离；0 钥阶段下一目标距离定义为 $\\min(\\text{dist}(K_1), \\text{dist}(K_2))$，1 钥阶段为距剩余钥匙距离，2 钥阶段为距 `V` 距离。)*"

        "number": 218,
        "text": "215: "
      },
      {
        "number": 219,
        "text": "216: ### 2. 🏰 魔王单局得分 $Score_{\\text{Demon}}$（`0 ~ 1000` 连续线性分布）"

      },

        "number": 221,
        "text": "218:   $$Score_{\\text{Demon (Kill)}} = 500 + 50 \\times (3 - P) + D + 250 \\times g$$"

      {
        "number": 222,
        "text": "219: * **情况 B：【困死超时勇者】（满 240 回合但勇者 `HP > 0` 存活 —— 基础分与金库暴利折减！）**："

        "number": 223,
        "text": "220:   $$Score_{\\text{Demon (Timeout)}} = 320 + 50 \\times (3 - P) + D + 125 \\times g$$"

      {
        "number": 224,
        "text": "221: * **情况 C：【金库失守】（被勇者存活通关 —— 按造成机关伤害与拖延回合连续计分，金库留存归零）**："

## 2026-11-19T20:18:59.185000+09:00 | reasoning | <LOCAL_USER_HOME>\.dsh\sessions\--REPO-part2_full-exam_rooms-P2_07_deepseek_dsh--\session-a11cda84-af09-4635-97b0-2a5db66db350\session.v4.jsonl.zstd decompressed_line=183 seq=181

Excellent! This is the complete v2.1 referee spec. The v2.2 rules add PLATE/P_GATE/LASER2/ONEWAY. The v2.2 rules doc gives the new mechanics semantics. Combining them gives me a near-complete simulator.

Key missing details for v2.2:
- PLATE: terrain layer, only BOX occupant activates. So PLATE is a terrain tile; when a BOX's occupant sits on it, that plate is "pressed". plates_active = (at least 1 PLATE exists) and (all PLATE have occupant == "BOX").
- P_GATE: high wall when not plates_active. Immune to explosion (防爆免疫).
- LASER2: fires at turn%4==0, period=4. Red at turn%3==0.
- ONEWAY: entities can only enter along arrow direction; lasers and airborne stones pass through all directions.

Also v2.2: BOX limit 6, PLATE 4, P_GATE 8, ONEWAY 12, red+blue total 12.

Additional v2.2 details I need to nail:
1. Phase D trigger: `turn % 3 == 0 or turn % 4 == 0`.
2. At turn % 12 == 0 both fire simultaneously based on the same snapshot after phase C.
3. laser_warnings include period and cannon.
4. Damage: 50 per cannon hitting (each laser cannon that intersects exposed_cells).
5. ONEWAY blocks hero and box only when entering against direction. `blocks_oneway(x,y,dir)` true iff terrain is ONEWAY_<d> and dir != DIR_VECTORS[d].

Important: does ONEWAY block entering the cell only, or also allow moving out freely? "勇者与箱子只许顺箭头方向进入" — only entry direction matters. Leaving is free.

What about BOX push: pushing box into a reverse ONEWAY → whole action rejected, box doesn't move, CRACK doesn't collapse. And hero entering p1 must also satisfy oneway check.

Now, also the "spawn 4-turn admission": at least 2 distinct Turn-1 end coordinates with zero machinery damage survival, each with an action sequence surviving to turn 4 with zero machinery damage. That means no damage at all in turns 1-4 (including laser/plate/etc). Note: "零机关伤害" — zero machinery damage. So HEAL is fine; MIMIC damage is machinery damage (no).

Wait, careful: at turn 3, red lasers fire; turn 4, blue lasers fire. So the admission requires that from spawn, at least 2 different turn-1 endpoints, each having a zero-damage path surviving to end of turn 4. This means my dungeon must not have lasers covering the spawn area in a way that forces damage. Actually lasers can cover as long as there are safe spots.

Important design consideration: The demon score. For CLEARED: 1.7*D + 150*(T-1)/239, max 320. For DEAD: 500 + 50*(3-P) + D + 250*g. For TIMEOUT: 320 + 50*(3-P) + D + 125*g.

So killing the hero is much better than timeout: DEAD gives 500+ vs 320+. And cheaper dungeons (higher g) give 250*g. With budget C, g = (3000-C)/3000.

Hmm interesting: so a cheap dungeon that kills gives 500 + 50*(3-P) + D + 250*g — with C=0, g=1 → 500+150+100+250 = 1000 max. But a trivial empty dungeon won't kill.

Wait: real kill requires D >= 100 basically (hp 100). DEAD with P=0 → 500 + 150 + 100 + 250*g. With g=0.75 (C=750) → 500+150+100+187.5 = 937.5. That matches my part1 score of 932.17 with 745G.

Actually for part1 my score was 932.17 = ... yes.

For v2.2 CLEARED cap is 320. So the key strategic question: how to make a dungeon that kills most/all opponents within 200-step author proof, while keeping D=100 and low cost? Since FULL mode means full visibility, the opponent solvers will be strong; killing is hard.

Alternative: TIMEOUT (hero survives 240 turns but doesn't clear): 320 + 50*(3-P) + D + 125*g. With P=0 (no keys), that's 320+150+D+125g. If D=0 and g=1 (C=0): 470. Hmm, that's not bad but requires the hero to be stuck forever.

The best is a kill: 500 + 50*(3-P) + D + 250*g. With g≈0.75 and D=100 and P=0: 937.5.

But actually P is hero progress at death: k + r. If they die at turn 1 with no keys, P=0 → +150.

So a cheap and lethal trap = high score. The v2.2 admission rule forbids spawn-kill for turns 1-4. But after that, we can make a deathtrap at the first choke.

Now note the "零和" scoring for CLEARED: 1.7*D + 150*(T-1)/239 ≤ 320. So if the hero clears fast (T small) and D small, demon gets near 0. That's the risk.

Given that the opponents in the actual tournament are other LLMs with their own solvers, and FULL mode with 2s turn-1 search + 0.5s per turn, a good human-designed puzzle could stop many. But since the scoring now makes a strong "one clean deadly choke" more valuable...

Let me think about what makes a good v2.2 dungeon under FULL visibility:

Strategy A ("Plate-gate vault lock"): Make V accessible only through P_GATE, requiring BOX on PLATE. Hero has no box-carry. But if there's a BOX near the plate and P_GATE gate blocks V, hero must push box onto plate. That's a solvable puzzle for a good solver, but many will fail. Strategy B ("Dual-frequency laser corridor + 12-beat death"): A one-way corridor where the only path passes through a laser kill zone where at turn 12k both red and blue lasers cross → 100 damage instant kill. def _is_high_wall(self, x, y):
    t = self.terrain[y][x]
    if t in HIGH_WALL_BASE: return True   # W, T_W, LASER_*, LASER2_*
    if t == "R_GATE": return not self.gates_flipped
    if t == "B_GATE": return self.gates_flipped
    if t == "P_GATE": return not self.plates_active()
    return False

def plates_active(self):
    found = False
    for (x,y) in self.plate_cells:
        found = True
        if self.occ[y][x] != "BOX": return False
    return found

\\\"U\\\", \\\"ONEWAY_D\\\": \\\"D\\\", \\\"ONEWAY_L\\\": \\\"L\\\", \\\"ONEWAY_R\\\": \\\"R\\\"}\\n\\nTILE_COST = {\\n    \\\"EMPTY\\\": 0, \\\"K1\\\": 0, \\\"K2\\\": 0, \\\"V\\\": 0,\\n    \\\"W\\\": 5, \\\"T_W\\\": 25, \\\"ICE\\\": 10,\\n    \\\"MIRROR_NE\\\": 25, \\\"MIRROR_SE\\\": 25, \\\"MIRROR_SW\\\": 25, \\\"MIRROR_NW\\\": 25,\\n    \\\"SPRING_U\\\": 35, \\\"SPRING_D\\\": 35, \\\"SPRING_L\\\": 35, \\\"SPRING_R\\\": 35,\\n    \\\"PIT\\\": 40, \\\"CRACK\\\": 20, \\\"SWITCH\\\": 30, \\\"R_GATE\\\": 20, \\\"B_GATE\\\": 20,\\n    \\\"PLATE\\\": 45, \\\"P_GATE\\\": 30,\\n    \\\"LASER_U\\\": 75, \\\"LASER_D\\\": 75, \\\"LASER_L\\\": 75, \\\"LASER_R\\\": 75,\\n    \\\"LASER2_U\\\": 90, \\\"LASER2_D\\\": 90, \\\"LASER2_L\\\": 90, \\\"LASER2_R\\\": 90,\\n \\\"T_W\\\", \\\"K1\\\", \\\"K2\\\", \\\"V\\\", \\\"PIT\\\",\\n    \\\"PORTAL_1A\\\", \\\"PORTAL_1B\\\", \\\"PORTAL_2A\\\", \\\"PORTAL_2B\\\",\\n    \\\"PLATE\\\", \\\"P_GATE\\\",\\n    \\\"ONEWAY_U\\\", \\\"ONEWAY_D\\\", \\\"ONEWAY_L\\\", \\\"ONEWAY_R\\\",\\n))\\n# 被炸毁 -> EMPTY\\nBLAST_WIPE = frozenset((\\n    \\\"W\\\", \\\"ICE\\\", \\\"SWITCH\\\", \\\"R_GATE\\\", \\\"B_GATE\\\", \\\"HEAL\\\", \\\"MIMIC\\\",\\n    \\\"MIRROR_NE\\\", \\\"MIRROR_SE\\\", \\\"MIRROR_SW\\\", \\\"MIRROR_NW\\\",\\n    \\\"SPRING_U\\\", \\\"SPRING_D\\\", \\\"SPRING_L\\\", \\\"SPRING_R\\\",\\n    \\\"LASER_U\\\", \\\"LASER_D\\\", \\\"LASER_L\\\", \\\"LASER_R\\\",\\n    \\\"LASER2_U\\\", \\\"LASER2_D\\\", \\\"LASER2_L\\\", \\\"LASER2_R\\\",\\n))\\n\\n\\n# =============================================================================\\n# 合法性校验\\n# =============================================================================\\n\\ndef validate_dungeon(grid):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"返回 (ok, errors, info)。info 含 spent_gold / vault_gold / 各类计数。\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    errs = []\\n    info = {}\\n    if not isinstance(grid, (list, tuple)) or len(grid) != H:\\n        return False, [\\\"grid 行数必须为 26\\\"], info\\n    for y in range(H):\\n        row = grid[y]\\n        if not isinstance(row, (list, tuple)) or len(row) != W:\\n            return False, [\\\"grid[%d] 列数必须为 40\\\" % y], info\\n\\n    counts = {}\\n    spent = 0\\n    for y in range(H):\\n        for x in range(W):\\n            t = grid[y][x]\\n            if not isinstance(t, str) or t not in TILE_COST:\\n                errs.append(\\\"非法组件 %r @ (%d,%d)\\\" % (t, x, y))\\n                continue\\n            counts[t] = counts.get(t, 0) + 1\\n            if x in (0, W - 1) or y in (0, H - 1):\\n                if t != \\\"T_W\\\":\\n                    errs.append(\\\"外框 (%d,%d) 必须为 T_W，实为 %s\\\" % (x, y, t))\\n            else:\\n                spent += TILE_COST[t]\\n\\n    # 出生净空区\\n    for (x, y) in SPAWN_ZONE:\\n        if grid[y][x] != \\\"EMPTY\\\":\\n            errs.append(\\\"出生净空区 (%d,%d) 必须为 EMPTY，实为 %s\\\" % (x, y, grid[y][x]))\\n\\n    # 地标\\n    def _find(tile):\\n        return [(x, y) for y in range(1, H - 1) for x in range(1, W - 1) if grid[y][x] == tile]\\n\\n    k1 = _find(\\\"K1\\\")\\n    k2 = _find(\\\"K2\\\")\\n    vv = _find(\\\"V\\\")\\n    if len(k1) != 1:\\n        errs.append(\\\"K1 必须恰 1 个，实为 %d\\\" % len(k1))\\n    if len(k2) != 1:\\n        errs.append(\\\"K2 必须恰 1 个，实为 %d\\\" % len(k2))\\n    if len(vv) != 1:\\n        errs.append(\\\"V 必须恰 1 个，实为 %d\\\" % len(vv))\\n    if len(k1) == 1:\\n        x, y = k1[0]\\n        if not (12 <= x <= 34 and 2 <= y <= 10):\\n            errs.append(\\\"K1 坐标 (%d,%d) 越界\\\" % (x, y))\\n    if len(k2) == 1:\\n        x, y = k2[0]\\n        if not (12 <= x <= 34 and 15 <= y <= 23):\\n            errs.append(\\\"K2 坐标 (%d,%d) 越界\\\" % (x, y))\\n    if len(k1) == 1 and len(k2) == 1:\\n        d = abs(k1[0][0] - k2[0][0]) + abs(k1[0][1] - k2[0][1])\\n        if d < 12:\\n            errs.append(\\\"K1/K2 曼哈顿距离 %d < 12\\\" % d)\\n        info[\\\"key_dist\\\"] = d\\n    if len(vv) == 1:\\n        x, y = vv[0]\\n        if not (33 <= x <= 37 and 4 <= y <= 21):\\n            errs.append(\\\"V 坐标 (%d,%d) 越界\\\" % (x, y))\\n\\n    # 内圈配额\\n    def inner(tile):\\n        return sum(1 for y in range(1, H - 1) for x in range(1, W - 1) if grid[y][x] == tile)\\n\\n    def group(tiles):\\n        return sum(counts.get(t, 0) for t in tiles)\\n\\n    limits = {\\n        \\\"T_W(inner)\\\": (inner(\\\"T_W\\\"), 120),\\n        \\\"MIRROR*\\\": (group(MIRROR_FOLD), 30),\\n        \\\"SPRING*\\\": (group(SPRING_DIR), 20),\\n        \\\"LASER*+LASER2*\\\": (group(LASER_TILES) + group(LASER2_TILES), 12),\\n        \\\"CRACK\\\": (counts.get(\\\"CRACK\\\", 0), 40),\\n        \\\"SWITCH\\\": (counts.get(\\\"SWITCH\\\", 0), 6),\\n        \\\"R_GATE+B_GATE\\\": (counts.get(\\\"R_GATE\\\", 0) + counts.get(\\\"B_GATE\\\", 0), 16),\\n        \\\"PLATE\\\": (counts.get(\\\"PLATE\\\", 0), 4),\\n        \\\"P_GATE\\\": (counts.get(\\\"P_GATE\\\", 0), 8),\\n        \\\"ONEWAY*\\\": (group(ONEWAY_TILES), 12),\\n        \\\"TNT\\\": (counts.get(\\\"TNT\\\", 0), 12),\\n        \\\"BOX\\\": (counts.get(\\\"BOX\\\", 0), 6),\\n        \\\"HEAL\\\": (counts.get(\\\"HEAL\\\", 0), 4),\\n        \\\"MIMIC\\\": (counts.get(\\\"MIMIC\\\", 0), 4),\\n    }\\n    for k, (have, cap) in limits.items():\\n        if have > cap:\\n            errs.append(\\\"配额超限 %s: %d > %d\\\" % (k, have, cap))\\n        info[k] = have\\n\\n    # 传送门成对\\n    for a, b in ((\\\"PORTAL_1A\\\", \\\"PORTAL_1B\\\"), (\\\"PORTAL_2A\\\", \\\"PORTAL_2B\\\")):\\n        if counts.get(a, 0) != counts.get(b, 0):\\n            errs.append(\\\"传送门 %s/%s 未成对\\\" % (a, b))\\n        if counts.get(a, 0) > 1 or counts.get(b, 0) > 1:\\n            errs.append(\\\"传送门 %s/%s 同编号重复\\\" % (a, b))\\n\\n    # 压板硬约束\\n    if counts.get(\\\"P_GATE\\\", 0) > 0:\\n        p = counts.get(\\\"PLATE\\\", 0)\\n        b = counts.get(\\\"BOX\\\", 0)\\n        if not (1 <= p <= b):\\n            errs.append(\\\"使用 P_GATE 必须满足 1 <= PLATE(%d) <= BOX(%d)\\\" % (p, b))\\n\\n    if spent > MAX_BUDGET:\\n        errs.append(\\\"预算超限 %d > %d\\\" % (spent, MAX_BUDGET))\\n\\n    info[\\\"spent_gold\\\"] = spent\\n    info[\\\"vault_gold\\\"] = MAX_BUDGET - spent\\n    info[\\\"g\\\"] = (MAX_BUDGET - spent) / MAX_BUDGET\\n    info[\\\"counts\\\"] = counts\\n    return (len(errs) == 0), errs, info\\n\\n\\ndef bind_clues(grid):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"按官方行优先顺序为每个 MIMIC 绑定专属骸骨线索格。返回 (clues, mimic_binding, errs)。\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    terrain = [[(\\\"EMPTY\\\" if grid[y][x] in (\\\"BOX\\\", \\\"TNT\\\") else grid[y][x]) for x in range(W)] for y in range(H)]\\n    occ = [[(grid[y][x] if grid[y][x] in (\\\"BOX\\\", \\\"TNT\\\") else None) for x in range(W)] for y in range(H)]\\n    clues = [[False] * W for _ in range(H)]\\n    binding = {}\\n    errs = []\\n    chests = set()\\n    for y in range(H):\\n        for x in range(W):\\n            if grid[y][x] in (\\\"HEAL\\\", \\\"MIMIC\\\"):\\n                chests.add((x, y))\\n    for y in range(H):\\n        for x in range(W):\\n            if grid[y][x] != \\\"MIMIC\\\":\\n                continue\\n            best = None\\n            for dx, dy in ((0, -1), (0, 1), (-1, 0), (1, 0)):\\n                nx, ny = x + dx, y + dy\\n                if not (0 <= nx < W and 0 <= ny < H):\\n                    continue\\n                if terrain[ny][nx] != \\\"EMPTY\\\" or occ[ny][nx] is not None:\\n                    continue\\n                if 1 <= nx <= 3 and 12 <= ny <= 14:\\n                    continue\\n                if clues[ny][nx]:\\n                    continue\\n                # 该格四邻中不得存在除当前 MIMIC 外的其他宝箱\\n                bad = False\\n                for ddx, ddy in ((0, -1), (0, 1), (-1, 0), (1, 0)):\\n                    px, py = nx + ddx, ny + ddy\\n                    if (px, py) in chests and (px, py) != (x, y):\\n                        bad = True\\n                        break\\n                if bad:\\n                    continue\\n                best = (nx, ny)\\n                break\\n            if best is None:\\n                errs.append(\\\"MIMIC@(%d,%d) 找不到合法专属线索格\\\" % (x, y))\\n            else:\\n                clues[best[1]][best[0]] = True\\n                binding[(x, y)] = best\\n    return clues, binding, errs\\n\\n\\n# =============================================================================\\n# 计分\\n# =============================================================================\\n\\ndef hero_score(cleared, turns, hp_left, keys, progress_p, g):\\n    if cleared:\\n        return 600.0 + 1.5 * max(0, hp_left) + 150.0 * (MAX_TURNS - turns) / 239.0 + 100.0 * g\\n    return 200.0 * progress_p\\n\\n\\ndef demon_score(outcome, turns, damage, progress_p, g):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"outcome in {DEAD, TIMEOUT, CLEARED, DQ}\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    D = min(100.0, damage)\\n    if outcome == \\\"DEAD\\\":\\n        return 500.0 + 50.0 * (3.0 - progress_p) + D + 250.0 * g\\n    if outcome in (\\\"TIMEOUT\\\", \\\"DQ\\\"):\\n        return 320.0 + 50.0 * (3.0 - progress_p) + D + 125.0 * g\\n    # CLEARED\\n    return 1.7 * D + 150.0 * (turns - 1) / 239.0\\n\\n\\n# =============================================================================\\n# 裁判内核\\n# =============================================================================\\n\\nclass Judge:\\n    def __init__(self, grid, seed=20261115):\\n        self.grid0 = [list(r) for r in grid]\\n        self.terrain = [[(\\\"EMPTY\\\" if self.grid0[y][x] in (\\\"BOX\\\", \\\"TNT\\\") else self.grid0[y][x])\\n                         for x in range(W)] for y in range(H)]\\n        self.occ = [[(self.grid0[y][x] if self.grid0[y][x] in (\\\"BOX\\\", \\\"TNT\\\") else None)\\n                     for x in range(W)] for y in range(H)]\\n        self.clues, self.mimic_binding, _e = bind_clues(self.grid0)\\n        self.plate_cells = [(x, y) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if self.terrain[y][x] == \\\"PLATE\\\"]\\n        self.pair_pos = {}\\n        for y in range(H):\\n            for x in range(W):\\n                t = self.terrain[y][x]\\n                if t in PORTALS:\\n                    self.pair_pos[t] = (x, y)\\n        self.turn = 0\\n        self.hero = {\\\"x\\\": SPAWN[0], \\\"y\\\": SPAWN[1], \\\"hp\\\": 100,\\n                     \\\"keys\\\": [False, False], \\\"jumps\\\": 3, \\\"throws\\\": 3, \\\"bombs\\\": 2}\\n        self.gates_flipped = False\\n        self.bombs = {}          # (x,y) -> timer\\n        self.damage_total = 0.0  # 累计有效机关伤害（用于 D）\\n        self.exposed = set()\\n        self.tnt_armed = set()\\n        self.status =     self._p0_progress = None\\n        self.progress = 0.0\\n        self.max_progress = 0.0\\n        self._stage_start = None\\n\\n    # ---------------- 基础查询 ----------------\\n    def inside(self, x, y):\\n        return 0 <= x < W and 0 <= y < H\\n\\n    def plates_active(self):\\n        if not self.plate_cells:\\n            return False\\n        for (x, y) in self.plate_cells:\\n            if self.occ[y][x] != \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                return False\\n        return True\\n\\n    def is_high_wall(self, x, y):\\n        t = self.terrain[y][x]\\n        if t in HIGH_WALL_STATIC:\\n            return True\\n        if t == \\\"R_GATE\\\":\\n            return not self.gates_flipped\\n        if t == \\\"B_GATE\\\":\\n            return self.gates_flipped\\n        if t == \\\"P_GATE\\\":\\n            return not self.plates_active()\\n        return False\\n\\n    def blocks_oneway(self, x, y, dirv):\\n        t = self.terrain[y][x]\\n        d = ONEWAY_TILES.get(t)\\n        if d is None:\\n            return False\\n        return dirv != DIRV[d]\\n\\n    def _trap(self, amt, kind, pos):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"机关伤害：累计有效机关伤害 min(hp, amt)。\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        eff = min(self.hero[\\\"hp\\\"], amt)\\n        self.damage_total += eff\\n        self.hero[\\\"hp\\\"] -= amt\\n        self.events.append(\\\"T%d:%s %s @(%d,%d) HP->%d\\\" % (\\n            self.turn, \\\"BOX\\\":\\n            if box_avoid_hero and (x, y) == (self.hero[\\\"x\\\"], self.hero[\\\"y\\\"]):\\n                return False\\n            if self.terrain[y][x] in (\\\"K1\\\", \\\"K2\\\", _move_entity(self, kind, p0, p1, dirv):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"kind: 'HERO' / 'BOX'。返回是否通关/死亡（已写入 self.status）。\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        steps = 0\\n        portal_count = 0\\n        suppress = False\\n        stop_momentum = False\\n        while True:\\n            steps += 1\\n            # 2. 离开钩子\\n            if self.terrain[p0[1]][p0[0]] == \\\"CRACK\\\":\\n                self.terrain[p0[1]][p0[0]] = \\\"PIT\\\"\\n                self.events.append(\\\"T%d:裂板坍塌@(%d,%d)\\\" % (self.turn, p0[0], p0[1]))\\n            # 3. 更新坐标\\n            if kind == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                self.occ[p0[1]][p0[0]] = None\\n                self.occ[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"BOX\\\"\\n            else:\\n                self.hero[\\\"x\\\"], self.hero[\\\"y\\\"] = p1\\n self.occ[p1[1]][p1[0]] = None\\n                    self.terrain[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n                    stop_momentum = True\\n                    self.events.append(\\\"T%d:箱子填坑@(%d,%d)\\\" % (self.turn, p1[0], p1[1]))\\n                elif t1 == \\\"MIMIC\\\":\\n                    self.terrain[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n          elif t1 == \\\"MIMIC\\\":\\n                    self._trap(45, \\\"MIMIC\\\", p1)\\n                    self.terrain[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n                    self._clear_clue(p1)\\n                    stop_momentum = True\\n                elif t1 == \\\"HEAL\\\":\\n                    self.hero[\\\"hp\\\"] = min(100, self.hero[\\\"hp\\\"] + 30)\\n (self.turn, p1[0], p1[1]))\\n            # 5. 死亡截断\\n            if kind == \\\"HERO\\\" and self.hero[\\\"hp\\\"] <= 0:\\n                self.status = \\\"DEAD\\\"\\n                return True\\n            # 6. 钥匙 / 通关\\n            if kind == \\\"HERO\\\":\\n                if t1 == \\\"K1\\\":\\n                    self.hero[\\\"keys\\\"][0] = True\\n                    self.terrain[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n                    self.events.append(\\\"T%d:拾取K1@(%d,%d)\\\" % (self.turn, p1[0], p1[1]))\\n                    self._note_progress()\\n                elif t1 == \\\"K2\\\":\\n                    self.hero[\\\"keys\\\"][1] = True\\n                    self.terrain[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n                    self.events.append(\\\"T%d:拾取K2@(%d,%d)\\\" % (self.turn, p1[0], p1[1]))\\n                    self._note_progress()\\n                elif t1 == \\\"V\\\" and self.hero[\\\"keys\\\"][0] and Full state with 6 boxes is too big for generic search. But most maps need either 0 boxes (plain route) or specific box pushes.

Design: use a hierarchical planner:
- Phase 1: try hero-only search (boxes = static obstacles) for the sequence K1 → K2 → V (with both orders), where the requirement is to reach each target. If it succeeds within budget, use that plan.
- Phase 2: if the hero-only search fails, do a box-aware search. To keep it tractable: search over the same state plus a set of "box-relevant goals" — e.g., if P_GATE blocks and PLATE exists, plan to push a box onto each PLATE. That's a sub-plan: find a box, find a push sequence to the plate.

Given the complexity, maybe a better solver architecture: a general best-first search over the full game state (hero pos, keys, gates, boxes, plate, turn-phase), with a good heuristic and a node budget, and — crucially — using *macro-actions* (move-to with a path) to reduce depth. That's essentially what I'd do:

- Actions: instant actions (MOVE dir ×4, WAIT, JUMP ×4, THROW?, BOMB?). BOMB is expensive/rare. THROW is mostly for switches; can be added as a special action.

State space: 1040 * 12 * 4 * 2 * (box positions combos) — box positions: 6 boxes but usually 1-4 relevant. With 4 boxes on ~1000 cells, that's astronomically large. But in practice boxes barely move. The reachable box configs from pushes are limited.

Practical compromise:

- If it has PLATE/P_GATE: do a targeted sub-search: "push a specific box onto a specific plate" — a mini Sokoban solver (state: box pos + hero pos, BFS). Then chain: route to box, push to plate, then route onward (re-evaluating P_GATE as open once all plates are pressed).

### Model extraction
From state: terrain (26x40 strings, with CHEST), occupant, clues, hero, gates_flipped, plates_active, turn, laser_warnings.

Deduce: CHEST + adjacent clue → MIMIC else HEAL.

### Static analysis
- `blocked(x,y)` for hero: high wall (W,T_W,LASER*,LASER2*, closed gates incl P_GATE when not active), PIT (lethal), MIMIC (lethal-ish).
- ONEWAY per direction.

### Mission planner
Missions:
1. `KEYS`: order [K1,K2] or [K2,K1].
2. `PLATES`: box pushes.
3. `PITS`: box fill.
4. `TNTS`: trigger.

Sequence heuristics:
- Start: try [K1,K2,V] and [K2,K1,V] with the current passability (P_GATE open only if plates_active).
- If V is unreachable → if P_GATE exists and not active → plan PLATE missions (all plates), then re-try.
- If a key is unreachable → check why: if a TNT+wall encloses it, plan a TNT mission; retry.
- If V still unreachable → look for pits on the way: plan pit fills.

Each mission returns an action list; the planner concatenates and returns the final action sequence.

Because the world changes as we go (boxes move, TNT explodes), after each mission I re-plan from a *simulated* state. To simulate, I need a forward simulator in submission.py matching the judge. I'll write a compact one.

Plan: 
```
def plan_all(model, state):
    sim = Sim(model, state)   # mutable copy
    plan = []
    missions = decide_mission_sequence(sim)  # iterative
    while not done and time left:
        m = next mission
        act_list = plan_mission(sim, m)
        if act_list is None: fail
        plan += act_list; sim.apply(act_list)
    return plan
```

That's clean. And `decide_action` just executes the plan (with validation: compare the observed state with the simulated expected state; if mismatch → replan).

\\\"exposed\\\", \\\"tnt_armed\\\")\\n\\n    def __init__(self, ter, occ, hero, gates):\\n        self.ter = [row[:] for row in ter]\\n        self.occ = [row[:] for row in occ]\\n        self.hx = = hero[7]\\n        self.gates = bool(gates)\\n        self.dmg = 0.0\\n        self.status = None\\n        self.exposed = set()\\n        self.tnt_armed = set()\\n\\n    # ---- 查询 ----\\n    def inside(self, x, y):\\n        return 0 <= x < GRID_W and 0 <= y < GRID_H\\n\\n    def plates_active(self):\\n        found = False\\n        for y in range(1, GRID_H - 1):\\n            row = self.ter[y]\\n            for x in range(1, GRID_W - 1):\\n                if row[x] == \\\"PLATE\\\":\\n                    found = True\\n                    if self.occ[y][x] != \\\"BOX\\\":\\n \\\"R_GATE\\\":\\n            return not self.gates\\n        if t == \\\"B_GATE\\\":\\n            return self.gates\\n        if t == \\\"P_GATE\\\":\\n            return not self.plates_active()\\n        return False\\n\\n    def blocks_oneway(self, x, y, dirv):\\n        d = ONEWAY_DIR.get(self.ter[y][x])\\n        if d is None:\\n            return False\\n        return dirv != DIRV[d]\\n\\n    def _trap(self, amt):\\n        self.dmg += min(self.hp, amt)\\n        self.hp -= amt\\n\\n    def _can_enter(self, x, y, dirv, kind):\\n        if not self.inside(x, y):\\n            return False\\n        if self.high_wall(x, y):\\n            return False\\n        o = self.occ[y][x]\\n        if o == \\\"BOX\\\" or o == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n            return False\\n        if kind == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n            if (x, y) == (self.hx, self.hy):\\n                return False\\n            if self.ter[y][x] in (\\\"K1\\\", \\\"K2\\\", \\\"V\\\"):\\n                return False\\n        if self.blocks_oneway(x, y, dirv):\\n            return False\\n        return True\\n\\n    # ---- 8 步原子位移 ----\\n    def _move_entity(self, kind, p0, p1, dirv):\\n        steps = 0\\n        portal_count = 0\\n        suppress = False\\n        stop_momentum = False\\n        while True:\\n            steps += 1\\n            if self.ter[p0[1]][p0[0]] == \\\"CRACK\\\":\\n                self.ter[p0[1]][p0[0]] = \\\"PIT\\\"\\n            if kind == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                self.occ[p0[1]][p0[0]] = None\\n                self.occ[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"BOX\\\"\\n            else:\\n                self.hx, self.hy = p1\\n                self.exposed.add(p1)\\n            t1 = self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]]\\n            if kind == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                if t1 == \\\"PIT\\\":\\n                 self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n                elif t1 == \\\"SWITCH\\\":\\n                    self.gates = not self.gates\\n            else:\\n                if t1 == \\\"PIT\\\":\\n                    self._trap(100)\\n                elif t1 == \\\"MIMIC\\\":\\n                    self._trap(45)\\n                    self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n            elif t1 == \\\"SWITCH\\\":\\n                    self.gates = not self.gates\\n            if kind != \\\"BOX\\\" and self.hp <= 0:\\n                self.status = \\\"DEAD\\\"\\n               elif t1 == \\\"K2\\\":\\n                    self.keys[1] = True\\n                    self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n                elif t1 == \\\"V\\\" and self.keys[0] and self.keys[1] and self.hp > 0:\\n                    self.status = \\\"CLEARED\\\"\\n                    return True\\n            if steps >= 32 or stop_momentum:\\n                break\\n            t1 = self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]]\\n            nxt = None\\n            newdir = dirv\\n            if t1 == \\\"ICE\\\":\\n                nxt = (p1[0] + dirv[0], p1[1] + dirv[1])\\n                if not self._can_enter(nxt[0], nxt[1], dirv, kind):\\n                    nxt = None\\n            elif t1 in MIRROR_FOLD:\\n                newdir = DIRV[MIRROR_FOLD[t1][DIR_OF[dirv]]]\\n                nxt = (p1[0] + newdir[0], p1[1] + newdir[1])\\n                if not self._can_enter(nxt[0], nxt[1], newdir, kind):\\n                    nxt = None\\n            elif t1 in SPRING_DIR:\\n                sd = DIRV[SPRING_DIR[t1]]\\n                newdir = sd\\n                land = (p1[0] + 3 * sd[0], p1[1] + 3 * sd[1])\\n                if not self.inside(land[0], land[1]):\\n                    land = None\\n                for k in (1, 2, 3):\\n                    px, py = p1[0] + k * sd[0], p1[1] + k * sd[1]\\n                    blocked = (not self.inside(px, py)) or self.high_wall(px, py) or \\\\\\n                        self.occ[py][px] in (\\\"BOX\\\", \\\"TNT\\\") or self.blocks_oneway(px, py, sd)\\n                    if kind == \\\"BOX\\\" and self.inside(px, py):\\n                        if (px, py) == (self.hx, self.hy) or self.ter[py][px] in (\\\"K1\\\", \\\"K2\\\", \\\"V\\\"):\\n                            blocked = True\\n                    if blocked:\\n                        if kind == \\\"BOX\\\" and self.inside(px, py) and self.occ[py][px] == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n                            self.tnt_armed.add((px, py))\\n                        land = (p1[0] + (k - 1) * sd[0], p1[1] + (k - 1) * sd[1]) if k >= 2 else None\\n                        break\\n                nxt = land\\n            elif t1 in PORTALS and not suppress:\\n                other = PORTAL_PAIR[t1]\\n                pp = None\\n                for yy in range(GRID_H):\\n                    for xx in range(GRID_W):\\n                        if self.ter[yy][xx] == other:\\n ----\\n    def _explode(self, sources):\\n        q = []\\n        seen = set()\\n        for s in sources:\\n            if s not in seen:\\n                seen.add(s)\\n                q.append(s)\\n        all_src = []\\n        while q:\\n            s = q.pop()\\n            all_src.append(s)\\n            for dx in (-1, 0, 1):\\n                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):\\n                    cx, cy = s[0] + dx, s[1] + dy\\n                    if not self.inside(cx, cy) or (cx, cy) in seen:\\n                        continue\\n                    if self.occ[cy][cx] == \\\"TNT\\\" or (cx, cy) in self.bombs:\\n                        seen.add((cx, cy))\\n                        q.append((cx, cy))\\n        a = b = 0\\n        for (sx, sy) in all_src:\\n            if abs(sx - self.hx) <= 1 and abs(sy - self.hy) <= 1:\\n                if self.occ[sy][sx] == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n                    a += 60\\n                elif (sx, sy) in self.bombs:\\n                    b += 50\\n        if a + b > 0:\\n            self.dmg += min(self.hp, a + b) * (a / float(a + b))\\n            self.hp -= (a + b)\\n        for (sx, sy) in all_src:\\n            if self.occ[sy][sx] == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n                self.occ[sy][sx] = None\\n            self.bombs.pop((sx, sy), None)\\n        union = set()\\n        for (sx, sy) in all_src:\\n            for dx in (-1, 0, 1):\\n union:\\n            if self.occ[cy][cx] == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                self.occ[cy][cx] = None\\n            t = self.ter[cy][cx]\\n            if t in BLAST_IMMUNE:\\n                continue\\n            if t == \\\"CRACK\\\":\\n                self.ter[cy][cx] = \\\"PIT\\\"\\n            elif t in BLAST_WIPE:\\n                self.ter[cy][cx] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n        for (cx, cy) in union:\\n            if self.occ[cy][cx] == \\\"BOX\\\" and self.ter[cy][cx] == \\\"PIT\\\":\\n                self.occ[cy][cx] = None\\n                self.ter[cy][cx] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n        if self.hp > 0 and self.ter[self.hy][self.hx] == \\\"PIT\\\":\\n            self._trap(100)\\n        if self.hp <= 0:\\n            self.status = \\\"DEAD\\\"\\n\\n    def _rays(self, red, blue):\\n        out = []\\n        armed = set()\\n        for y in range(GRID_H):\\n            for x in range(GRID_W):\\n                t = self.ter[y][x]\\n                if t in LASER_TILES:\\n                    if not red:\\n                        continue\\n                    d = LASER_TILES[t]\\n                elif t in LASER2_TILES:\\n                    if not blue:\\n                        continue\\n                    d = LASER2_TILES[t]\\n                else:\\n                    continue\\n                dx, dy = DIRV[d]\\n                cells = []\\n                for step in range(1, 11):\\n                    nx, ny = x + dx * step, y + dy * step\\n                    if not self.inside(nx, ny):\\n                        break\\n                    if self.high_wall(nx, ny) or self.occ[ny][nx] == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                        break\\n                    if self.occ[ny][nx] == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n                        armed.add((nx, ny))\\n                        break\\n                    cells.append((nx, ny))\\n                out.append(cells)\\n        return out, armed\\n\\n    def _throw(self, sx, sy, dirv):\\n        rng = 6\\n        sp = 0\\n        while rng > 0:\\n            nx, ny = sx + dirv[0], sy + dirv[1]\\n            if not self.inside(nx, ny):\\n                return\\n            rng -= 1\\n            sx, sy = nx, ny\\n            if self.high_wall(nx, ny) or self.occ[ny][nx] == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                return\\n            if self.occ[ny][nx] == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n                self.tnt_armed.add((nx, ny))\\n       self.ter[ny][nx] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n                return\\n            if t in MIRROR_FOLD:\\n                dirv = DIRV[MIRROR_FOLD[t][DIR_OF[dirv]]]\\n                continue\\n            if t in PORTALS and sp < 2:\\n                continue\\n        t = self.ter[sy][sx]\\n        if t != \\\"ICE\\\" and t not in MIRROR_FOLD:\\n            return\\n        for _ in range(32):\\n            nx, ny = sx + dirv[0], sy + dirv[1]\\n            if not self.inside(nx, ny):\\n                return\\n            sx, sy = nx, ny\\n            if self.high_wall(nx, ny) or self.occ[ny][nx] == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                return\\n            if self.occ[ny][nx] == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n                self.tnt_armed.add((nx, ny))\\n                return\\n            t = self.ter[ny][nx]\\n            if t == \\\"SWITCH\\\":\\n                self.gates = not self.gates\\n                return\\n            if t == \\\"MIMIC\\\":\\n                self.ter[ny][nx] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n                return\\n            if t in MIRROR_FOLD:\\n                dirv = DIRV[MIRROR_FOLD[t][DIR_OF[dirv]]]\\n                continue\\n            if t == \\\"ICE\\\":\\n                continue\\n            return\\n\\n    # ---- 单回合 ----\\n    def apply(self, action):\\n        if self.status is not None:\\n            return self.status\\n        self.turn = getattr(self, \\\"turn\\\", 0) + 1\\n        self.exposed = {(self.hx, self.hy)}\\n        self.tnt_armed = set()\\n        hx, hy = self.hx, self.hy\\n        if action == \\\"BOMB\\\":\\n            if self.bombs > 0 and (hx, hy) not in self.bombs:\\n                self.bombs -= 1\\n                self.bombs_map[(hx, hy)] = 3\\n        elif action.startswith(\\\"MOVE_\\\"):\\n            d = action[5]\\n            dx, dy = DIRV[d]\\n            p1 = (hx + dx, hy + dy)\\n            if not self.inside(*p1) or self.high_wall(*p1) or self.occ[p1[1]][p1[0]] == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n                pass\\n            elif self.occ[p1[1]][p1[0]] == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                if not self.blocks_oneway(p1[0], p1[1], (dx, dy)):\\n                    p2 = (hx + 2 * dx, hy + 2 * dy)\\n                    if self._can_enter(p2[0], p2[1], (dx, dy), \\\"BOX\\\"):\\n                        self._move_entity(\\\"BOX\\\", p1, p2, (dx, dy))\\n                        if self.status is None and \\\\\\n                                self._can_enter(p1[0], p1[1], (dx, dy), \\\"HERO\\\"):\\n                            self._move_entity(\\\"HERO\\\", (hx, hy), p1, (dx, dy))\\n            elif not self.blocks_oneway(p1[0], p1[1], (dx, dy)):\\n                self._move_entity(\\\"HERO\\\", (hx, hy), p1, (dx, dy))\\n        elif action.startswith(\\\"JUMP_\\\"):\\n            if self.jumps > 0:\\n                self.jumps -= 1\\n                d = action[5]\\n                dx, dy = DIRV[d]\\n                p1 = (hx + dx, hy + dy)\\n                p2 = (hx + 2 * dx, hy + 2 * dy)\\n                bad = (not self.inside(*p1)) or self.high_wall(*p1) or \\\\\\n                    self.blocks_oneway(p1[0], p1[1], (dx, dy))\\n                if not bad:\\n                    if (not self.inside(*p2)) or self.high_wall(*p2) or \\\\\\n                            self.occ[p2[1]][p2[0]] in (\\\"BOX\\\", \\\"TNT\\\") or \\\\\\n                            self.blocks_oneway(p2[0], p2[1], (dx, dy)):\\n                        bad = True\\n                if not bad:\\n                    self._move_entity(\\\"HERO\\\", (hx, hy), p2, (dx, dy))\\n        elif action.startswith(\\\"THROW_\\\"):\\n            if self.throws > 0:\\n                self.throws -= 1\\n                self._throw(hx, hy, DIRV[action[6]])\\n        if self.status is None:\\n            for k in list(self.bombs_map.keys()):\\n                self.bombs_map[k] -= 1\\n            srcs = [p for p, t in self.bombs_map.items() if t <= 0] + list(self.tnt_armed)\\n            if srcs:\\n                self._explode(srcs)\\n        if self.status is None:\\n            t = getattr(self, \\\"turn\\\", 0)\\n            red = (t % 3 == 0)\\n            blue = (t % 4 == 0)\\n  if c in self.exposed:\\n                            m += 1\\n                            break\\n                if m:\\n                    self.dmg += min(self.hp, 50 * m)\\n                    self.hp -= 50 * m\\n                    if self.hp <= 0:\\n                        self.status = \\\"DEAD\\\"\\n                if self.status is None and armed:\\n                    self._explode(list(armed))\\n        if self.status is None and getattr(self, \\\"turn\\\", 0) >= MAX_TURNS:\\n            self.status = \\\"TIMEOUT\\\"\\n        return self.status\\n\\n\\n# =============================================================================\\n# 二、静态地图分析 / 时间展开求路\\n# =============================================================================\\n\\nclass _World(object):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"从 FULL 观测快照提取的静态世界：地形、实体、机关位置、激光周期表。\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    __slots__ = (\\\"ter\\\", \\\"occ\\\", \\\"hero\\\", \\\"gates\\\", \\\"plates\\\", \\\"pgate\\\", \\\"boxes\\\",\\n                 \\\"cannons\\\", \\\"targets\\\", \\\"switch_cells\\\", \\\"pit_cells\\\", \\\"tnt_cells\\\",\\n                 \\\"clues\\\", \\\"turn\\\", \\\"hazard\\\")\\n\\n    def __init__(self, state):\\n        self.ter = []\\n        self.occ = []\\n        clues = state.get(\\\"clues\\\") or [[False] * GRID_W for _ in range(GRID_H)]\\n        for y in range(GRID_H):\\n            trow = state[\\\"terrain\\\"][y]\\n            orow = state[\\\"occupant\\\"][y]\\n            trow2 = []\\n            for x in range(GRID_W):\\n                t = trow[x]\\n                if t == \\\"CHEST\\\":\\n                    t = \\\"MIMIC\\\" if clues[y][x] else \\\"HEAL\\\"\\n                trow2.append(t)\\n            self.ter.append(trow2)\\n            self.occ.append([orow[x] for x in range(GRID_W)])\\n        h = state[\\\"hero\\\"]\\n        self.hero = (int(h[\\\"x\\\"]), int(h[\\\"y\\\"]), int(h[\\\"hp\\\"]), bool(h[\\\"keys\\\"][0]),\\n                     bool(h[\\\"keys\\\"][1]), int(h[\\\"jumps\\\"]), int(h[\\\"throws\\\"]), int(h[\\\"bombs\\\"]))\\n        self.gates = bool(state[\\\"gates_flipped\\\"])\\n        self.turn = int(state[\\\"turn\\\"])\\n        self.plates = []\\n        self.pgate = []\\n        self.boxes = []\\n        self.cannons = []\\n        self.switch_cells = []\\n        self.pit_cells = []\\n        self.tnt_cells = []\\n        for y in range(GRID_H):\\n            for x in range(GRID_W):\\n                t = self.ter[y][x]\\n                if t == \\\"PLATE\\\":\\n                    self.plates.append((x, y))\\n                elif t == \\\"P_GATE\\\":\\n                    self.pgate.append((x, y))\\n                elif t in LASER_TILES:\\n                    self.cannons.append((x, y, LASER_TILES[t], 3))\\n                elif t in LASER2_TILES:\\n                    self.cannons.append((x, y, LASER2_TILES[t], 4))\\n                elif t == \\\"SWITCH\\\":\\n                    self.switch_cells.append((x, y))\\n                elif t == \\\"PIT\\\":\\n                    self.pit_cells.append((x, y))\\n                elif t == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n                    self.tnt_cells.append((x, y))\\n                if self.occ[y][x] == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                    self.boxes.append((x, y))\\n        self.targets = state.get(\\\"targets\\\") or {}\\n        self.hazard = [[0] * GRID_W for _ in range(GRID_H)]\\n        self._build_hazard()\\n\\n    def _build_hazard(self):\\n        \\\"\\\"\\\"每个格子按 turn%12 的激光命中门数（含 P_GATE 关闭态）。\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n        active = self.plates_active()\\n        for (cx, cy, d, period) in self.cannons:\\n            dx, dy = DIRV[d]\\n            for step in range(1, 11):\\n                nx, ny = cx + dx * step, cy + dy * step\\n                if not (0 <= nx < GRID_W and 0 <= ny < GRID_H):\\n                    break\\n                t = self.ter[ny][nx]\\n                if t in HIGH_WALL or self.occ[ny][nx] == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                    break\\n                if t == \\\"R_GATE\\\" and not self.gates:\\n                    break\\n                if t == \\\"B_GATE\\\" and self.gates:\\n                    break\\n                if t == \\\"P_GATE\\\" and not active:\\n                    break\\n                if self.occ[ny][nx] == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n                    break\\n                for p in (range(3, 12, 3) if period == 3 else range(4, 12, 4)):\\n                    self.hazard[ny][nx] |= (1 << p)\\n\\n    def plates_active(self):\\n        if not self.plates:\\n            return False\\n        for (x, y) in self.plates:\\n            if self.occ[y][x] != \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                return False\\n        return True\\n\\n    def high_wall(self, x, y):\\n        if not (0 <= x < GRID_W and 0 <= y < GRID_H):\\n            return True\\n        t = self.ter[y][x]\\n        if t in HIGH_WALL:\\n            return True\\n        if t == \\\"R_GATE\\\":\\n            return not self.gates\\n        if t == \\\"B_GATE\\\":\\n            return self.gates\\n        if t == \\\"P_GATE\\\":\\n            return not self.plates_active()\\n        return False\\n\\n    def blocks_oneway(self, x, y, dirv):\\n        d = ONEWAY_DIR.get(self.ter[y][x])\\n        return d is not None and dirv != DIRV[d]\\n\\n\\ndef _sim_hero_move(ter, occ, gates, hx, hy, d, kind_dir=None):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"在静态地形上模拟一次 MOVE，返回 (end, dmg, flip, exposed, moved)。\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    dx, dy = DIRV[d]\\n    p0 = (hx, hy)\\n    p1 = (hx GRID_H:\n                v = ny * GRID_W + nx\n                base = _cell_cost(known[v], occ_m[v], flipped, False, v in hot, hp)\n                if base is not None:\n                    cv = cover[v]\n                    heavy = hit_cost * _POPC[cu | cv] if nb else 0.0\n                    prob = 0.0\n                    if not (cu | cv) and (u in mem_beam or v in mem_beam):\n                        prob = hit_cost\n                    add_edge(u, v, MOVE_ACT[dk], base, heavy, prob)\n            if jumps > 0:\n                p1x = ux + dx\n                p1y = uy + dy\n                p2x = ux + 2 * dx\n                p2y = uy + 2 * dy\n                if not (0 <= p2x < GRID_W and 0 <= p2y < GRID_H):\n                    continue\n                i1 = p1y * GRID_W + p1x\n                t1 = known[i1]\n                if t1 is not None and _is_wall(t1, flipped):\n                    continue\n                i2 = p2y * GRID_W + p2x\n                t2 = known[i2]\n                if t2 is not None and _is_wall(t2, flipped):\n                    continue\n                base2 = _cell_cost(t2, occ_m[i2], flipped, False, i2 in hot, hp)\n                if base2 is None:\n                    continue\n                if t1 is None:\n                    base2 += 1.5\n                ci = cover[i2]\n                heavy = hit_cost * _POPC[cu | ci] if nb else 0.0\n                prob = 0.0\n                if not (cu | ci) and (u in mem_beam or i2 in mem_beam):\n                    prob = hit_cost\n                add_edge(u, i2, JUMP_ACT[dk], base2 + jump_extra, heavy, prob)\n\n    total = CELLS * 3\n    dist = [INF] * total\n    act = [None] * total\n    if goal_idx is None:\n        return dist, act\n    for ph in range(3):\n        dist[goal_idx * 3 + ph] = 0.0\n    pq = [(0.0, goal_idx * 3), (0.0, goal_idx * 3 + 1), (0.0, goal_idx * 3 + 2)]\n    while pq:\n        d, st = heapq.heappop(pq)\n        if d > dist[st] + 1e-12:\n            continue\n        cell = st // 3\n        ph = st % 3\n        for (uf, a, c) in layers[ph][cell]:\n            nd = d + c\n            if nd < dist[uf] - 1e-12:\n                dist[uf] = nd\n                act[uf] = a\n                heapq.heappush(pq, (nd, uf))\n    return dist, act\n\n\ndef _sim_chain(hx, hy, dkey, known, occ_m, flipped, hp):\n    \"\"\"已知地图上仿真一次 MOVE 的 8 步原子位移链。\"\"\"\n    res = {\"dead\": False, \"blocked\": False, \"unknown\": False,\n           \"dmg\": 0, \"x\": hx, \"y\": hy, \"exposed\": [(hx, hy)]}\n    dx, dy = DIRS[dkey]\n    x = hx + dx\n    y = hy + dy\n    if not (0 <= x < GRID_W and 0 <= y < GRID_H):\n        res[\"blocked\"] = True\n        return res\n    idx = y * GRID_W + x\n    if occ_m[idx] == \"BOX\" or occ_m[idx] == \"TNT\":\n        res[\"blocked\"] = True\n        return res\n    t = known[idx]\n    if t is None:\n        res[\"unknown\"] = True\n        res[\"x\"] = x\n        res[\"y\"] = y\n        res[\"exposed\"].append((x, y))\n        return res\n    if _is_wall(t, flipped):\n        res[\"blocked\"] = True\n        return res\n    cur = (x, y)\n    dk = dkey\n    steps = 0\n    while True:\n        steps += 1\n        if steps > 32:\n            break\n        tile = known[cur[1] * GRID_W + cur[0]]\n        if tile is None:\n            res[\"unknown\"] = True\n            break\n        res[\"exposed\"].append(cur)\n        if tile == \"PIT\":\n            res[\"dmg\"] += 100\n            res[\"dead\"] = True\n            break\n        if tile == \"MIMIC\":\n            res[\"dmg\"] += 45\n        elif tile == \"HEAL\":\n            res[\"dmg\"] -= 30\n        elif tile == \"SWITCH\":\n            flipped = not flipped\n        if tile in SPRING_TILES:\n            dk = SPRING_TILES[tile]\n            ndx, ndy = DIRS[dk]\n            land = None\n            for k in (1, 2, 3):\n                px = cur[0] + k * ndx\n                py = cur[1] + k * ndy\n                if not (0 <= px < GRID_W and 0 <= py < GRID_H):\n                    land = None if k == 1 else (cur[0] + (k - 1) * ndx, cur[1] + (k - 1) * ndy)\n                    break\n                j = py * GRID_W + px\n                tt = known[j]\n                oo = occ_m[j]\n                if oo == \"BOX\" or oo == \"TNT\" or (tt is not None and _is_wall(tt, flipped)):\n                    land = None if k == 1 else (cur[0] + (k - 1) * ndx, cur[1] + (k - 1) * ndy)\n                    break\n                if tt is None:\n                    res[\"unknown\"] = True\n                    land = None\n                    break\n            if res[\"unknown\"]:\n                break\n            if land is None or land == cur:\n                break\n            cur = land\n            res[\"exposed\"].append(cur)\n            tile =             res[\"dead\"] = True\n                break\n            if tile == \"MIMIC\":\n                res[\"dmg\"] += 45\n            elif tile == \"HEAL\":\n                res[\"dmg\"] -= 30\n
