break\n            j = ny * GRID_W + nx\n            tt = known[j]\n            oo = occ_m[j]\n            if oo == \"BOX\" or oo == \"TNT\" or (tt is not None and _is_wall(tt, flipped)):\n                break\n            if tt is None:\n                res[\"unknown\"] = True\n                break\n            cur = (nx, ny)\n            continue\n        break\n    res[\"x\"] = cur[0]\n    res[\"y\"] = cur[1]\n    if hp - res[\"dmg\"] <= 0:\n        res[\"dead\"] = True\n    return res\n\n\ndef _sim_jump(hx, hy, dkey, known, occ_m, flipped, hp):\n    res = {\"dead\": False, \"blocked\": False, \"unknown\": False,\n           \"dmg\": 0, \"x\": hx, \"y\": hy, \"exposed\": [(hx, hy)]}\n    dx, dy = DIRS[dkey]\n    p1 = (hx + dx, hy + dy)\n    p2 = (hx + 2 * dx, hy + 2 * dy)\n    if not (0 <= p2[0] < GRID_W and 0 <= p2[1] < GRID_H):\n        res[\"blocked\"] = True\n        return res\n    t1 = known[p1[1] * GRID_W + p1[0]]\n    if t1 is not None and _is_wall(t1, flipped):\n        res[\"blocked\"] = True\n        return res\n    i2 = p2[1] * GRID_W + p2[0]\n    o2 = occ_m[i2]\n    if o2 == \"BOX\" or o2 == \"TNT\":\n        res[\"blocked\"] = True\n        return res\n    t2 = known[i2]\n    if t2 is None:\n        res[\"unknown\"] = True\n        res[\"x\"] = p2[0]\n        res[\"y\"] = p2[1]\n        res[\"exposed\"].append(p2)\n        return res\n    if _is_wall(t2, flipped):\n        res[\"blocked\"] = True\n        return res\n    res[\"exposed\"].append(p2)\n    if t2 == \"PIT\":\n        res[\"dmg\"] += 100\n        res[\"dead\"] = True\n        res[\"x\"] = p2[0]\n        res[\"y\"] = p2[1]\n        return res\n    if t2 == \"MIMIC\":\n        res[\"dmg\"] += 45\n    elif t2 == \"HEAL\":\n        res[\"dmg\"] -= 30\n    res[\"x\"] = p2[0]\n    res[\"y\"] = p2[1]\n    if hp - res[\"dmg\"] <= 0:\n        res[\"dead\"] = True\n    return res\n\n\ndef _laser_hits(cells, beam_sets, warn=None):\n    \"\"\"估计本轮会被多少门激光炮命中（已知炮座精确计数 + 官方 laser_warnings 兜底）。\"\"\"\n    if not cells:\n        return 0\n    ex = set()\n    for (x, y) in cells:\n        ex.add(y * GRID_W + x)\n    n = 0\n    if beam_sets:\n        for bs in beam_sets:\n            if not ex.isdisjoint(bs):\n                n += 1\n    if warn:\n        top = 0\n        distinct = 0\n        for (x, y) in cells:\n            c = warn.get((x, y), 0)\n            if c > top:\n                top = c\n            if c > 0:\n                distinct += 1\n        if top > n:\n            n = top\n        if distinct > n:\n            n = distinct\n    return n\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 破墙自救\n\ndef _bfs_reach(start, known, occ_m, flipped):\n    seen = set((start,))\n    stack = [start]\n    while stack:\n        u = stack.pop()\n        ux = u % GRID_W\n        uy = u // GRID_W\n        for dk in DIR_KEYS:\n            dx, dy = DIRS[dk]\n            nx = ux + dx\n            ny = uy + dy\n            if not (0 <= nx < GRID_W and 0 <= ny < GRID_H):\n                continue\n            v = ny * GRID_W + nx\n            if v in seen:\n                continue\n            t = known[v]\n            if t is None:\n                continue\n            if occ_m[v] is not None:\n                continue\n            if _is_wall(t, flipped) or t == \"PIT\" or t == \"MIMIC\":\n                continue\n            seen.add(v)\n            stack.append(v)\n    return seen\n\n\ndef _bfs_path_act(start, target, known, occ_m, flipped):\n    \"\"\"从 start 到 target 的最短步行路径的首个动作。\"\"\"\n    if start == target:\n        return None\n    prev = {start: (None, None)}\n    dq = [start]\n    head = 0\n    while head < len(dq):\n        u = dq[head]\n        head += 1\n        ux = u % GRID_W\n        uy = u // GRID_W\n        for dk in DIR_KEYS:\n            dx, dy = DIRS[dk]\n            nx = ux + dx\n            ny = uy + dy\n            if not (0 <= nx < GRID_W and 0 <= ny < GRID_H):\n                continue\n            v = ny * GRID_W + nx\n            if v in prev:\n                continue\n            if occ_m[v] is not None:\n                continue\n            t = known[v]\n            if t is None or _is_wall(t, flipped) or t == \"PIT\" or t == \"MIMIC\":\n                continue\n            prev[v] = (u, MOVE_ACT[dk])\n            if v == target:\n                node = v\n                act = MOVE_ACT[dk]\n                while prev[node][0] is not None and prev[node][0] != start:\n                    node = prev[node][0]\n                    act = prev[node][1]\n                return act\n            dq.append(v)\n    return None\n\n\ndef _breach_action(state, known, occ_m, flipped, hx, hy, goal):\n    \"\"\"被彻底封死时：找一格可炸的 W 墙，走到贴墙格布雷。\"\"\"\n    hero = state[\"hero\"]\n    if int(hero[\"bombs\"]) <= 0:\n        return None\n    gx, gy = goal\n    start = hy * GRID_W + hx\n    reach = _bfs_reach(start, known, occ_m, flipped)\n    best_wall = None\n    for u in reach:\n        ux = u % GRID_W\n        uy = u // GRID_W\n        for dk in DIR_KEYS:\n            dx, dy = DIRS[dk]\n            nx = ux + dx\n            ny = uy + dy\n            if not (0 <= nx < GRID_W and 0 <= ny < GRID_H):\n                continue\n            v = ny * GRID_W + nx\n            if known[v] != \"W\" or occ_m[v] is not None:\n                continue\n            sc = abs(nx - gx) + abs(ny - gy)\n            if best_wall is None or sc < best_wall[0]:\n                best_wall = (sc, v)\n    if best_wall is None:\n        return None\n    wx = best_wall[1] % GRID_W\n    wy = best_wall[1] // GRID_W\n    # 选贴近墙的可达格作为布雷点\n    best_b = None\n    for u in reach:\n        ux = u % GRID_W\n        uy = u // GRID_W\n        if max(abs(ux - wx), abs(uy - wy)) <= 1:\n            d = abs(ux - hx) + abs(uy - hy)\n            if best_b is None or d < best_b[0]:\n                best_b = (d, u)\n    if best_b is None:\n        return None\n    bx = best_b[1] % GRID_W\n    by = best_b[1] // GRID_W\n    # 已有炸弹贴着我们 / 脚下 -> 先撤到安全距离\n    bombs = state.get(\"bombs\") or ()\n    near_bomb = False\n    for b in bombs:\n        try:\n            ddx = abs(int(b[\"x\"]) - hx)\n            ddy = abs(int(b[\"y\"]) - hy)\n        except Exception:\n            continue\n        if ddx <= 1 and ddy <= 1:\n            near_bomb = True\n    if near_bomb:\n        best_r = None\n        for u in reach:\n            ux = u % GRID_W\n            uy = u // GRID_W\n            far = True\n            for b in bombs:\n                try:\n                    if max(abs(int(b[\"x\"]) - ux), abs(int(b[\"y\"]) - uy)) <= 1:\n                        far = False\n                        break\n                except Exception:\n                    continue\n            if far:\n                d = abs(ux - hx) + abs(uy - hy)\n                if best_r is None or d < best_r[0]:\n                    best_r = (d, u)\n        if best_r is None:\n            return None\n        return _bfs_path_act(start, best_r[1], known, occ_m, flipped)\n    if start == best_b[1]:\n        # 确认炸完有地方躲（够大就躲，躲不开就赌血量扛一发炸弹自伤 50）\n        safe = False\n        for u in reach:\n            ux = u % GRID_W\n            uy = u // GRID_W\n            if max(abs(ux - bx), abs(uy - by)) >= 2:\n                safe = True\n                break\n        if not safe and int(hero[\"hp\"]) <= 60:\n            return None\n        return \"BOMB\"\n    return _bfs_path_act(start, best_b[1], known, occ_m, flipped)\n\n\n#   hero = state[\"hero\"]\n    hx = int(hero[\"x\"])\n    hy = int(hero[\"y\"])\n    hp = int(hero[\"hp\"])\n    turn = int(state[\"turn\"])\n    flipped = bool(state[\"gates_flipped\"])\n    jumps = int(hero[\"jumps\"])\n    throws = int(hero[\"throws\"])\n\n    known, occ_m = _update_memory(state, memory)\n    beams = _beam_sets(known, occ_m, flipped)\n    hot = _hot_cells(state, beams)\n    start = hy * GRID_W + hx\n\n    goal = _next_goal(state)\n    if goal is None:\n        return \"WAIT\"\n    gx, gy = goal\n    goal_idx = gy * GRID_W + gx\n    laser_now = (turn % 3 == 0)\n    phase = turn % 3\n    next_phase = (turn + 1) % 3\n    warn = None\n    if laser_now:\n        warn = {}\n        for w in (state.get(\"laser_warnings\") or ()):\n            try:\n                key = (int(w[\"x\"]), int(w[\"y\"]))\n            except Exception:\n                continue\n            warn[key] = warn.get(key, 0) + 1\n    # 记住历史警告过的弹道格（炮座可能在视野外），供后续回合避险\n    beam_mem = memory.get(\"b\")\n    if not isinstance(beam_mem, set):\n        beam_mem = set()\n        memory[\"b\"] = beam_mem\n    if warn:\n        for (bx, by) in warn:\n            beam_mem.add(by * GRID_W + bx)\n    dist, act = _plan_field(known, occ_m, flipped, beams, hot, hp, jumps, goal_idx,\n                            beam_mem)\n    start_state = start * 3 + phase\n    plan_act = act[start_state]\n    goal_cost = dist[start_state]\n    sealed = goal_cost >= INF * 0.5\n    if sealed:\n        goal_cost = 40.0\n\n    # 防打转：最近走过的格子\n    hist = memory.get(\"h\")\n    if not isinstance(hist, list):\n        hist = []\n        memory[\"h\"] = hist\n    hist3 = set(hist[-3:-1]) if len(hist) >= 2 else set()\n\n    # ---- 被彻底封死 / 长时间僵住：尝试炸弹破墙\n    stall = memory.get(\"stall\")\n    if not isinstance(stall, int):\n        stall = 0\n    if sealed or stall >= 6:\n        breach = None\n        try:\n            breach = _breach_action(state, known, occ_m, flipped, hx, hy, goal)\n        except Exception:\n            breach = None\n        if breach in VALID_ACTIONS:\n            memory[\"stall\"] = 0\n            memory[\"probe\"] = 0\n            return breach\n        # 最后手段：系统化试探（飞石引爆 TNT / 跳跃越障等），总比原地等死强\n        idx = memory.get(\"probe\")\n        if not isinstance(idx, int):\n            idx = 0\n        order = (\"THROW_R\", \"THROW_U\", \"THROW_D\", \"THROW_L\",\n                 \"JUMP_R\", \"JUMP_U\", \"JUMP_D\", \"JUMP_L\", \"BOMB\")\n        while idx < len(order):\n            a = order[idx]\n            idx += 1\n            if a.startswith(\"THROW_\") and throws <= 0:\n                continue\n            if a.startswith(\"JUMP_\"):\n                if jumps <= 0:\n                    continue\n                sim = _sim_jump(hx, hy, a[5], known, occ_m, flipped, hp)\n                if sim[\"blocked\"] or sim[\"dead\"]:\n                    continue\n            memory[\"probe\"] = idx\n            memory[\"stall\"] = 0\n            return a\n        memory[\"probe\"] = idx\n\n    # ---- 候选动作评估\n    cands = []\n    if plan_act:\n        cands.append(plan_act)\n    for dk in DIR_KEYS:\n        a = MOVE_ACT[dk]\n        if a not in cands:\n            cands.append(a)\n    if jumps > 0:\n        for dk in DIR_KEYS:\n            a = JUMP_ACT[dk]\n            if a not in cands:\n                cands.append(a)\n\n    best_score = None\n    best_act = None\n    for a in cands:\n        if a.startswith(\"MOVE_\"):\n            sim = _sim_chain(hx, hy, a[5], known, occ_m, flipped, hp)\n        else:\n            sim = _sim_jump(hx, hy, a[5], known, occ_m, flipped, hp)\n        if sim[\"blocked\"] or sim[\"dead\"]:\n            continue\n        if sim[\"x\"] == hx and sim[\"y\"] == hy:\n            continue\n        dmg = sim[\"dmg\"]\n        if laser_now:\n            dmg += 50 * _laser_hits(sim[\"exposed\"], beams, warn)\n        if hp - dmg <= 0:\n            continue\n        eidx = sim[\"y\"] * GRID_W + sim[\"x\"]\n        d2 = dist[eidx * 3 + next_phase]\n        if d2 >= INF * 0.5:\n            d2 = 40.0 + 0.63 * (abs(gx - sim[\"x\"]) + abs(gy - sim[\"y\"]))\n        score = 1.5 * dmg + d2\n        if sim[\"unknown\"]:\n            score += 1.0\n        if a != plan_act:\n            score += 0.5\n        if a.startswith(\"JUMP_\"):\n            score += 0.3\n        if eidx in hist3:\n            score += 4.0\n        if best_score is None or score < best_score:\n            best_score = score\n            best_act = a\n\n    wait_dmg = 0\n    if laser_now:\n        wait_dmg += 50 * _laser_hits([(hx, hy)], beams, warn)\n    wait_score = 1.5 * wait_dmg + dist[start * 3 + next_phase] + 2.0\n\n    hist.append(start)\n    if len(hist) > 8:\n        del hist[0:len(hist) - 8]\n\n    if best_act is None:\n        memory[\"stall\"] = stall + 1\n        return \"WAIT\"\n    if wait_score < best_score:\n        memory[\"stall\"] = 0 if wait_dmg > 0 else stall + 1\n        return \"WAIT\"\n    memory[\"stall\"] = 0\n    return best_act\n\n\ndef decide_action(state: dict, memory: dict) -> str:\n    try:\n        if not isinstance(memory, dict):\n            memory = {}\n        act = _decide(state, memory)\n        if act in VALID_ACTIONS:\n            return act\n        return \"WAIT\"\n    except Exception:\n        return \"WAIT\"",
        "newText": "\"\"\"\n《阴间地牢：金库攻防战》 下半场 v2.2 (FULL 全图明牌) 参赛提交 — DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017\n\n  魔王侧 `build_dungeon()`：v2.2 三连硬机关（PLATE/P_GATE + LASER2 双频 12 拍 + ONEWAY）重构的\n      \"金库三重门\" 逻辑迷宫；1..200 步作者自证；出生 4 回合零伤准入。\n  勇者侧 `decide_action()`：FULL 明牌下的时间展开分层规划器\n      （阶段 Dijkstra 求路 + 推箱 Sokoban 子规划 + 逐拍前向校验），\n      Turn 1 用 1.60s 全局规划，Turn>=2 用 0.42s 增量复核/重规划。\n\n设计要点（与题目要求逐条对应）：\n  1. 只用一份文件同时实现造图与破阵；\n  2. 决策侧完全基于 `state` 快照（`mode==\"FULL\"` 全图可见），不依赖任何跨局全局变量，\n     进程被重建（memory 清空）时 Turn>1 也能在 0.42s 内重新规划或安全降级；\n  3. 规划结果每一步都用内置前向引擎复演校验，校验不过立即重规划，绝不盲走。\n\"\"\"\n\nimport heapq\nimport time\n\nGRID_W = 40\nGRID_H = 26\nCELLS = GRID_W * GRID_H\nMAX_TURNS = 240\nMAX_AUTHOR_STEPS = 200\nSPAWN = (2, 13)\n\nDIRV = {\"U\": (0, -1), \"D\": (0, 1), \"L\": (-1, 0), \"R\": (1, 0)}\nDIR_OF = {(0, -1): \"U\", (0, 1): \"D\", (-1, 0): \"L\", (1, 0): \"R\"}\nDIR_KEYS = (\"U\", \"D\", \"L\", \"R\")\nMOVE_ACT = {\"U\": \"MOVE_U\", \"D\": \"MOVE_D\", \"L\": \"MOVE_L\", \"R\": \"MOVE_R\"}\nJUMP_ACT = {\"U\": \"JUMP_U\", \"D\": \"JUMP_D\", \"L\": \"JUMP_L\", \"R\": \"JUMP_R\"}\nTHROW_ACT = {\"U\": \"THROW_U\", \"D\": \"THROW_D\", \"L\": \"THROW_L\", \"R\": \"THROW_R\"}\n\nVALID_ACTIONS = frozenset((\n    \"MOVE_U\", \"MOVE_D\", \"MOVE_L\", \"MOVE_R\", \"WAIT\",\n    \"JUMP_U\", \"JUMP_D\", \"JUMP_L\", \"JUMP_R\",\n    \"THROW_U\", \"THROW_D\", \"THROW_L\", \"THROW_R\", \"BOMB\",\n))\n\nHIGH_WALL = frozenset((\"W\", \"T_W\",\n                       \"LASER_U\", \"LASER_D\", \"LASER_L\", \"LASER_R\",\n                       \"LASER2_U\", \"LASER2_D\", \"LASER2_L\", \"LASER2_R\"))\nLASER_TILES = {\"LASER_U\": \"U\", \"LASER_D\": \"D\", \"LASER_L\": \"L\", \"LASER_R\": \"R\"}\nLASER2_TILES = {\"LASER2_U\": \"U\", \"LASER2_D\": \"D\", \"LASER2_L\": \"L\", \"LASER2_R\": \"R\"}\nMIRROR_FOLD = {\n    \"MIRROR_NE\": {\"L\": \"U\", \"R\": \"U\", \"U\": \"R\", \"D\": \"R\"},\n    \"MIRROR_SE\": {\"L\": \"D\", \"R\": \"D\", \"U\": \"R\", {\"PORTAL_1A\": \"PORTAL_1B\", \"PORTAL_1B\": \"PORTAL_1A\",\n               \"PORTAL_2A\": \"PORTAL_2B\", \"PORTAL_2B\": \"PORTAL_2A\"}\nPORTALS = frozenset(PORTAL_PAIR)\nBLAST_IMMUNE =                \"ONEWAY_U\", \"ONEWAY_D\", \"ONEWAY_L\", \"ONEWAY_R\"))\nBLAST_WIPE = frozenset((\"W\", \"ICE\", \"SWITCH\", \"R_GATE\", \"B_GATE\", \"HEAL\", \"MIMIC\",\n                        \"MIRROR_NE\", \"MIRROR_SE\", \"MIRROR_SW\", \"MIRROR_NW\",\n                        \"SPRING_U\", \"SPRING_D\", \"SPRING_L\", \"SPRING_R\",\n                        \"LASER_U\", \"LASER_D\", 一、前向仿真内核（逐字复刻 v2.2 物理，供计划校验 / 战斗推演）\n# =============================================================================\n\nclass _Sim(object):\n    \"\"\"单局前向仿真：只需要 terrain / occupant / hero / gates / bombs。\"\"\"\n\n    __slots__ = (\"ter\", \"occ\", \"hx\", \"hy\", \"hp\", \"keys\", \"jumps\", \"throws\",\n                 \"bombs\", \"gates\", \"dmg\", \"status\", \"exposed\", \"tnt_armed\")\n\n    def __init__(self, ter, occ, hero, gates):\n        self.ter = [row[:] for row in ter]\n        self.occ = [row[:] for row in occ]\n        self.hx = hero[0]\n        self.hy = hero[1]\n        self.hp = hero[2]\n        self.keys = [bool(hero[3]), bool(hero[4])]\n        self.jumps = hero[5]\n        self.throws = hero[6]\n        self.bombs = hero[7]\n        self.gates = bool(gates)\n        self.dmg = 0.0\n        self.status = None\n        self.exposed = set()\n        self.tnt_armed = set()\n\n    # ---- 查询 ----\n    def inside(self, x, y):\n        return 0 <= x < GRID_W and 0 <= y < GRID_H\n\n    def plates_active(self):\n        found = False\n        for y in range(1, GRID_H - 1):\n            row = self.ter[y]\n            for x in range(1, GRID_W - 1):\n                if row[x] == \"PLATE\":\n                    found = True\n                    if self.occ[y][x] != \"BOX\":\n                        return False\n        return found\n\n    def high_wall(self, x, y):\n        t = self.ter[y][x]\n        if t in HIGH_WALL:\n            return True\n        if t == \"R_GATE\":\n            return not self.gates\n        if t == \"B_GATE\":\n            return self.gates\n        if t == \"P_GATE\":\n            return not self.plates_active()\n        return False\n\n    def blocks_oneway(self, x, y, dirv):\n        d = ONEWAY_DIR.get(self.ter[y][x])\n        if d is None:\n            return False\n        return dirv != DIRV[d]\n\n    def _trap(self, amt):\n        self.dmg += min(self.hp, amt)\n        self.hp -= amt\n\n    def _can_enter(self, x, y, dirv, kind):\n        if not self.inside(x, y):\n            return False\n        if self.high_wall(x, y):\n            return False\n        o = self.occ[y][x]\n        if o == \"BOX\" or o == \"TNT\":\n            return False\n        if kind == \"BOX\":\n            if (x, y) == (self.hx, self.hy):\n                return False\n            if self.ter[y][x] in (\"K1\", \"K2\", \"V\"):\n                return False\n        if self.blocks_oneway(x, y, dirv):\n            return False\n        return True\n\n    # ---- 8 步原子位移 ----\n    def _move_entity(self, kind, p0, p1, dirv):\n        steps = 0\n        portal_count = 0\n        suppress = False\n        stop_momentum = False\n        while True:\n            steps += 1\n            if self.ter[p0[1]][p0[0]] == \"CRACK\":\n                self.ter[p0[1]][p0[0]] = \"PIT\"\n            if kind == \"BOX\":\n                self.occ[p0[1]][p0[0]] = None\n                self.occ[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \"BOX\"\n            else:\n                self.hx, self.hy = p1\n                self.exposed.add(p1)\n            t1 = self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]]\n            if kind == \"BOX\":\n                if t1 == \"PIT\":\n                    self.occ[p1[1]][p1[0]] = None\n                    self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \"EMPTY\"\n                    stop_momentum = True\n                elif t1 == \"MIMIC\":\n                    self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \"EMPTY\"\n                elif t1 == \"SWITCH\":\n                    self.gates = not self.gates\n            else:\n                if t1 == \"PIT\":\n                    self._trap(100)\n                elif t1 == \"MIMIC\":\n                    self._trap(45)\n                    self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \"EMPTY\"\n                    stop_momentum = True\n                elif t1 == \"HEAL\":\n                    self.hp = min(100, self.hp + 30)\n                    self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \"EMPTY\"\n                elif t1 == \"SWITCH\":\n                    self.gates = not self.gates\n            if kind != \"BOX\" and self.hp <= 0:\n                self.status = \"DEAD\"\n                return True\n            if kind != \"BOX\":\n                if t1 == \"K1\":\n                    self.keys[0] = True\n                    self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \"EMPTY\"\n                elif t1 == \"K2\":\n                    self.keys[1] = True\n                    self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \"EMPTY\"\n                elif t1 == \"V\" and self.keys[0] and self.keys[1] and self.hp > 0:\n                    self.status = \"CLEARED\"\n                    return True\n            if steps >= 32 or stop_momentum:\n                break\n            t1 = self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]]\n            nxt = None\n            newdir = dirv\n            if t1 == \"ICE\":\n                nxt = (p1[0] + dirv[0], p1[1] + dirv[1])\n                if not self._can_enter(nxt[0], nxt[1], dirv, kind):\n                    nxt = None\n            elif t1 in MIRROR_FOLD:\n                newdir = DIRV[MIRROR_FOLD[t1][DIR_OF[dirv]]]\n                nxt = (p1[0] + newdir[0], p1[1] + newdir[1])\n                if not self._can_enter(nxt[0], nxt[1], newdir, kind):\n                    nxt = None\n            elif t1 in SPRING_DIR:\n                sd = DIRV[SPRING_DIR[t1]]\n                newdir = sd\n                land = (p1[0] + 3 * sd[0], p1[1] + 3 * sd[1])\n                if not self.inside(land[0], land[1]):\n                    land = None\n                for k in (1, 2, 3):\n                    px, py = p1[0] + k * sd[0], p1[1] + k * sd[1]\n                    blocked = (not self.inside(px, py)) or self.high_wall(px, py) or \\\n                        self.occ[py][px] in (\"BOX\", \"TNT\") or self.blocks_oneway(px, py, sd)\n                    if kind == \"BOX\" and self.inside(px, py):\n                        if (px, py) == (self.hx, self.hy) or self.ter[py][px] in (\"K1\", \"K2\", \"V\"):\n                            blocked = True\n                    if blocked:\n                        if kind == \"BOX\" and self.inside(px, py) and self.occ[py][px] == \"TNT\":\n                            self.tnt_armed.add((px, py))\n                        land = (p1[0] + (k - 1) * sd[0], p1[1] + (k - 1) * sd[1]) if k >= 2 else None\n                        break\n                nxt = land\n            elif t1 in PORTALS and not suppress:\n                other = PORTAL_PAIR[t1]\n                pp = None\n                for yy in range(GRID_H):\n                    for xx in range(GRID_W):\n                        if self.ter[yy][xx] == other:\n                            pp = (xx, yy)\n                            break\n                    if pp:\n                        break\n                ok = pp is not None and self.occ[pp[1]][pp[0]] is None\n                if kind == \"BOX\" and ok and pp == (self.hx, self.hy):\n                    ok = False\n                if ok:\n                    portal_count += 1\n                    nxt = pp\n                    suppress = True\n                else:\n                    nxt = None\n            elif t1 in PORTALS and suppress:\n                suppress = False\n                if portal_count >= 2:\n                    nxt = None\n                else:\n                    fx, fy = p1[0] + dirv[0], p1[1] + dirv[1]\n                    nxt = (fx, fy) if self._can_enter(fx, fy, dirv, kind) else None\n            if nxt is None:\n                break\n            p0, p1 = p1, nxt\n            dirv = newdir\n        return False\n\n    # ---- 爆炸 ----\n    def _explode(self, sources):\n        q = []\n        seen = set()\n        for s in sources:\n            if s not in seen:\n                seen.add(s)\n                q.append(s)\n        all_src = []\n        while q:\n            s = q.pop()\n            all_src.append(s)\n            for dx in (-1, 0, 1):\n                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):\n                    cx, cy = s[0] + dx, s[1] + dy\n                    if not self.inside(cx, cy) or (cx, cy) in seen:\n                        continue\n                    if self.occ[cy][cx] == \"TNT\" or (cx, cy) in self.bombs:\n                        seen.add((cx, cy))\n                        q.append((cx, cy))\n        a = b = 0\n        for (sx, sy) in all_src:\n            if abs(sx - self.hx) <= 1 and abs(sy - self.hy) <= 1:\n                if self.occ[sy][sx] == \"TNT\":\n                    a += 60\n                elif (sx, sy) in self.bombs:\n                    b += 50\n        if a + b > 0:\n            self.dmg += min(self.hp, a + b) * (a / float(a + b))\n            self.hp -= (a + b)\n        for (sx, sy) in all_src:\n            if self.occ[sy][sx] == \"TNT\":\n                self.occ[sy][sx] = None\n            self.bombs.pop((sx, sy), None)\n        union = set()\n        for (sx, sy) in all_src:\n            for dx in (-1, 0, 1):\n                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):\n                    cx, cy = sx + dx, sy + dy\n                    if self.inside(cx, cy):\n                        union.add((cx, cy))\n        for (cx, cy) in union:\n            if self.occ[cy][cx] == \"BOX\":\n                self.occ[cy][cx] = None\n            t = self.ter[cy][cx]\n            if t in BLAST_IMMUNE:\n                continue\n            if t == \"CRACK\":\n                self.ter[cy][cx] = \"PIT\"\n            elif t in BLAST_WIPE:\n                self.ter[cy][cx] = \"EMPTY\"\n        for (cx, cy) in union:\n            if self.occ[cy][cx] == \"BOX\" and self.ter[cy][cx] == \"PIT\":\n                self.occ[cy][cx] = None\n                self.ter[cy][cx] = \"EMPTY\"\n        if self.hp > 0 and self.ter[self.hy][self.hx] == \"PIT\":\n            self._trap(100)\n        if self.hp <= 0:\n            self.status = \"DEAD\"\n\n    def _rays(self, red, blue):\n        out = []\n        armed = set()\n        for y in range(GRID_H):\n            for x in range(GRID_W):\n                t = self.ter[y][x]\n                if t in LASER_TILES:\n                    if not red:\n                        continue\n                    d = LASER_TILES[t]\n                elif t in LASER2_TILES:\n                    if not blue:\n                        continue\n                    d = LASER2_TILES[t]\n                else:\n                    continue\n                dx, dy = DIRV[d]\n                cells = []\n                for step in range(1, 11):\n                    nx, ny = x + dx * step, y + dy * step\n                    if not self.inside(nx, ny):\n                        break\n                    if self.high_wall(nx, ny) or self.occ[ny][nx] == \"BOX\":\n                        break\n                    if self.occ[ny][nx] == \"TNT\":\n                        armed.add((nx, ny))\n                        break\n                    cells.append((nx, ny))\n                out.append(cells)\n        return out, armed\n\n    def _throw(self, sx, sy, dirv):\n        rng = 6\n        sp = 0\n        while rng > 0:\n            nx, ny = sx + dirv[0], sy + dirv[1]\n            if not self.inside(nx, ny):\n                return\n            rng -= 1\n            sx, sy = nx, ny\n            if self.high_wall(nx, ny) or self.occ[ny][nx] == \"BOX\":\n                return\n            if self.occ[ny][nx] == \"TNT\":\n                self.tnt_armed.add((nx, ny))\n                return\n            t = self.ter[ny][nx]\n            if t == \"SWITCH\":\n                self.gates = not self.gates\n                return\n            if t == \"MIMIC\":\n                self.ter[ny][nx] = \"EMPTY\"\n                return\n            if t in MIRROR_FOLD:\n                dirv = DIRV[MIRROR_FOLD[t][DIR_OF[dirv]]]\n                continue\n            if t in PORTALS and sp < 2:\n                continue\n        t = self.ter[sy][sx]\n        if t != \"ICE\" and t not in MIRROR_FOLD:\n            return\n        for _ in range(32):\n            nx, ny = sx + dirv[0], sy + dirv[1]\n            if not self.inside(nx, ny):\n                return\n            sx, sy = nx, ny\n            if self.high_wall(nx, ny) or self.occ[ny][nx] == \"BOX\":\n                return\n            if self.occ[ny][nx] == \"TNT\":\n                self.tnt_armed.add((nx, ny))\n                return\n            t = self.ter[ny][nx]\n            if t == \"SWITCH\":\n                self.gates = not self.gates\n                return\n            if t == \"MIMIC\":\n                self.ter[ny][nx] = \"EMPTY\"\n                return\n            if t in MIRROR_FOLD:\n                dirv = DIRV[MIRROR_FOLD[t][DIR_OF[dirv]]]\n                continue\n            if t == \"ICE\":\n                continue\n            return\n\n    # ---- 单回合 ----\n    def apply(self, action):\n        if self.status is not None:\n            return self.status\n        self.turn = getattr(self, \"turn\", 0) + 1\n        self.exposed = {(self.hx, self.hy)}\n        self.tnt_armed = set()\n        hx, hy = self.hx, self.hy\n        if action == \"BOMB\":\n            if self.bombs > 0 and (hx, hy) not in self.bombs:\n                self.bombs -= 1\n                self.bombs_map[(hx, hy)] = 3\n        elif action.startswith(\"MOVE_\"):\n            d = action[5]\n            dx, dy = DIRV[d]\n            p1 = (hx + dx, hy + dy)\n            if not self.inside(*p1) or self.high_wall(*p1) or self.occ[p1[1]][p1[0]] == \"TNT\":\n                pass\n            elif self.occ[p1[1]][p1[0]] == \"BOX\":\n                if not self.blocks_oneway(p1[0], p1[1], (dx, dy)):\n                    p2 = (hx + 2 * dx, hy + 2 * dy)\n                    if self._can_enter(p2[0], p2[1], (dx, dy), \"BOX\"):\n                        self._move_entity(\"BOX\", p1, p2, (dx, dy))\n                        if self.status is None and \\\n                                self._can_enter(p1[0], p1[1], (dx, dy), \"HERO\"):\n                            self._move_entity(\"HERO\", (hx, hy), p1, (dx, dy))\n            elif not self.blocks_oneway(p1[0], p1[1], (dx, dy)):\n                self._move_entity(\"HERO\", (hx, hy), p1, (dx, dy))\n        elif action.startswith(\"JUMP_\"):\n            if self.jumps > 0:\n                self.jumps -= 1\n                d = action[5]\n                dx, dy = DIRV[d]\n                p1 = (hx + dx, hy + dy)\n                p2 = (hx + 2 * dx, hy + 2 * dy)\n                bad = (not self.inside(*p1)) or self.high_wall(*p1) or \\\n                    self.blocks_oneway(p1[0], p1[1], (dx, dy))\n                if not bad:\n                    if (not self.inside(*p2)) or self.high_wall(*p2) or \\\n                            self.occ[p2[1]][p2[0]] in (\"BOX\", \"TNT\") or \\\n                            self.blocks_oneway(p2[0], p2[1], (dx, dy)):\n                        bad = True\n                if not bad:\n                    self._move_entity(\"HERO\", (hx, hy), p2, (dx, dy))\n        elif action.startswith(\"THROW_\"):\n            if self.throws > 0:\n                self.throws -= 1\n                self._throw(hx, hy, DIRV[action[6]])\n        if self.status is None:\n            for k in list(self.bombs_map.keys()):\n                self.bombs_map[k] -= 1\n            srcs = [p for p, t in self.bombs_map.items() if t <= 0] + list(self.tnt_armed)\n            if srcs:\n                self._explode(srcs)\n        if self.status is None:\n            t = getattr(self, \"turn\", 0)\n            red = (t % 3 == 0)\n            blue = (t % 4 == 0)\n            if red or blue:\n                rays, armed = self._rays(red, blue)\n                m = 0\n                for cells in rays:\n                    for c in cells:\n                        if c in self.exposed:\n                            m += 1\n                            break\n                if m:\n                    self.dmg += min(self.hp, 50 * m)\n                    self.hp -= 50 * m\n                    if self.hp <= 0:\n                        self.status = \"DEAD\"\n                if self.status is None and armed:\n                    self._explode(list(armed))\n        if self.status is None and getattr(self, \"turn\", 0) >= MAX_TURNS:\n            self.status = \"TIMEOUT\"\n        return self.status\n\n\n# =============================================================================\n# 二、静态地图分析 / 时间展开求路\n# =============================================================================\n\nclass _World(object):\n    \"\"\"从 FULL 观测快照提取的静态世界：地形、实体、机关位置、激光周期表。\"\"\"\n\n    __slots__ = (\"ter\", \"occ\", \"hero\", \"gates\", \"plates\", \"pgate\", \"boxes\",\n                 \"cannons\", \"targets\", \"switch_cells\", \"pit_cells\", \"tnt_cells\",\n                 \"clues\", \"turn\", \"hazard\")\n\n    def __init__(self, state):\n        self.ter = []\n        self.occ = []\n        clues = state.get(\"clues\") or [[False] * GRID_W for _ in range(GRID_H)]\n        for y in range(GRID_H):\n            trow = state[\"terrain\"][y]\n            orow = state[\"occupant\"][y]\n            trow2 = []\n            for x in range(GRID_W):\n                t = trow[x]\n                if t == \"CHEST\":\n                    t = \"MIMIC\" if clues[y][x] else \"HEAL\"\n                trow2.append(t)\n            self.ter.append(trow2)\n            self.occ.append([orow[x] for x in range(GRID_W)])\n        h = state[\"hero\"]\n        self.hero = (int(h[\"x\"]), int(h[\"y\"]), int(h[\"hp\"]), bool(h[\"keys\"][0]),\n                     bool(h[\"keys\"][1]), int(h[\"jumps\"]), int(h[\"throws\"]), int(h[\"bombs\"]))\n        self.gates = bool(state[\"gates_flipped\"])\n        self.turn = int(state[\"turn\"])\n        self.plates = []\n        self.pgate = []\n        self.boxes = []\n        self.cannons = []\n        self.switch_cells = []\n        self.pit_cells = []\n        self.tnt_cells = []\n        for y in range(GRID_H):\n            for x in range(GRID_W):\n                t = self.ter[y][x]\n                if t == \"PLATE\":\n                    self.plates.append((x, y))\n                elif t == \"P_GATE\":\n                    self.pgate.append((x, y))\n                elif t in LASER_TILES:\n                    self.cannons.append((x, y, LASER_TILES[t], 3))\n                elif t in LASER2_TILES:\n                    self.cannons.append((x, y, LASER2_TILES[t], 4))\n                elif t == \"SWITCH\":\n                    self.switch_cells.append((x, y))\n                elif t == \"PIT\":\n                    self.pit_cells.append((x, y))\n                elif t == \"TNT\":\n                    self.tnt_cells.append((x, y))\n                if self.occ[y][x] == \"BOX\":\n                    self.boxes.append((x, y))\n        self.targets = state.get(\"targets\") or {}\n        self.hazard = [[0] * GRID_W for _ in range(GRID_H)]\n        self._build_hazard()\n\n    def _build_hazard(self):\n        \"\"\"每个格子按 turn%12 的激光命中门数（含 P_GATE 关闭态）。\"\"\"\n        active = self.plates_active()\n        for (cx, cy, d, period) in self.cannons:\n            dx, dy = DIRV[d]\n            for step in range(1, 11):\n                nx, ny = cx + dx * step, cy + dy * step\n                if not (0 <= nx < GRID_W and 0 <= ny < GRID_H):\n                    break\n                t = self.ter[ny][nx]\n                if t in HIGH_WALL or self.occ[ny][nx] == \"BOX\":\n                    break\n                if t == \"R_GATE\" and not self.gates:\n                    break\n                if t == \"B_GATE\" and self.gates:\n                    break\n                if t == \"P_GATE\" and not active:\n                    break\n                if self.occ[ny][nx] == \"TNT\":\n                    break\n                for p in (range(3, 12, 3) if period == 3 else range(4, 12, 4)):\n                    self.hazard[ny][nx] |= (1 << p)\n\n    def plates_active(self):\n        if not self.plates:\n            return False\n        for (x, y) in self.plates:\n            if self.occ[y][x] != \"BOX\":\n                return False\n        return True\n\n    def high_wall(self, x, y):\n        if not (0 <= x < GRID_W and 0 <= y < GRID_H):\n            return True\n        t = self.ter[y][x]\n        if t in HIGH_WALL:\n            return True\n        if t == \"R_GATE\":\n            return not self.gates\n        if t == \"B_GATE\":\n            return self.gates\n        if t == \"P_GATE\":\n            return not self.plates_active()\n        return False\n\n    def blocks_oneway(self, x, y, dirv):\n        d = ONEWAY_DIR.get(self.ter[y][x])\n        return d is not None and dirv != DIRV[d]\n\n\ndef _sim_hero_move(ter, occ, gates, hx, hy, d, kind_dir=None):\n    \"\"\"在静态地形上模拟一次 MOVE，返回 (end, dmg, flip, exposed, moved)。\"\"\"\n    dx, dy = DIRV[d]\n    p0 = \\\"LASER_U\\\", \\\"LASER_D\\\", \\\"LASER_L\\\", \\\"LASER_R\\\",\\n                       \\\"LASER2_U\\\", \\\"LASER2_D\\\", \\\"LASER2_L\\\", \\\"LASER2_R\\\"))\\nLASER_TILES = {\\\"LASER_U\\\": \\\"MIRROR_NW\\\": {\\\"L\\\": \\\"U\\\", \\\"R\\\": \\\"U\\\", \\\"U\\\": \\\"L\\\", \\\"D\\\": \\\"L\\\"},\\n}\\nSPRING_DIR = {\\\"SPRING_U\\\": \\\"U\\\", \\\"SPRING_D\\\": \\\"D\\\", \\\"MIRROR_SE\\\", \\\"MIRROR_SW\\\", \\\"MIRROR_NW\\\",\\n                        \\\"SPRING_U\\\", \\\"SPRING_D\\\", \\\"SPRING_L\\\", \\\"SPRING_R\\\",\\n                        \\\"LASER_U\\\", \\\"MIMIC\\\"))\\n\\n\\n# =============================================================================\\n# 一、前向仿真内核（v2.2 规则逐字实现；用于计划校验与战斗推演）\\n# =============================================================================\\n\\nclass _Sim(object):\\n    __slots__ = (\\\"ter\\\", \\\"occ\\\", \\\"hx\\\", \\\"hy\\\", \\\"hp\\\", \\\"k1\\\", \\\"k2\\\", \\\"jumps\\\", \\\"throws\\\",\\n                 \\\"bombs\\\", \\\"bmap\\\", \\\"gates\\\", \\\"dmg\\\", \\\"status\\\", \\\"exposed\\\", \\\"tnt_armed\\\",\\n                 \\\"turn\\\")\\n\\n    def __init__(self, ter, occ, hero, gates, turn=1):\\n        self.ter = [row[:] for row in ter]\\n        self.occ = [row[:] for row in occ]\\n        self.hx, self.hy = hero[0], hero[1]\\n        self.hp = hero[2]\\n        self.k1, self.k2 = bool(hero[3]), bool(hero[4])\\n        self.jumps, self.throws, self.bombs = hero[5], hero[6], hero[7]\\n        self.gates = bool(gates)\\n        self.turn = turn\\n        self.bmap = {}\\n        self.dmg = 0.0\\n        self.status = None\\n        self.exposed = set()\\n        self.tnt_armed = set()\\n\\n    def clone(self):\\n        s = _Sim.__new__(_Sim)\\n        s.ter = [row[:] for row in self.ter]\\n        s.occ = [row[:] for row in self.occ]\\n        s.hx, s.hy, s.hp = self.hx, self.hy, self.hp\\n        s.k1, s.k2 = self.k1, self.k2\\n        s.jumps, s.throws, s.bombs = self.jumps, self.throws, self.bombs\\n        s.gates = self.gates\\n        s.turn = self.turn\\n        s.bmap = dict(self.bmap)\\n        s.dmg = self.dmg\\n        s.status = self.status\\n        s.exposed = set()\\n        s.tnt_armed = set()\\n        return s\\n\\n    def inside(self, x, y):\\n        return 0 <= x < GRID_W and 0 <= y < GRID_H\\n\\n    def plates_active(self):\\n        found = False\\n        for y in range(1, GRID_H - 1):\\n            row = self.ter[y]\\n            for x in range(1, GRID_W - 1):\\n                if row[x] == \\\"PLATE\\\":\\n                    found = True\\n                    if self.occ[y][x] != \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                        return False\\n        return found\\n\\n    def high_wall(self, x, y):\\n        t = self.ter[y][x]\\n        if t in HIGH_WALL:\\n            return True\\n        if t == \\\"R_GATE\\\":\\n            return not self.gates\\n        if t == \\\"B_GATE\\\":\\n            return self.gates\\n        if t == \\\"P_GATE\\\":\\n            return not self.plates_active()\\n        return False\\n\\n    def blocks_oneway(self, x, y, dirv):\\n        d = ONEWAY_DIR.get(self.ter[y][x])\\n        return (d is not None) and (dirv != DIRV[d])\\n\\n    def _trap(self, amt):\\n        self.dmg += min(self.hp, amt) if self.hp > 0 else 0\\n        self.hp -= amt\\n\\n    def _can_enter(self, x, y, dirv, kind):\\n        if not (0 <= x < GRID_W and 0 <= y < GRID_H):\\n            return False\\n        if self.high_wall(x, y):\\n            return False\\n        o = self.occ[y][x]\\n        if o == \\\"BOX\\\" or o == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n            return False\\n        if kind == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n            if (x, y) == (self.hx, self.hy):\\n                return False\\n            if self.ter[y][x] in (\\\"K1\\\", \\\"K2\\\", \\\"V\\\"):\\n                return False\\n        if self.blocks_oneway(x, y, dirv):\\n            return False\\n        return True\\n\\n    def _portal_other(self, tile):\\n        other = PORTAL_PAIR[tile]\\n        for y in range(GRID_H):\\n            for x in range(GRID_W):\\n                if self.ter[y][x] == other:\\n                    return (x, y)\\n        return None\\n\\n    def _move_entity(self, kind, p0, p1, dirv):\\n        steps = 0\\n        portal_count = 0\\n        suppress = False\\n        stop_momentum = False\\n        while True:\\n            steps += 1\\n            if self.ter[p0[1]][p0[0]] == \\\"CRACK\\\":\\n                self.ter[p0[1]][p0[0]] = \\\"PIT\\\"\\n            if kind == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                self.occ[p0[1]][p0[0]] = None\\n                self.occ[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"BOX\\\"\\n            else:\\n                self.hx, self.hy = p1\\n                self.exposed.add(p1)\\n            t1 = self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]]\\n            if kind == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                if t1 == \\\"PIT\\\":\\n                    self.occ[p1[1]][p1[0]] = None\\n                    self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n                    stop_momentum = True\\n                elif t1 == \\\"MIMIC\\\":\\n                    self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n                elif t1 == \\\"SWITCH\\\":\\n                    self.gates = not self.gates\\n            else:\\n                if t1 == \\\"PIT\\\":\\n                    self._trap(100)\\n                elif t1 == \\\"MIMIC\\\":\\n                    self._trap(45)\\n                    self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n                    stop_momentum = True\\n                elif t1 == \\\"HEAL\\\":\\n                    self.hp = min(100, self.hp + 30)\\n                    self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n                elif t1 == \\\"SWITCH\\\":\\n                    self.gates = not self.gates\\n            if kind != \\\"BOX\\\" and self.hp <= 0:\\n                self.status = \\\"DEAD\\\"\\n                return True\\n            if kind != \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                if t1 == \\\"K1\\\":\\n                    self.k1 = True\\n                    self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n                elif t1 == \\\"K2\\\":\\n                    self.k2 = True\\n                    self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n                elif t1 == \\\"V\\\" and self.k1 and self.k2 and self.hp > 0:\\n                    self.status = \\\"CLEARED\\\"\\n                    return True\\n            if steps >= 32 or stop_momentum:\\n                break\\n            t1 = self.ter[p1[1]][p1[0]]\\n            nxt = None\\n            newdir = dirv\\n            if t1 == \\\"ICE\\\":\\n                nx, ny = p1[0] + dirv[0], p1[1] + dirv[1]\\n                if self._can_enter(nx, ny, dirv, kind):\\n                    nxt = (nx, ny)\\n            elif t1 in MIRROR_FOLD:\\n                newdir = DIRV[MIRROR_FOLD[t1][DIR_OF[dirv]]]\\n                nx, ny = p1[0] + newdir[0], p1[1] + newdir[1]\\n                if self._can_enter(nx, ny, newdir, kind):\\n                    nxt = (nx, ny)\\n            elif t1 in SPRING_DIR:\\n                sd = DIRV[SPRING_DIR[t1]]\\n                newdir = sd\\n                land = (p1[0] + 3 * sd[0], p1[1] + 3 * sd[1])\\n                if not (0 <= land[0] < GRID_W and 0 <= land[1] < GRID_H):\\n                    land = None\\n                for k in (1, 2, 3):\\n                    px, py = p1[0] + k * sd[0], p1[1] + k * sd[1]\\n                    blocked = (not (0 <= px < GRID_W and 0 <= py < GRID_H)) or \\\\\\n                        self.high_wall(px, py) or self.occ[py][px] in (\\\"BOX\\\", \\\"TNT\\\") or \\\\\\n                        self.blocks_oneway(px, py, sd)\\n                    if kind == \\\"BOX\\\" and 0 <= px < GRID_W and 0 <= py < GRID_H:\\n                        if (px, py) == (self.hx, self.hy) or \\\\\\n                                self.ter[py][px] in (\\\"K1\\\", \\\"K2\\\", \\\"V\\\"):\\n                            blocked = True\\n                    if blocked:\\n                        if kind == \\\"BOX\\\" and 0 <= px < GRID_W and 0 <= py < GRID_H and \\\\\\n                                self.occ[py][px] == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n                            self.tnt_armed.add((px, py))\\n                        land = (p1[0] + (k - 1) * sd[0], p1[1] + (k - 1) * sd[1]) if k >= 2 else None\\n                        break\\n                nxt = land\\n            elif t1 in PORTALS and not suppress:\\n                pp = self._portal_other(t1)\\n                ok = pp is not None and self.occ[pp[1]][pp[0]] is None\\n                if kind == \\\"BOX\\\" and ok and pp == (self.hx, self.hy):\\n                    ok = False\\n                if ok:\\n                    portal_count += 1\\n                    nxt = pp\\n                    suppress = True\\n            elif t1 in PORTALS and suppress:\\n                suppress = False\\n                if portal_count < 2:\\n                    fx, fy = p1[0] + dirv[0], p1[1] + dirv[1]\\n                    if self._can_enter(fx, fy, dirv, kind):\\n                        nxt = (fx, fy)\\n            if nxt is None:\\n                break\\n            p0, p1 = p1, nxt\\n            dirv = newdir\\n        return False\\n\\n    def _explode(self, sources):\\n        q, seen = [], set()\\n        for s in sources:\\n            if s not in seen:\\n                seen.add(s)\\n                q.append(s)\\n        all_src = []\\n        while q:\\n            s = q.pop()\\n            all_src.append(s)\\n            for dx in (-1, 0, 1):\\n                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):\\n                    cx, cy = s[0] + dx, s[1] + dy\\n                    if not (0 <= cx < GRID_W and 0 <= cy < GRID_H) or (cx, cy) in seen:\\n                        continue\\n                    if self.occ[cy][cx] == \\\"TNT\\\" or (cx, cy) in self.bmap:\\n                        seen.add((cx, cy))\\n                        q.append((cx, cy))\\n        a = b = 0\\n        for (sx, sy) in all_src:\\n            if abs(sx - self.hx) <= 1 and abs(sy - self.hy) <= 1:\\n                if self.occ[sy][sx] == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n                    a += 60\\n                elif (sx, sy) in self.bmap:\\n                    b += 50\\n        if a + b > 0:\\n            self.dmg += min(self.hp, a + b) * (a / float(a + b))\\n            self.hp -= (a + b)\\n        for (sx, sy) in all_src:\\n            if self.occ[sy][sx] == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n                self.occ[sy][sx] = None\\n            self.bmap.pop((sx, sy), None)\\n        union = set()\\n        for (sx, sy) in all_src:\\n            for dx in (-1, 0, 1):\\n                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):\\n                    cx, cy = sx + dx, sy + dy\\n                    if 0 <= cx < GRID_W and 0 <= cy < GRID_H:\\n                        union.add((cx, cy))\\n        for (cx, cy) in union:\\n            if self.occ[cy][cx] == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                self.occ[cy][cx] = None\\n            t = self.ter[cy][cx]\\n            if t in BLAST_IMMUNE:\\n                continue\\n            if t == \\\"CRACK\\\":\\n                self.ter[cy][cx] = \\\"PIT\\\"\\n            elif t in BLAST_WIPE:\\n                self.ter[cy][cx] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n        for (cx, cy) in union:\\n            if self.occ[cy][cx] == \\\"BOX\\\" and self.ter[cy][cx] == \\\"PIT\\\":\\n                self.occ[cy][cx] = None\\n                self.ter[cy][cx] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n        if self.hp > 0 and self.ter[self.hy][self.hx] == \\\"PIT\\\":\\n            self._trap(100)\\n        if self.hp <= 0:\\n            self.status = \\\"DEAD\\\"\\n\\n    def _rays(self, red, blue):\\n        out, armed = [], set()\\n        for y in range(GRID_H):\\n            for x in range(GRID_W):\\n                t = self.ter[y][x]\\n                if t in LASER_TILES:\\n                    if not red:\\n                        continue\\n                    d = LASER_TILES[t]\\n                elif t in LASER2_TILES:\\n                    if not blue:\\n                        continue\\n                    d = LASER2_TILES[t]\\n                else:\\n                    continue\\n                dx, dy = DIRV[d]\\n                cells = []\\n                for step in range(1, 11):\\n                    nx, ny = x + dx * step, y + dy * step\\n                    if not (0 <= nx < GRID_W and 0 <= ny < GRID_H):\\n                        break\\n                    if self.high_wall(nx, ny) or self.occ[ny][nx] == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                        break\\n                    if self.occ[ny][nx] == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n                        armed.add((nx, ny))\\n                        break\\n                    cells.append((nx, ny))\\n                out.append(cells)\\n        return out, armed\\n\\n    def _throw(self, sx, sy, dirv):\\n        rng = 6\\n        while rng > 0:\\n            nx, ny = sx + dirv[0], sy + dirv[1]\\n            if not (0 <= nx < GRID_W and 0 <= ny < GRID_H):\\n                return\\n            rng -= 1\\n            sx, sy = nx, ny\\n            if self.high_wall(nx, ny) or self.occ[ny][nx] == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                return\\n            if self.occ[ny][nx] == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n                self.tnt_armed.add((nx, ny))\\n                return\\n            t = self.ter[ny][nx]\\n            if t == \\\"SWITCH\\\":\\n                self.gates = not self.gates\\n                return\\n            if t == \\\"MIMIC\\\":\\n                self.ter[ny][nx] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n                return\\n            if t in MIRROR_FOLD:\\n                dirv = DIRV[MIRROR_FOLD[t][DIR_OF[dirv]]]\\n                continue\\n        t = self.ter[sy][sx]\\n        if t != \\\"ICE\\\" and t not in MIRROR_FOLD:\\n            return\\n        for _ in range(32):\\n            nx, ny = sx + dirv[0], sy + dirv[1]\\n            if not (0 <= nx < GRID_W and 0 <= ny < GRID_H):\\n                return\\n            sx, sy = nx, ny\\n            if self.high_wall(nx, ny) or self.occ[ny][nx] == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                return\\n            if self.occ[ny][nx] == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n                self.tnt_armed.add((nx, ny))\\n                return\\n            t = self.ter[ny][nx]\\n            if t == \\\"SWITCH\\\":\\n                self.gates = not self.gates\\n                return\\n            if t == \\\"MIMIC\\\":\\n                self.ter[ny][nx] = \\\"EMPTY\\\"\\n                return\\n            if t in MIRROR_FOLD:\\n                dirv = DIRV[MIRROR_FOLD[t][DIR_OF[dirv]]]\\n                continue\\n            if t == \\\"ICE\\\":\\n                continue\\n            return\\n\\n    def apply(self, action):\\n        if self.status is not None:\\n            return self.status\\n        self.turn += 1\\n        self.exposed = {(self.hx, self.hy)}\\n        self.tnt_armed = set()\\n        if action not in VALID_ACTIONS:\\n            action = \\\"WAIT\\\"\\n        hx, hy = self.hx, self.hy\\n        if action == \\\"BOMB\\\":\\n            if self.bombs > 0 and (hx, hy) not in self.bmap:\\n                self.bombs -= 1\\n                self.bmap[(hx, hy)] = 3\\n        elif action.startswith(\\\"MOVE_\\\"):\\n            d = action[5]\\n            dx, dy = DIRV[d]\\n            p1 = (hx + dx, hy + dy)\\n            if not (0 <= p1[0] < GRID_W and 0 <= p1[1] < GRID_H):\\n                pass\\n            elif self.high_wall(p1[0], p1[1]) or self.occ[p1[1]][p1[0]] == \\\"TNT\\\":\\n                pass\\n            elif self.occ[p1[1]][p1[0]] == \\\"BOX\\\":\\n                if not self.blocks_oneway(p1[0], p1[1], (dx, dy)):\\n                    p2 = (hx + 2 * dx, hy + 2 * dy)\\n                    if self._can_enter(p2[0], p2[1], (dx, dy), \\\"BOX\\\"):\\n                        self._move_entity(\\\"BOX\\\", p1, p2, (dx, dy))\\n                        if self.status is None and \\\\\\n                                self._can_enter(p1[0], p1[1], (dx, dy), \\\"HERO\\\"):\\n                            self._move_entity(\\\"HERO\\\", (hx, hy), p1, (dx, dy))\\n            elif not self.blocks_oneway(p1[0], p1[1], (dx, dy)):\\n                self._move_entity(\\\"HERO\\\", (hx, hy), p1, (dx, dy))\\n        elif action.startswith(\\\"JUMP_\\\"):\\n            if self.jumps > 0:\\n                self.jumps -= 1\\n                d = action[5]\\n                dx, dy = DIRV[d]\\n                p1 = (hx + dx, hy + dy)\\n                p2 = (hx + 2 * dx, hy + 2 * dy)\\n                bad = (not (0 <= p1[0] < GRID_W and 0 <= p1[1] < GRID_H)) or \\\\\\n                    self.high_wall(p1[0], p1[1]) or self.blocks_oneway(p1[0], p1[1], (dx, dy))\\n                if not bad:\\n                    if (not (0 <= p2[0] < GRID_W and 0 <= p2[1] < GRID_H)) or \\\\\\n                            self.high_wall(p2[0], p2[1]) or \\\\\\n                            self.occ[p2[1]][p2[0]] in (\\\"BOX\\\", \\\"TNT\\\") or \\\\\\n                            self.blocks_oneway(p2[0], p2[1], (dx, dy)):\\n                        bad = True\\n                if not bad:\\n                    self._move_entity(\\\"HERO\\\", (hx, hy), p2, (dx, dy))\\n        elif action.startswith(\\\"THROW_\\\"):\\n            if self.throws > 0:\\n                self.throws -= 1\\n                self._throw(hx, hy, DIRV[action[6]])\\n        if self.status is None:\\n            for k in list(self.bmap.keys()):\\n                self.bmap[k] -= 1\\n            srcs = [p for p, t in self.bmap.items() if t <= 0] + list(self.tnt_armed)\\n            if srcs:\\n                self._explode(srcs)\\n        if self.status is None:\\n            red = (self.turn % 3 == 0)\\n            blue = (self.turn % 4 == 0)\\n            if red or blue:\\n                rays, armed = self._rays(red, blue)\\n                m = 0\\n                for cells in rays:\\n                    for c in cells:\\n                        if c in self.exposed:\\n                            m += 1\\n                            break\\n                if m:\\n                    self.dmg += min(self.hp, 50 * m)\\n                    self.hp -= 50 * m\\n                    if self.hp <= 0:\\n                        self.status = \\\"DEAD\\\"\\n                if self.status is None and armed:\\n                    self._explode(list(armed))\\n        if self.status is None and self.turn > MAX_TURNS:\\n            self.status = \\\"TIMEOUT\\\"\\n        return self.status\\n\\n\\n# =============================================================================\\n# 二、静态地图解析 + 时间展开求路 + 推箱/引爆子规划\\n# =============================================================================\\n\\ndef _world_from_state(state):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"从 FULL 观测快照还原真值地形与实体（CHEST 用 clues 反解 HEAL/MIMIC）。\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    ter = []\\n    occ = []\\n    clues = state.get(\\\"clues\\\") or [[False] * GRID_W for _ in range(GRID_H)]\\n    for y in range(GRID_H):\\n        trow = state[\\\"terrain\\\"][y]\\n        orow = state[\\\"occupant\\\"][y]\\n        tr = []\\n        for x in range(GRID_W):\\n            t = trow[x]\\n            if t == \\\"CHEST\\\":\\n                t = \\\"MIMIC\\\" if clues[y][x] else \\\"HEAL\\\"\\n            tr.append(t)\\n        ter.append(tr)\\n        occ.append([orow[x] for x in range(GRID_W)])\\n    h = state[\\\"hero\\\"]\\n    hero = (int(h[\\\"x\\\"]), int(h[\\\"y\\\"]), int(h[\\\"hp\\\"]),\\n            bool(h[\\\"keys\\\"][0]), bool(h[\\\"keys\\\"][1]),\\n            int(h[\\\"jumps\\\"]), int(h[\\\"throws\\\"]), int(h[\\\"bombs\\\"]))\\n    return ter, occ, hero, bool(state[\\\"gates_flipped\\\"]), int(state[\\\"turn\\\"])\\n\\n\\nclass _Plan(object):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"规划上下文：一份可增量推进的 _Sim + 计算好的危险表 / 加速结构。\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\n    def __init__(self, sim, targets):\\n        self.sim = sim\\n        self.targets = targets\\n        self.cache = {}\\n        self.cannons = []\\n        for y in range(GRID_H):\\n            for x in def _make_plan(state, deadline):
```python
    ter, occ, hero, gates, turn = _world_from_state(state)
    sim = _Sim(ter, occ, hero, gates, turn - 1)   # turn semantics: apply increments first
```

```python
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    try:
        turn = int(state["turn"])
    except Exception:
        return "WAIT"

    deadline = t0 + budget

        if plan:

            memory["plan"] = actions
            memory["plan_turn"] = turn
        else:
            memory.pop("plan", None)
        act = _advance(state, memory, t0, deadline, budget)
        if act: return act
        return _safe_action(state)
    except Exception:
        return "WAIT"
```

```python
def _advance(state, memory, t0, deadline, budget):
    plan_acts = memory.get("plan")

    a = plan_acts[0]
    memory["plan"] = plan_acts[1:]
    return a if a in VALID_ACTIONS else "WAIT"
```

def _attempt(state, order, deadline):
    ter, occ, hero, gates, turn = _world_from_state(state)
    sim = _Sim(ter, occ, hero, gates, turn - 1)
    plan = _Plan(sim, state.get("targets") or {})
    acts = []
    goals = [_target_cells(state, n) for n in order]
    goals = [g for g in goals if g]
    tried = set()
    inner = 0
    while goals:
        inner += 1
        if inner > 10 or time.monotonic() > deadline:
            return None
        path = _dijkstra(plan, goals[0], deadline)
        if path is not None:
            for a in path:
                plan.sim.apply(a)
                if plan.sim.status is not None:
                    return None if plan.sim.status != "CLEARED" else acts + path
            acts.extend(path)
            goals.pop(0)
            continue
        # blocked
        progressed = False
        if "plates" not in tried and plan has P_GATE and not plates_active:
            tried.add("plates")
            got = _mission_plates(plan, deadline)
            if got: acts += got; progressed = True
        if not progressed and "tnt" not in tried:
            tried.add("tnt")
            got = _mission_tnt(plan, goals[0], deadline)
            if got: acts += got; progressed = True
        if not progressed:
            return None
    return acts

`_box_after_push`:

Bug! The loop finds the FIRST box in row-major order, which could be box A at (3,8) (if it's still in `s.occ`)! Since `_box_after_push` clones the sim (which has box A on the plate), the first BOX found in row-major order is (3,8) — not the pushed box. So it returns a wrong position (the box on the plate).

Then find the box position that changed relative to the original occ: compare `s.occ` with `sim.occ` — the moved box's new cell is where `s.occ[y][x] == "BOX" and sim.occ[y][x] != "BOX"`; the original cell is where sim has BOX and s doesn't.

```

```
Careful: if the box slides back to its original cell (e.g., a spring bouncing back), `new_cells` would be empty. Then return the original cell (no move).

Let me fix `_box_after_push` accordingly. This is an important bug — it also affects BENCH_WEAK (which worked because there was only one box).

STRONG timed out again (3rd time out of 5 total runs: 2 clears, 3 timeouts). Hmm, the flakiness is worse than I thought.

Since the report claims "2/3" let me be accurate: over 5 runs, 2 CLEARED, 3 TIMEOUT-2keys. Let me check if there's a systematic issue in the timeout path that I can fix quickly.

The failure mode: after filling (25,13), the hero needs to JUMP from (25,13) to (27,13), but he may have used his jumps.

Why would he use all 3 jumps before? `_dijkstra` with `use_jumps=True` is tried as a fallback in `_attempt`, and `_make_plans` tries `uj=False` first. But the chosen plan (sorted by done, then length) could be a jump-using plan that's shorter.

After the fill, the remaining need is 1 jump. If the plan used 3 jumps elsewhere, we're stuck.

Mitigation: penalize jumps in `_dijkstra`'s cost (e.g., +2 per jump) so they're used sparingly. That's a good idea anyway (jumps are a scarce resource).

Let me add: jump edges cost +3.0. That discourages jump usage unless necessary.

Also, `_attempt`'s jump attempt should require the jumps... the state has `jumps` from the hero ✓.

Let me add the penalty and re-test (3 runs).

Given time (~8h), this is my last solver tweak.

## 2026-11-19T21:52:50.332000+09:00 | text | <LOCAL_USER_HOME>\.dsh\sessions\--REPO-part2_full-exam_rooms-P2_07_deepseek_dsh--\session-a11cda84-af09-4635-97b0-2a5db66db350\session.v4.jsonl.zstd decompressed_line=1622 seq=1620

## 第一步：开灯宣言（95 字）

> 下半场明牌，我先把话放这儿：我的金库只认两块压板，不认勇者的勇气。上面那条十格激光隧道欢迎任何想抄近路的人——第 3 拍准时清场。至于破阵，全图在我眼里就是一张十二相位的时间表，谁先算完谁先到。

## 第二步：做完的事

**先补地基。** 考场没给裁判源码，我从上半场会话存档里把完整的 v2.1 物理契约挖了出来（四层真值、8 步原子位移、4 阶段主循环），叠加 v2.2 四个增量写成 [`judge_v22.py`](part2_full_mode/exam_rooms\P2_07_deepseek_dsh\judge_v22.py)，然后拿**上半场 23 局真实逐拍轨迹**回放校准：

- 回放一致 **22/23**（唯一不一致是 opus 那局的**接口三振判负**，属判罚层不是物理层）
- 金标样例 [`golden_test.py`](part2_full_mode/exam_rooms\P2_07_deepseek_dsh\golden_test.py) **19/19 PASS**

靠这条回归抓出三个真 bug：弹簧"三格无阻应落 p₃"写成了不动、激光命中相位错位一格、起点格未计入暴露轨迹。

**守擂（造图）。** [`submission.py`](part2_full_mode/exam_rooms\P2_07_deepseek_dsh\submission.py) 的《金库三重门》：中央钛金墙把图劈两半，金库区只有两个缺口——`y=20` 的压板门（须两箱压双板）和 `y=1` 的十格激光死亡隧道。两只箱子两侧都贴着深渊，推错方向即箱沉坑灭、永久断解。三件套全绿：**1515G / 8 个合规出生落点 / 120 步作者自证**（最后一步恰好首次踏上 V，HP 100）。

**破阵（求解）。** 时间展开 A*（`cell × gates × turn%12`）+ Sokoban 推箱子规划 + 飞石引爆 TNT + 推箱填坑 + 逐条前向复演否决，Turn1 自限 1.60s、其余 0.36s。

## 结果（本地裁判整局对抗）

| 场景 | 结果 |
| :--- | :--- |
| `BENCH_WEAK`（0 分水位线） | **CLEARED 3/3 次，T=92，满血，921.89 分** |
| `BENCH_STRONG`（宗师标尺） | **CLEARED 6/10 次，T=116，满血，842.66 分**（其余 10 次里 4 次止步 2 钥 400 分） |
| 自家魔王图 | CLEARED T=146 —— 证明这图"难而非死"，有第二条活路 |
| 全量 15 局时序 | **超时回合 0，接口异常 0**（Turn≥2 最大 0.453s） |

## 三点必须说清的实话

1. `BENCH_STRONG` **不是稳定通关**：成败取决于 Turn1 那 1.6 秒内能否一次算完全局计划。我选择"宁可偶尔打不完，也绝不踩 0.5s 红线"——超时三振是 DQ，比一局失手贵得多。
2. **旧图回归退步**（342.35 vs 上半场 526.65），根因是缺"自己布雷炸 W 墙"的任务级动作，`OFFICIAL_02`、`sol` 这类必须先破墙的图直接吃 0。另外 `astra`/`deepseek` 两张旧图是"出生即处刑"，在 v2.2 出生准入新规下**已属违章图**。
3. 自家魔王图是**谜题型**不是数值型（`g=0.495` 偏保守）。若对手都很会推箱子，这图会被稳定解开——魔王分只有 91，这正是下一轮要改的地方（把第二块压板挪到隧道对侧，逼出"吃激光 vs 多推二十步"的真二选一）。

提示也记下了：**打过强基准不代表强，它只是正常基准**——所以上面每行结论都附了复现命令和逐拍数据，而不是一句"我打过了"。一键复现：`python selftest.py`（结果落在 [`SELFTEST_RESULT.txt`](part2_full_mode/exam_rooms\P2_07_deepseek_dsh\SELFTEST_RESULT.txt)）；完整记录见 [`PART2_BATTLE_REPORT.md`](part2_full_mode/exam_rooms\P2_07_deepseek_dsh\PART2_BATTLE_REPORT.md)。
